chapters.title: Chapter 1151: Fairy King
paragraphs: The woman has a youthful face, with fair skin and large blue eyes. Her long golden blonde hair was styled partly in a braid. Her overall figure was slim but shapely, with a small waist and accentuated hips. Her golden off-shoulder dress combined elegance with sensuality, enhancing her figure and emphasizing her well-rounded breasts. Her lower dress has a high slit on one side, showing her long, toned legs, making her look alluring.

"Tian You’an, if Tian Qiye and her loyalists find out that our first ancestor has returned, they will immediately capture her, and they will probably kill her before she regains her past memories and abilities. Therefore, bringing her to our domain is the worst choice." The female winged race nodded in understanding to the old man, who then asked Tian Huangjin a question. "Did she ascend to our realm with that kid, daughter?"

Tian Huangjin immediately explained. "Father, you just came out of your seclusion, so I haven’t informed you about this matter, but Zhang Fei ascended to this realm a little over five years ago. He brought his closest people here, and his cultivation has reached the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm now. Back then, he stayed in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and he married Luo Fenghan’s daughter."

"Oh?" Tian Yizu was surprised to hear that. "How could his cultivation be so fast? As I recall, his cultivation hadn’t yet broken through to the Quasi-Divine Realm when you summoned my avatar to the Three Mortal Realms, which was about eight years ago. Moreover, I have never heard that Luo Fenghan has a daughter, and he should only have two sons."

"I don’t know exactly how he managed to do it, but he is a dual cultivator with many women by his side, Father. As for Luo Fenghan’s daughter, no one knew about Luo Yunxiao before their marriage." Tian Yizu naturally knew that a dual cultivator could cultivate much faster if he or she had many partners, but Zhang Fei’s progress was still too absurd for him. Tian Huangjin then continued. "In fact, his cultivation had already broken through to the Divine Expansion Realm when Tianshi Shengjie brought me to meet him years ago. The thing that confused me the most was his age, especially since he was aging too quickly. The last time I saw him, he was still in his twenties, but he was already in his forties when I met him again at the Divine Samsara Sect."

"Time." Tian Yizu and Tian Huangjin looked at a male grand elder. "Since Zhang Fei is aging so quickly, coupled with his cultivation speed, then the only reasonable explanation is that he possesses an artifact with time properties, which helps him speed up or slow down time."

"I agree with you, Tian Wei." Tian You’an spoke, nodding her head. "However, I have never heard of any other artifact with time control besides the Mirror of Eternity, which is ranked 3rd among the Seven Profound Treasures. According to legend, the artifact has the ability to reverse time, but no one has ever been able to prove it, including its current owner."

Tian Wei nodded slightly. "The Mirror of Eternity is in Wang Jingzhi’s hands, and she will never hand it over to anyone, especially since it is her main weapon. Since Zhang Fei recently ascended to this realm, I’m sure they don’t know each other yet. Therefore, I believe there is another factor behind his rapid aging and cultivation, and only he knows it."
"Do you know where Zhang Fei is now?" Tian Yizu asked his daughter again.

"He decided to join the Moonlit Passion Temple, and Qing Qiu’er has appointed him an elder." Tian Huangjin’s answer didn’t surprise them, especially since Zhang Fei was a dual cultivator. "In fact, he wants to transform the sect from a dual cultivation sect to a universal one, Father. He should be in that sect now, especially since they have a lot of work to do to carry out his ideas."

Tian Yizu nodded in agreement before having a discussion with the other two. "Daughter, you know Zhang Fei is better, so I want you to select some of our younger generation to join that sect. You must do this secretly and ensure that Tian Qiye is unaware of it; they will join the sect after he completes his preparations."
"Yes, Father." Tian Huangjin then asked. "What if I join that sect, Father?"

Tian Yizu furrowed his brows, and Tian Wei also looked surprised by Tian Huangjin’s request. Meanwhile, Tian You’an teased her. "Are you interested in Zhang Fei, Little Jin? Otherwise, you wouldn’t have proposed such an idea, right?"

"I don’t have such a feeling in my life, and I was born solely to hunt demons." Tian Huangjin denied her. "However, I’m curious about his progress and everything, so I want to witness everything myself to satisfy my curiosity."
Tian You’an shook her head before speaking to Tian Ziyu. "I think you should let your daughter go, or she’ll be like this for the rest of her life."

"Alright, you can join the sect, but you must not interfere in Zhang Fei’s personal affairs." Tian Huangjin smiled in relief after Tian Yizu agreed. "If there are any new changes regarding him, you must inform us directly."
"Yes, Father."
Tian Huotian then spoke to Tian Wei. "Father, please allow me to go to the Moonlit Passion Temple with Huangjin."
"Me too!" Tian Zhiling raised her right hand. "Elders, I want to join Huangjin and Huotian."

Tian Wei could only shake his head. "Alright, you two can go to that sect with Huangjin. However, you two must not make a fuss there, especially you, Zhiling. If I find out you made a fuss there, I will ground you for a hundred years."
"Elder! I’m not a troublemaker, okay?" Tian Zhiling grabbed Tian Huangjin and Tian Huotian’s hands. "Since our report is complete, we will be leaving now, Elders."

"Haha! I’m sure that little girl will cause a commotion in that sect, but Huotian should be able to control her behavior." Tian You’an laughed as she looked at Tian Zhiling, who hurriedly pulled the two away. "Why don’t you marry them off? They have loved each other for a long time, and she has always clung to him."

"My son does love Zhiling, but he is not ready to marry her, mainly because of her childish behavior. He wants to wait for her to mature first, and he will propose to her then." Tian Wei then stood up. "Where are Tian Jian and Tian Renshi? Why didn’t they show up today?"
Both Tian Yizu and Tian You’an shook their heads at Tian Wei. "Let’s go back, or Tian Qiye will be suspicious of us."
"Let’s go."
In the Floral Mirage Domain, or more precisely, in the residence of the fairies, Jia Leixuan knelt before the white-haired young man sitting on the throne, supporting his head with one hand.
The green-haired young man was none other than the Fairy King, Jia Zizhen. To the side of the room, several male and female fairies stood in order, listening to Jia Leixuan’s report.

Jia Zizhen folded his forehead as Jia Leixuan informed him about Zhang Fei and the people closest to him. "He recently ascended from the Three Mortal Realms, but he has already caused a stir in the Moon Illusion Domain with his breakthrough. His abilities in the alchemy and sword paths surpassed many people, including some senior alchemists and sword masters. He could summon many people out of nowhere, and he has many mythical beasts from several different races under his command; even the merchant’s ancient beast likes him. Moreover, Empress Huo Yanling’s reincarnation is close to him, so I’m sure that he is the sole successor of the Ten-Tailed Fox that we have been looking for all this time. Do you know where he is now?"

"No." Jia Leixuan replied with a shake of his head. "My King, he seems to have heard about those rumors from Luo Fenghan and the others, and he’s deliberately keeping his distance from us. We tried to approach him, but Empress Huo didn’t let us get near him, and they disappeared for several days until the day of the auction. Therefore, I have no information about his plans or his current whereabouts, but he probably returned to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary."

"Empress Huo has been like that for ages." Jia Zizhen then looked at an old man and an old woman, who were standing side by side. "What about your beloved granddaughter, Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun?"

Jia Shengyun respectfully replied to him directly, "My king, I’ve already used our secret technique to track Yuyan’s whereabouts, but we still haven’t managed to find her. We’ve also used special methods to contact her, but we’ve never managed to reach her."
"My king, we have sent some people to look for Yuyan in the Three Mortal Realms, but they shouldn’t have arrived there yet." Jia Lingzhu spoke.

"I don’t care how you two will find her, but I want you two to find Jia Yuyan as soon as possible and bring her back. Once she returns, I will take her as one of my concubines." Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun inwardly cursed before nodding to Jia Zizhen, after which they immediately left the place. "Leixuan, take some people to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary to look for Zhang Fei, and you guys should look for him in other domains if you can’t find him there."
"Yes, My King."

chapters.title: Chapter 1152: Ye Futian
paragraphs: "Do you think something has happened to our granddaughter? Our secret technique should be able to track her whereabouts, but she seems to have disappeared from this universe." Jia Shengyun spoke as they walked to another location.
Jia Lingzhu immediately conveyed her guess. "If Zhang Fei is really the heir of the ten-tailed fox, Yuyan might have met him before, and her disappearance might have something to do with him."
"Do you think that’s possible?"
Jia Lingzhu remembered something. "We must go to that place, and we will find out the truth from him."
Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu had arrived in front of a small lake similar to the one in the Fairy Forest of the Sky Jade Realm, where a statue of a ten-tailed fox stood tall in the center.
Both Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu cupped their hands toward the statue. "Senior, please forgive us, but we have a question for you."
*Swoosh*

Shortly, one of Hu Tianlang’s souls came out of the statue, but he looked different from his lustful, proud, wrathful, benevolent, or evil souls. "Did you two come here to ask about my little girl’s whereabouts?"
"Do you know Yuyan’s whereabouts, Senior?" Jia Lingzhu asked.
Hu Tianlang nodded at her. "Your granddaughter has lived by my heir’s side for decades, and they have long been husband and wife."
"Huh?" Both Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu were shocked to hear that. "Is that true, Senior? Are Zhang Fei and our granddaughter already husband and wife?"

Hu Tianlang lazily waved one of his tails, and a small screen appeared before them. "Even though I have separated my souls into several parts, all my souls are still connected to each other. He is my heir, Zhang Fei. Because of your stupid king, my little girl has never been this happy before, but now she is so happy, and he is the source of her happiness."
"But how can they be husband and wife, Senior?" Jia Lingzhu asked in confusion.
Jia Shengyun also spoke. "Zhang Fei hasn’t broken through to the Five Celestial Realms for long, so their cultivation difference is too significant to get married."

"Foolish people." Hu Tianlang made the remark, shaking his head. "Did you two forget that my heir has a demon identity? His demon identity is a lust demon, and he has an ability that allows him to modify his body or that of other people. He was too aggressive, and my little girl eventually fell for him. He altered her body, and they have been dual cultivated countless times in the last decades."

Upon hearing that, Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu exchanged glances with each other. There was joy in their eyes after seeing Jia Yuyan so happy with Zhang Fei, but they were also worried about them, especially since their king had long wanted her to be his concubine.

Hu Tianlang spoke to them again. "You two don’t need to think about them; your foolish king will never succeed in finding them. Even without Huo Yanling by his side, my heir is not as weak as you two think, and he has grown more and more as a cultivator in the past two decades. Once he is ready, he will come to this domain to meet me, and your foolish king will fall then."
"Do you know their current location, Senior?"

"I know, but I won’t tell you two about their location, and you guys only need to know that my little girl is truly happy with my heir. You two just need to wait for him to bring her here, and you guys will reunite at that time." Hu Tianlang immediately disappeared and returned to the statue again.

Both Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu let out soft sighs, but they were truly relieved to find out that their granddaughter was fine and had returned to the Paradise Realm. They immediately left the area and met their children.
"Master Ye!"

A tall, muscular middle-aged man with long black hair that flows past his shoulders turned to the voice. He has a trimmed beard and mustache, giving him a mature and stern look. His outfit was a dark robe with dark red accents, decorated with dark flame-like patterns. "Heng’er."
"Master Ye!" Yong Heng flew quickly to him before hugging him. "Hahaha! I missed you so much! I was able to see you again after thousands of years!"
The middle-aged man was none other than Ye Futian, the grand elder of the Eternal Night Demon Race, and he was also Han Ling’s grandmaster.
Compared to Ye Mingran, Ye Futian’s aura was much more terrifying, and his body was covered in a jet-black aura.
Ye Futian hugged Yong Heng back. "I miss you too, Heng’er. Thousands of years for you, but tens of thousands of years for me, remember?"
"Hehehe." Yong Heng nodded before pointing at Han Ling. "Master Ye, he is my current master, and he is a disciple of your late disciple."

Ye Futian immediately looked at Han Ling, who was walking beside Ye Mingran. Compared to the Eternal Night Demon God, his aura was much more terrifying, and his body was covered in a deathly, jet-black aura.
"I didn’t expect that this little kid was your granddisciple, Futian." Ye Mingran spoke, but her tone was kind of lazy.
Ye Futian nodded at her. "I myself didn’t expect that the little brat I met back then would raise a disciple, and he bequeathed everything to him, including my sword."

"Grandmaster, my name is Han Ling." Han Ling then took out a letter from animal skin and handed it to Ye Futian. "My late master wrote this letter himself, and I have kept it for several millennia. At first, I thought I would never have the chance to hand it over to you because I had no way to ascend to this realm, but fate had other plans, so I will hand it over to you now."

Ye Futian immediately received the letter and read the writing of his late disciple. Without him realizing it, a satisfied smile appeared on his old face, and a few drops of tears dripped from his eyes, surprising Ye Mingran. "Hahaha! That little brat was truly stubborn! I’ve told him many times not to think about all that, but he never forgot it until the end of his lifespan."

"Let me read it." Ye Futian handed the letter to Ye Mingran, who immediately read it. "You surely obtained such a good disciple back then, but unfortunately, you didn’t manage to find your daughter at that time."

Ye Futian released a soft sigh after Ye Mingran mentioned her daughter. "Wu Zhe helped my daughter and that little asura demon bastard disguised themselves and their aura, and his disguise ability is far better than the Faceless Demon God, Wu Mian, making it difficult for me to find them."

Yong Heng wanted to say something to Ye Futian, but Han Ling signaled her not to say anything, especially regarding Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye. Instead, she informed him of something else. "Master Ye, you actually also have a great-grand disciple."
"Hmm?" Ye Futian furrowed his brows.
Even Ye Mingran was also surprised by this. "Who is your disciple?"

"Senior Ye, you have met my disciple at the auction, and he is the young man who fought for the brush with the Seven Emotion Demon God, Qiu Qingxiu." Han Ling’s words made Ye Mingran think of Zhang Fei, but she didn’t expect that he would have an indirect relationship with her demon race. "I met him in the Three Mortal Realms, and he was the one who brought me to this realm."
Ye Mingran nodded in understanding. "You guys shouldn’t mention that kid here, or we’ll have problems with Qiu Qingxiu if she finds out about this. You three can talk, and I’ll leave."
"Has your disciple mastered all the techniques?" Ye Futian asked Han Ling after Ye Mingran disappeared.
Han Ling nodded at him. "Grandmaster, Zhang Fei is still young, but he is a god-ranked sword master, and his mastery of those techniques is superior to mine."

"That’s true, Master Ye," Yong Heng also spoke to him. "I’ve seen that guy practice swordsmanship countless times, and he’s very skilled at using your techniques. However, I didn’t expect that he had a connection with the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, and the second princess of that race lived in his body for decades."
Ye Futian was shocked to hear that. "You mean Nalan Yushu?"
"Yes, Master Ye!" Yong Heng vigorously nodded her head. "I didn’t know her identity at first, but I found out after Zhang Fei took my master to his private training ground."
"I see." Ye Futian led them to another area. "Let’s talk somewhere else, and I’ll send you both out of this domain afterward; otherwise, your master will become a demon like us."
After they chatted for a while, Ye Futian sent Han Ling and Yong Heng out of the Eternal Night Domain. "If you encounter a serious situation, you can activate this token, and it will protect you."
"Thank you, grandmaster." Han Ling stored the token in his storage ring.
"Where are you going next?"
Han Ling shook his head. "I will visit my disciple in the Twin Flames Domain, but I won’t be staying there for long, and I’ll leave to explore this realm."
"I see." Ye Futian patted his shoulder. "Be careful; the cultivators in this realm are different from those in your home realm."
Han Ling nodded. "We will leave now, grandmaster."

Fei Yinglin then pointed in several directions. "From this area all the way around this mountain is the outer disciple area, and the gate above is the border to the inner disciple area. Inner disciples can ask outer disciples for help with their daily chores, and the same also applies to core disciples, but they are prohibited from dual cultivating with disciples below their rank to maintain balance between them."

"That’s weird." Both women muttered. "In the Three Mortal Realms, it is not a problem for outer, inner, and core disciples to dual cultivate with anyone. Back when he was still living in the lower realm, our husband dual cultivated not only with inner or core disciples, but he also dual cultivated with a vice sect master and a few elders."

Fei Yinglin shook her head at them. "Actually, those ordinary dual cultivation sects are not much different from your husband’s former sect, and they are free to dual cultivate with everyone as long as they agree. However, such things are strictly prohibited by all supreme sects, including our sect."
"So, those who haven’t reached the Five Celestial Realms will join those sects?"

Fei Yinglin gave them a light nod. "Only those who have broken through to the Five Celestial Realms can join supreme sects. Those whose cultivation is still in the Seven Divine Realms will join first-grade sects, and those who have not yet reached that stage will join second-grade sects. The third-grade sects are more like academies for juniors, who are just starting their cultivation path."

After that, Fei Yinglin led them to the inner disciples’ area, which was slightly more luxurious than the core disciples’ area. However, the area was much smaller, especially since the mountain got narrower as they climbed.

Since there are more female disciples than male disciples, Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing saw many lily couples there. They exchanged glances with each other before laughing. ’If he knew there were many lilies in this sect, he would likely approach them later.’

Before long, they arrived at the core disciples’ area, which was far more luxurious than the previous two areas. Although the houses in the area weren’t particularly large, each disciple had their own residence. However, the area was hushed because the core disciples mostly left the sect on missions, and they only stayed in the sect when they were resting and breaking through.

They didn’t stay in that area for too long, and Fei Yinglin led them to the area designated for special disciples. Since there were only ten of them, the area looked much more spacious with ten large luxury houses, which were built quite far from each other.

"Oh? Who are these two women, Yinglin? Why did you bring outside disciples like them to this area?" A young man with shoulder-length hair and a tall, thin figure asked as he appeared in front of them. However, he was not a human male but a male beast, especially since he had two eyes and ears that were similar to a cat’s eyes and ears, and he also had a black tail snaking behind his hip.
Fei Yinglin pulled the two women behind her before answering him. "Bao Yunlai, you must not approach or seduce them, especially since they are the wives of our new elder."

"Oh?" Bao Yunlai was momentarily surprised. "I’ve heard about our new elder, but they said his cultivation is still at the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, which confused me. What was Sect Master Qing’s reason for appointing him to be our elder? Moreover, I heard she gave him free rein to order the other elders, and the construction below the mountain was his idea."

"You must not underestimate our husband, especially since he is different from other cultivators, including you." Bao Yunlai looked at Yao Jinwu with a frown, but his body trembled slightly when she released her golden crow aura. "You should have paid attention to my identity, right?"
Bao Yunlai nodded with a serious expression. "You are a Golden Crow beast, right?"
Upon hearing that, Fei Yinglin looked back at Yan Jinwu, who smiled at her. "That’s right, I am a Golden Crow, and my beast rank is higher than a Star Shadow Leopard like you."

"Naturally, your beast rank is higher than mine because you are a mythical beast, and I am only a divine beast." Bao Yunlai then asked. "Where is your husband? Is he also a beast? Why isn’t he with the three of you?"
"Our husband is a beast, a nine-tailed fox to be precise." Sima Huiqing’s revelation shocked both Bao Yunlai and Fei Yinglin. "He is dual cultivating with Sister Qiu’er at Celestial Lake now."

Bao Yunlai was stunned for a moment before turning to Fei Yingling, asking for confirmation. "Sister Huiqing didn’t lie to you, and Zhang Fei [5] is indeed dual cultivating with Sect Master Qing there. Since you already know their relationship, you should already understand his status in our sect. He is not just an elder, and he will become the leader of this sect one day."
"I didn’t expect Sect Master Qing to choose him as her partner." Bao Yunlai muttered under his breath. "So, is it true that they will turn this sect into a universal sect?"

Fei Yinglin responded with a shake of her head. "Do you still have to ask about that? Haven’t you seen that the people below have started to open up new lands? Our sect is too weak compared to the other dual cultivation sect, and Sect Master Qing chose to do so because he believed that Zhang Fei [5]’s abilities would help us become better and stronger."
"What kind of abilities does he have?" Bao Yunlai asked curiously.

"Is a god-rank alchemist enough?" Bao Yunlai stared at Yan Jinwu in disbelief, especially since Zhang Fei’s cultivation was too low to achieve such a feat. "Our husband is also a god-rank sword master, and he also masters several other things. If you don’t believe me, you can try sparring with him in swordsmanship. Once the construction below is complete, the sword maniac, Jian Kuang, will come here to spar with him."
A woman suddenly appeared behind Bao Yunlai and hugged him. "What are you talking about with them, darling? Are you thinking about seducing them?"

The woman’s figure was small and not that tall, and her face was quite fierce. She has short, curly black hair. Two cat ears twitched above her head, and her black eyes were like cat pupils, decorated by thick eyebrows. She wore a tight black leather suit that was quite revealing on top, showing off her smooth chest, cleavage, and nicely defined curves.
Bao Yunlai shook his head. "They are the wives of our new elder, Kong Mao."

chapters.title: Chapter 1157: Han Ling’s Return
paragraphs: Kong Mao observed Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing directly, and she noticed the identity of the female golden crow. "Where is your husband?"

Yan Jinwu pointed toward the Celestial Lake. "You shouldn’t go there because our husband is dual cultivating with Sister Qiu’er; otherwise, you won’t be able to hold back your lust, and your lover will be sad about losing you."
Bao Yunlai furrowed his brows, but Fei Yinglin immediately confirmed Yan Jinwu’s words with a nod. "Don’t go there, Mao."
"Hehe." Kong Mao giggled. "Don’t you trust me, darling? I am always loyal to you, and I will never be tempted by any man."
"Still, I forbid you from going there." Bao Yunlai spoke with a stern look.
Kong Mao pursed her lips. "Alright, I won’t go there. Why don’t you go with the others, Yinglin?"

"I’m close to breaking through, so I won’t be going anywhere for now." Fei Yinglin signaled Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing to follow her. "I’ll take them to the elders’ area, as they will stay there with their husband."
After the three women left, Kong Mao asked her lover. "Who exactly is our new elder? Why did Sect Master Qing suddenly choose him as her partner?"

"Zhang Fei [5] is a nine-tailed fox." Bao Yunlai’s answers surprised Kong Mao. "According to Yinglin, he is a god-rank alchemist and a god-rank sword master, and he still has several other statuses, but she hasn’t told me all of them."

Kong Mao looked toward the Celestial Lake. "He is a nine-tailed fox with cultivation in the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, but he can achieve such formidable statuses. Do you think he will be able to bring change to this sect?"

"For now, all the elders, assisted by those closest to him, are preparing a lot of land to build the new halls. According to Elder Chen Yuefeng, he wants to build the alchemy hall and the other halls, and the people closest to him will lead those halls." Kong Mao frowned at Bao Yunlai. "I know your thoughts, but Sect Master Qing has already chosen him as her partner, so his status is different from the other elders. I haven’t met his people, so I don’t know anything about their abilities. However, Elder Chen said that there are a god-rank alchemist, a supreme-rank blacksmith, and a few experts in soul cultivation among them."

Kong Mao nodded slightly. "I don’t know how it will turn out, but I hope he will succeed, especially since it will also benefit us. Do you want to go home? I haven’t seen my parents for a long time, and we don’t have anything else to do now, so I want to go home to see them."
"Let’s go home then."
"Did they intentionally level this area, Senior?" Sima Huiqing asked Fei Yinglin once they were in the Elders’ area, especially since it was flatter and more spacious than the areas below.

Fei Yinglin nodded at her. "Actually, this floating plateau used to belong to the Sun Moon Sect, and they managed everything in the past. However, Sect Master Qing managed to snatch it from them, especially after she accidentally discovered the Forbidden Lotus Codex. Since then, this plateau has belonged to our sect, but the people of that sect have never stopped trying to snatch it back. Fortunately, all the sub-techniques within the Forbidden Lotus Codex were truly extraordinary, and they became our mainstay in defeating them."
"Did all the disciples learn the technique?" Yan Jinwu asked that because she felt it would be strange if Qing Qiu’er allowed everyone to learn the technique.

"Only the elders and the ten special disciples have learned that technique, and our numbers are enough to stop the people from that sect." Fei Yinglin then pointed to the largest building in the area. "All the female elders live there, and all the male elders live in the other building. Sect Master Qing lives in a small artificial pond at the top, and no one can enter except for Vice Sect Master You. Since your husband has become her new partner, I think she will take you all to live there."

Both women nodded in understanding. "Since we can’t go in there, and our husband is also still dual cultivating with Sister Qing at the lake, we should go down the mountain and help the others to open those areas."
"Let’s go now."

After they descended from the mountain, the three women saw that many new areas had been cleared, and numerous logs were neatly arranged in one area. Their large numbers, coupled with their high cultivation base, made their work much easier.

Fei Yinglin was surprised when she saw many devices flying here and there, carrying logs and stones. "Who created those devices? They’re outdated compared to the ones in my domain, but they’re still helpful for this construction."

"Both of them." Yan Jinwu pointed to Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji, who seemed busy controlling those devices. "They are the best artifact crafters in the Three Mortal Realms, and Ji Changlan is the leader of the blacksmith union."
Fei Yinglin nodded in understanding. "However, they shouldn’t have to cut down all the trees, and they should leave some to separate each hall."
"Hehe." Yan Jinwu chuckled at that. "Senior, you don’t need to think about that because our husband has two dryads by his side, and they can grow those trees in the blink of an eye."
"Dryads, huh?" Fei Yinglin softly muttered, nodding her head a few times. "Let’s join them."
You Feling suddenly landed in front of them. "Is my big sister with Zhang Fei [5] now?"

"They are dual cultivating at the Celestial Lake right now." Yan Jinwu’s answer surprised You Feiling, who was not expecting that Qing Qiu’er had already done it with Zhang Fei [5]. "You should go there, Sister You. I’m sure Sister Qing won’t be able to serve our husband by herself, so you should join them to help her; otherwise, she won’t be able to get out of bed for several days."
You Feiling looked towards the Celestial Lake for a moment, but she immediately refused. "My big sister hasn’t dual cultivated with a man for a long time, so I won’t disturb her fun."
"Sister You, I’m curious about the partners of you two; where are they now?" Sima Huiqing suddenly asked.

"Our partners have been dead for a long time." Seeing that Sima Huiqing and Yan Jinwu were so curious, You Feiling immediately explained to them in more detail. "Since then, we no longer have partners because there are no men worthy of being ones, and we use other methods to increase our cultivation. However, my big sister decided to send her avatars to all the towers to look for a worthy one, and she found Zhang Fei [5] in the Star Tower with two women. Since then, she has chosen him as her partner and imparted the Lotus Forbidden Codex to him to help him develop faster."
Both women nodded in understanding. "What about you, Sister You? Are you interested in becoming our husband’s partner too?"
"I haven’t thought about it yet." You Feiling immediately turned around. "Let’s help them."

Time flew by quickly, and the day had turned to night again. Han Ling had arrived at the city below the floating plateau, but an old man was already waiting for him at the entrance. "Are you Han Ling?"
"Yes." Han Ling nodded at the old man. "Could you please tell me your identity, Senior?"

"My name is Rong Yuchen, and Elder Zhang asked me to pick you up." The old man immediately gave Han Ling a token from the Moonlit Passion Sect. "This token is your identity as an elder of our sect, and the people of this city will not stop you from going there. However, you don’t need to go through this city, and you can fly straight up, especially since our sect is on the floating plateau. As long as you have this token, you can directly pass through the barrier without needing to use the teleportation device."

Han Ling looked up toward the floating plateau, but Rong Yuchen immediately grabbed his shoulder and took him flying there. "Honestly, I didn’t think about becoming an elder in your sect, Senior. I came here to meet Zhang Fei [5] and bid him farewell, and I will go explore this realm."

"I can’t say anything about that, and you should speak to Elder Zhang yourself." Han Ling nodded to Rong Yuchen. "However, he’s busy with Sect Master Qing right now, so you should wait for him to return."
"I see." Han Ling nodded in understanding. "In that case, I’ll wait for him to come back."

A while later, they arrived at the floating plateau, but Han Ling was a little surprised to see thousands of people working hard, even though it was already night. He remembered Zhang Fei [5]’s plans to turn the sect into a universal one, and he decided to join them while waiting for his return.

At the Celestial Lake, Qing Qiu’er was lying on the ground with an expression full of exhaustion, and her body was covered with many red marks that Zhang Fei [5] had given her. "You’re crazy! You fucked me from midnight until it was night again."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "Weren’t you the one who asked me to fuck you so hard?"
Qing Qiu’er let out a soft breath. "Please bring me back to my residence to rest."

Time flew by quickly, and the day had turned to night again.
Han Ling had arrived at the city below the floating plateau, but an old man was already waiting for him at the entrance.
"Are you Han Ling?"
"Yes." Han Ling nodded at the old man.
"Could you please tell me your identity, Senior?"
"My name is Rong Yuchen, and Elder Zhang asked me to pick you up." The old man immediately gave Han Ling a token from the Moonlit Passion Sect.
"This token is your identity as an elder of our sect, and the people of this city will not stop you from going there.
However, you don’t need to go through this city, and you can fly straight up, especially since our sect is on the floating plateau.
As long as you have this token, you can directly pass through the barrier without needing to use the teleportation device."
Han Ling looked up toward the floating plateau, but Rong Yuchen immediately grabbed his shoulder and took him flying there.
"Honestly, I didn’t think about becoming an elder in your sect, Senior.
I came here to meet Zhang Fei [5] and bid him farewell, and I will go explore this realm."
"I can’t say anything about that, and you should speak to Elder Zhang yourself." Han Ling nodded to Rong Yuchen.
"However, he’s busy with Sect Master Qing right now, so you should wait for him to return."
"I see." Han Ling nodded in understanding.
"In that case, I’ll wait for him to come back."
A while later, they arrived at the floating plateau, but Han Ling was a little surprised to see thousands of people working hard, even though it was already night.
He remembered Zhang Fei [5]’s plans to turn the sect into a universal one, and he decided to join them while waiting for his return.
At the Celestial Lake, Qing Qiu’er was lying on the ground with an expression full of exhaustion, and her body was covered with many red marks that Zhang Fei [5] had given her.
"You’re crazy!
You fucked me from midnight until it was night again."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled.
"Weren’t you the one who asked me to fuck you so hard?"
Qing Qiu’er let out a soft breath.
"Please bring me back to my residence to rest."

chapters.title: Chapter 1158: Meet Ji Zhongli
paragraphs: When Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er arrived at the peak of the mountain, four women were already waiting for them there. You Feiling and Su Yao blushed when they saw both of them were naked, but their gaze locked onto the dangling dick.
You Feiling and Su Yao swallowed their saliva as their bodies gradually heated up by themselves, and their breaths began to become irregular as they imagined lewd things in their minds.
Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing giggled at their reactions. "Husband, your master has returned, and he lives in the elders’ area."

"I know." Zhang Fei [5] briefly glanced at You Feiling and Su Yao before taking Qing Qiu’er to the only building in the area, and he left her there to rest. Thereafter, he hurriedly got dressed and went to the elders’ area to meet Han Ling.
Once he left, Yan Jinwu teased You Feiling and Su Yao. "See? What did I say before? Sister Qing won’t be able to handle our husband by herself, and she’s completely exhausted."
"Unlike Sister Qing, our husband still isn’t tired even though they’ve been dual cultivating for almost a whole day, and he can continue for a few more rounds," Sima Huiqing chimed in.
"I’ll check on my big sister." You Feiling hurriedly entered the building, as did Su Yao, who followed her master, leaving Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing laughing at their shy behavior.
Yan Jinwu immediately stood up. "There aren’t any other buildings here yet, so we should go to the elders’ area and rest there."
"Yeah, let’s go there."

Zhang Fei [5] and Han Ling stood side by side in one of the elders’ areas, discussing their long-term plans. "Old Han, I understand your desire to explore this realm, but I still need your help to help me rebuild this sect. I want to make this sect our base, and our future journey will start from here. Therefore, I hope you’ll be willing to stay here for a while, and together we will make this sect the strongest in this realm."

"Haha." Han Ling laughed at that. "Kid, I knew you had lofty ambitions, but I didn’t expect them to be this big. Making this sect the strongest in this realm isn’t an effortless matter, you know? There are so many powerful cultivators in this realm, including those demon gods. You do have many advantages compared to them, but surpassing them will take a very long time, and we will face a lot of pressure in the process."
"Are you afraid of facing those pressures, Old Han?" Zhang Fei [5] asked with a smile.

Han Ling looked at him. "Should I be afraid of facing them? I’m aware of the difference between my strength and theirs, but I no longer have any burden in my life. They are powerful, but I’m confident in my abilities, and I’m sure I can face them as long as I act more carefully."
"In that case, join me and become the strongest together." Zhang Fei [5] extended his hand to his master.

Han Ling grabbed his hand. "Alright, I’ll put my adventure on hold, and I’ll help you rebuild this sect. Although it will take a long time, I believe that this sect will be the strongest one day, especially with those people on our side."

"That’s great!" Zhang Fei [5] exclaimed in joy. "Since you’ve agreed, I want you to lead the Sword Hall, Old Han. With your help, I believe this sect will produce many skilled sword masters, and they will be our vanguard in conquering this realm."
Han Ling then asked him. "What about the other elders? Have you checked their abilities? Do they have other abilities besides dual cultivation?"

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] awkwardly rubbed his nose. "I met them yesterday, but I haven’t checked their abilities yet. Since it’s already late, I’ll gather them tomorrow to check their abilities. I hope they have other abilities besides dual cultivation, or they will only be a burden to our sect."

Han Ling nodded in agreement with that. "We cannot solely rely on the strength and abilities of the people on our side to develop this sect, and we need their help to do so because they are natives of this realm. Since you have chosen this sect as our base, and the construction has also begun, I think it is time for you to bring your people left behind in the Three Mortal Realms to this realm, especially those giant race members. With their help, the construction of this sect will be completed ahead of schedule, and we can start looking for new disciples."
"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the gate to the Sovereign Heaven Realm. "In that case, I’ll meet them first, and I’ll bring them here when they’re ready."
"Alright."

A while later, Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the eastern forest and found Jin Zhongli sitting alone enjoying his wine. "Have you broken through to the Five Celestial Realms? You’ve only been gone for about three months, but I can no longer sense your strength."

"My current cultivation has already reached the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, Old Jin." Jin Zhongli looked at Zhang Fei [5] in shock. "It’s only been three months for you, but more than two decades have passed for me. Since I arrived in that realm, I’ve been completely focused on my cultivation, especially after the events of that time."

Jin Zhongli nodded in understanding after he checked Zhang Fei [5]’s bone age, discovering that he had indeed aged significantly. "You are a dual cultivator with so many women by your side, and the Celestial Qi is much more powerful than the Divine Qi, so it is natural that you can reach this stage in twenty decades. So, what brought you back to this realm? Did you find many intriguing things in that realm?"

"As I previously mentioned, I’ve dedicated myself entirely to my cultivation for over two decades, so I haven’t visited many locations in that realm. However, I’ve been to several places before, such as in the Forbidden Land, and I discovered quite a few intriguing things there." Zhang Fei [5] then sat by Jin Zhongli’s side and retold him several things. "Old Jin, I’ve already chosen our base, so I was thinking of bringing you and these people to that realm, and all of your cultivation will progress rapidly there."
Jin Zhongli was surprised. "Can you tell me everything first?"

"Sure." Zhang Fei [5] then told Jin Zhongli about the Moonlit Passion Temple and his future plans for it. "Right now, most of my people have already started construction, and I want to take you all there to speed up the process. Once everything is finished, I will ask the elders to look for new disciples. However, it is not an easy matter because the sect used to be a dual cultivation sect, and other cultivators despised dual cultivators so badly."

Jin Zhongli nodded in agreement. "Rebuilding a reputation that’s been tarnished for decades, or even millennia, is definitely no easy feat. However, you possess many extraordinary abilities, and you also have many people who are experts in various fields. Therefore, I believe you will have no trouble gaining new disciples, and you guys just need to use your abilities to pique their interest with some live performances."

"Live performances, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered with a slight nod. "We can do that with alchemy, swordsmanship, blacksmithing, and formation arrays. However, some others can’t do that with live performances, so I have to think of other ways to attract the attention of the new disciples. By the way, Old Jin, can you help Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji to create gravity devices like the ones in the punished ground of this realm?"

Jin Zhongli nodded at him. "I don’t know the abilities of those two people in artifact crafting yet, but I can help them develop some of the same devices. However, it will probably take some time, and we also need special materials to create them."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] recalled the Sky Pillar Realm. "There’s a realm far more advanced than the Xianjin Realm there, and I can take you there to find those materials."

"How much different is the gravity in that realm compared to here?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately told Jin Zhongli about it. "In that case, you have to talk to those people first. Most are ready for that realm, but the rest must adapt to its conditions first."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately left to meet Ren Shou and Shangguan Wan’er first. After they agreed, he went to the giant race living area and discussed the matter with Ju Tan, Ju Xing, and the others.
Since they had already vowed to follow Zhang Fei [5], the giant race members didn’t think twice and immediately accepted his offer to go to the Paradise Realm.

Zhang Fei [5] then summoned Jia Yuyan out of the training space, and they immediately gathered the other natural races in one place. None of them objected; instead, they had been looking forward to this opportunity for a long time.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately asked them all to pack their personal belongings, and he left the Eastern Forest to meet his slaves in the main city, such as Leng Hua, Cao Yunbai, and Bao Yundong. Although they were not as strong as the cultivators in the Paradise Realm, they were strong enough to help him, and he decided to take them there.

chapters.title: Chapter 1159: Gather Old Acquaintances
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] decided to meet Lin Zuxin and offered her to go to the Paradise Realm. Despite her initial shock, she readily agreed, and she asked him to bring her family along.
In the end, Zhang Fei [5] decided to take Lin Zuxin’s family along, especially since she only had a daughter, a son-in-law, and a little grandson.
Zhang Fei [5] then went to the Chi Clan to meet Chi Yuexin, and she accepted his offer on the condition that he bring Wenren Yue and some of her clan members along, which he agreed to.
As with the Lin Clan, Zhang Fei [5] did not immediately take them to the Paradise Realm. He asked them to prepare everything first.

After that, Zhang Fei [5] left the Sovereign Heaven Realm and went to the Phoenix Realm, where he met Feng Zhen. He also summoned Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu out of the training space, and he asked them to prepare all the members of the two phoenix races.

At first, Zhang Fei [5] thought about waiting for Feng Yao to be ready to return to the Blazing Nirvana Domain, but the phoenix princess couldn’t say for sure when she would return to the domain. Therefore, he decided to take them to the Moonlit Passion Temple first because the floating plateau was truly vast, and they could increase their cultivation while waiting for her to be ready.

Unlike the people from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, Zhang Fei [5] had already asked the members of the phoenix race to prepare themselves long ago; Thus, he didn’t waste much time waiting for them, especially since they had been ready to move for a long time.
Zhang Fei [5] sent the members of the phoenix race to the Moonlit Passion Temple, followed by Feng Zhen, Feng Xueying, and Feng Jinqiu, to arrange their new residence there.

After leaving the Phoenix Realm, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Xianjin Realm, where he met Tian Yishen and Xiao Laoshu, especially since both of them were expert doctors and understood many medical technologies.

Zhang Fei [5] explained to Tian Yishen and Xiao Laoshu about his desire to take them to the Paradise Realm, which shocked them. After all, they had never known about that realm before. "Currently, the Nameless One and the others are already in that realm, having broken through to the Five Celestial Realms years ago. If the two of you are willing to go there, your cultivation will also reach that stage, and you will become even better doctors."
"Does that mean you’ve also broken through to that stage, kid?" Tian Yishen asked.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Tian Yishen. "I broke through to this stage a few weeks ago, Senior."
"Senior, this kid’s bone age is over 40 years old now," Xiao Laoshu suddenly said.

"I see." Tian Yishen nodded slightly after examining Zhang Fei [5]. "Kid, your offer is interesting, and we really want to go to the Paradise Realm. Unfortunately, we cannot leave so suddenly, and we need time to organize everything first. If you don’t mind, please give us a week, and you can pick us up at that time."

"Don’t worry, Senior. No need to rush and settle all your affairs in this realm first, and I will take you two to the Paradise Realm after everything is settled." After they discussed a few other things, Zhang Fei [5] left the hospital and thought about his next destination, especially since everyone he knew in the Xianjin Realm was already at the Moonlite Passion Temple.

[Master, why don’t you go see Long Zhenxia? You have her flame dragon bloodline, and she is an excellent alchemist, so you should appreciate her more and take her with you. Apart from her, haven’t you thought about bringing the natural races from the Evergreen Spirit Haven and the golden fox race?]

"I don’t have a good relationship with the natural races from the Evergreen Spirit Haven, and not all of them are strong. Therefore, I won’t bring them there, and I will ask them to take care of my shop in their realm and in other realms. Zhang Fei [5] then summoned Huli Zhishen and Huli Xianniang out of the training space before opening the gate to the Wilderness Expanse Realm. "I want you two to return to your realm to meet your race members, and you must prepare them to move there as soon as possible."
Both women were surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s sudden decision. "Why do you suddenly want to take them there?"

"They are your family members, so I thought it would be better if I brought them there." They stared suspiciously at Zhang Fei [5], as they did not believe that reason. "Haha! Finding new sect members isn’t easy with the Moonlit Passion Sect’s old reputation, so I want them to fill the floating plateau to make it more lively while we look for new disciples. Moreover, your golden fox race are mythical beasts, so it would be a loss if they continued to stay here, and they would be able to develop themselves further there."
"Do you want to have them as your troops, husband?" Huli Zhishen seriously asked.

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] admitted it straight away. "You guys still remember the writing left by the old fox, right? Back then, I would rather not accept that because I was too weak, but I’ve decided to accept it. However, I cannot be a peacemaker if I depend solely on our current numbers, as this universe is simply too vast, and I will need more troops in the future. I’ve already sent the Phoenix Race there, so I’ll send the other mythical beast race there as well, and we’ll start from your golden fox race."
"Alright, we’ll return to our realm now." Huli Zhishen immediately led Huli Xianniang to the gate.

After they left, Zhang Fei [5] summoned the ancestors and the leaders of the Vermilion Bird, Mythical Deer, Dragon, Black Turtle, and White Tiger Races. "I want all of you to return to your respective realms and prepare your race members to move to the Paradise Realm, and you can contact me when they’re ready. Once they are ready, I’ll pick you all up and take them all there."

Zhu Danqing and the others were surprised by that, but they were also relieved because Zhang Fei [5] was willing to bring members of their races to the Paradise Realm, allowing them to develop further.
"In that case, we—"

"No need." Zhang Fei stopped Zhu Hong and opened several gates at once. Since the system upgraded to level 8, he no longer needed to go to those realms to open them. "Enter now and contact me once they are ready."
"Yes."

Zhang Fei [5]’s next destination was the Sky Dragon Realm, and he met the mythical beasts who lived in there. When he arrived there, he immediately brought Zhu Lingyao, Feng Qingmeng, Nu Qichen, Huli Haohao, and Yan Jinwu into that realm. Like the others, he asked them to prepare their clan members in that realm.

On the other hand, Zhang Fei [5] visited the other clans, such as the Dragon, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger Clans. Unlike the three beast races in their main realm, the three clans in that realm have long belonged to him, and he ordered them to prepare to move.

Zhang Fei [5] then went to the Qilin Clan to meet Lei Qilin and his family, and he asked Yuwen Xingzuan from the Kunpeng Clan to join them. His current cultivation shocked everyone, but he shocked them again when he revealed his decision to take them to the Paradise Realm. "Yuwen Xingyuan and Lei Huoting have already reached the Five Celestial Realms, so they are the strongest among you all now."
"How can my granddaughter reach that stage in just over two years, kid?" Lei Qilin asked in awe and shock.

"Hey, Old Lei! You don’t need to be surprised by our daughter and granddaughter’s cultivation." Yuwen Xingzuan pointed at Zhang Fei [5]. "Look at him; his cultivation only broke through to the 5-Star Heaven Realm when he first arrived in this realm, but his cultivation has already surpassed ours."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly. "Old Lei, the flow of time in the Paradise Realm is much faster, and 50 years in that realm is equivalent to one year in the Three Mortal Realms. Moreover, I no longer cultivate using Divine Qi but Celestial Qi, so you guys don’t need to be surprised by my progress, especially since I’ve been focused on cultivation for the past 20 years."
"The Celestial Qi?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "I’ll explain everything to you all later, and you guys can start packing now. By the way, I’m going to meet some people in the other realms now, and I’ll come back here to pick you all up later."
After Zhang Fei [5] left, the people from the Qilin and Kunpeng Clans immediately gathered their members, and they hurriedly packed up their respective important belongings.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] had arrived at the Mirage Heaven Realm, finding Long Zhenxia checking out his shop.
Long Zhenxia stared at Zhang Fei [5], dumbfounded. "Has your cultivation already passed the Seven Divine Realms?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] grabbed her hand. "Zhenxia, I know I treated you badly, even though you gave me your flame dragon bloodline. I came here to pay for my mistakes, and I want to take you to the Paradise Realm."

"I broke through to this stage a few weeks ago, Senior."
"Senior, this kid’s bone age is over 40 years old now," Xiao Laoshu suddenly said.
"I see." Tian Yishen nodded slightly after examining Zhang Fei [5].
"Kid, your offer is interesting, and we really want to go to the Paradise Realm.
Unfortunately, we cannot leave so suddenly, and we need time to organize everything first.
If you don’t mind, please give us a week, and you can pick us up at that time."
"Don’t worry, Senior.

No need to rush and settle all your affairs in this realm first, and I will take you two to the Paradise Realm after everything is settled." After they discussed a few other things, Zhang Fei [5] left the hospital and thought about his next destination, especially since everyone he knew in the Xianjin Realm was already at the Moonlite Passion Temple.
[Master, why don’t you go see Long Zhenxia?
You have her flame dragon bloodline, and she is an excellent alchemist, so you should appreciate her more and take her with you.
Apart from her, haven’t you thought about bringing the natural races from the Evergreen Spirit Haven and the golden fox race?]
"I don’t have a good relationship with the natural races from the Evergreen Spirit Haven, and not all of them are strong.
Therefore, I won’t bring them there, and I will ask them to take care of my shop in their realm and in other realms.
Zhang Fei [5] then summoned Huli Zhishen and Huli Xianniang out of the training space before opening the gate to the Wilderness Expanse Realm.
"I want you two to return to your realm to meet your race members, and you must prepare them to move there as soon as possible."
Both women were surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s sudden decision.
"Why do you suddenly want to take them there?"
"They are your family members, so I thought it would be better if I brought them there." They stared suspiciously at Zhang Fei [5], as they did not believe that reason.
"Haha!
Finding new sect members isn’t easy with the Moonlit Passion Sect’s old reputation, so I want them to fill the floating plateau to make it more lively while we look for new disciples.
Moreover, your golden fox race are mythical beasts, so it would be a loss if they continued to stay here, and they would be able to develop themselves further there."
"Do you want to have them as your troops, husband?" Huli Zhishen seriously asked.
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] admitted it straight away.
"You guys still remember the writing left by the old fox, right?
Back then, I would rather not accept that because I was too weak, but I’ve decided to accept it.
However, I cannot be a peacemaker if I depend solely on our current numbers, as this universe is simply too vast, and I will need more troops in the future.
I’ve already sent the Phoenix Race there, so I’ll send the other mythical beast race there as well, and we’ll start from your golden fox race."
"Alright, we’ll return to our realm now." Huli Zhishen immediately led Huli Xianniang to the gate.
After they left, Zhang Fei [5] summoned the ancestors and the leaders of the Vermilion Bird, Mythical Deer, Dragon, Black Turtle, and White Tiger Races.
"I want all of you to return to your respective realms and prepare your race members to move to the Paradise Realm, and you can contact me when they’re ready.
Once they are ready, I’ll pick you all up and take them all there."

Zhu Danqing and the others were surprised by that, but they were also relieved because Zhang Fei [5] was willing to bring members of their races to the Paradise Realm, allowing them to develop further.
"In that case, we—"
"No need." Zhang Fei stopped Zhu Hong and opened several gates at once.
Since the system upgraded to level 8, he no longer needed to go to those realms to open them.
"Enter now and contact me once they are ready."
"Yes."
Zhang Fei [5]’s next destination was the Sky Dragon Realm, and he met the mythical beasts who lived in there.
When he arrived there, he immediately brought Zhu Lingyao, Feng Qingmeng, Nu Qichen, Huli Haohao, and Yan Jinwu into that realm.
Like the others, he asked them to prepare their clan members in that realm.
On the other hand, Zhang Fei [5] visited the other clans, such as the Dragon, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger Clans.
Unlike the three beast races in their main realm, the three clans in that realm have long belonged to him, and he ordered them to prepare to move.
Zhang Fei [5] then went to the Qilin Clan to meet Lei Qilin and his family, and he asked Yuwen Xingzuan from the Kunpeng Clan to join them.
His current cultivation shocked everyone, but he shocked them again when he revealed his decision to take them to the Paradise Realm.
"Yuwen Xingyuan and Lei Huoting have already reached the Five Celestial Realms, so they are the strongest among you all now."
"How can my granddaughter reach that stage in just over two years, kid?" Lei Qilin asked in awe and shock.
"Hey, Old Lei!
You don’t need to be surprised by our daughter and granddaughter’s cultivation." Yuwen Xingzuan pointed at Zhang Fei [5].
"Look at him; his cultivation only broke through to the 5-Star Heaven Realm when he first arrived in this realm, but his cultivation has already surpassed ours."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly.
"Old Lei, the flow of time in the Paradise Realm is much faster, and 50 years in that realm is equivalent to one year in the Three Mortal Realms.
Moreover, I no longer cultivate using Divine Qi but Celestial Qi, so you guys don’t need to be surprised by my progress, especially since I’ve been focused on cultivation for the past 20 years."
"The Celestial Qi?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them.
"I’ll explain everything to you all later, and you guys can start packing now.
By the way, I’m going to meet some people in the other realms now, and I’ll come back here to pick you all up later."
After Zhang Fei [5] left, the people from the Qilin and Kunpeng Clans immediately gathered their members, and they hurriedly packed up their respective important belongings.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] had arrived at the Mirage Heaven Realm, finding Long Zhenxia checking out his shop.
Long Zhenxia stared at Zhang Fei [5], dumbfounded.
"Has your cultivation already passed the Seven Divine Realms?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] grabbed her hand.
"Zhenxia, I know I treated you badly, even though you gave me your flame dragon bloodline.
I came here to pay for my mistakes, and I want to take you to the Paradise Realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 1160: Meet His In-Laws
paragraphs: "The Paradise Realm?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Long Zhenxia. "The Paradise Realm is above the Three Mortal Realms, and it is the best place for our cultivation, especially since we can cultivate using Celestial Qi. This is why I’m aging rapidly, and my cultivation has already reached the Five Celestial Realms."
"The Five Celestial Realms, the Celestial Qi, the Paradise Realm." Long Zhenxia muttered in a daze, as she had never heard of any of them before.
Zhang Fei [5] pulled Long Zhenxia into the back room. "To make it easier for you to understand, I will take you there now."
[Daily quest I: Absorb 10,000,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1000 purple jewels.]
[Daily Quest II: Absorb 10,000,000 demon essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade demon cores.]
[Daily Quest III: Absorb 10,000,000 beast essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade beast cores.]
[Daily Quest IV: Killing 1000 beasts/demon beasts in the Celestial Lord or above.]
[Reward: Celestial daily pack x1]

Long Zhenxia was stunned again once they arrived at the Paradise Realm. She looked around the surrounding area and tried to sense the Qi in that place, but she still couldn’t feel anything, especially since she hadn’t transformed her Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi.

Zhang Fei [5] covered Long Zhenxia with his aura; otherwise, she would not be able to withstand the gravitational pressure in the Paradise Realm, which was several times heavier than that of the Three Mortal Realms.
"Where are we now?"

"This place is the Moonlit Passion Temple." Long Zhenxia looked at him with raised eyebrows, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately took her flying high. "Your guess is correct; this sect is a dual cultivation sect. Look at them; they are preparing to rebuild this sect, and I will transform it into a universal sect. This sect will become my base, and I will bring all my acquaintances in the Three Mortal Realms here to start our new journey in this realm. Are you willing to move here with me?"
"Uhm." Long Zhenxia herself had been waiting for Zhang Fei [5] for a long time, especially since she left the Sky Dragon Realm. "What about my family and our shop?"

"Naturally, I will bring your family, and you won’t be separated from each other." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer relieved Long Zhenxia. "As for our shop, I think you can close both of them, and we will open many new shops in this realm in the future."
"Does this mean you will also close all your shops in other realms?"

"My slaves will take care of them for me." Zhang Fei [5] imparted the method for converting Divine Qi into Celestial Qi to her before bringing her to the mountaintop, where he sat behind her with his palms pressed against her back. "It will take too long if you convert your Qi yourself, so I’ll help you do it."
*Tap... Tap...*
"Who is she, Zhang Fei?" You Feiling, who had just come out of the building with Su Yao, asked.

Long Zhenxia looked at the two women, but she didn’t dare to look at them for too long because they were too strong for her. ’I’ve never met cultivators as powerful as them in the Three Mortal Realms.’

"Her name is Long Zhenxia, and I just brought her from the Three Mortal Realms." Both women were no longer surprised by it, especially since Zhang Fei [5] had already done it several times when they were still in the Forbidden Land. "By the way, I’ve brought many people here, and many more will follow soon. All of them are phoenix race members, and I asked Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu to arrange their residences away from others."

After hearing that, You Feiling and Su Yao used their senses to check the area below the mountain. They found hundreds of phoenix race members around the edge of the floating plateau trying to convert their Divine Qi into the Divine Qi, but they were still too weak in their eyes. Even so, the two women did not underestimate them because mythical beasts were much different from humans, and they could become much stronger once they had cultivated in their realm.

"How many people will you bring from the Three Mortal Realms?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained the situation to the two women, which left them stunned for a while. "Fortunately, this floating plateau is truly vast; otherwise, we wouldn’t be able to accommodate them. Since my big sister has handed everything over to you, you can arrange everything accordingly, and you can ask the elders for help to take care of them."

Zhang Fei [5] then conveyed his idea. "Since this sect’s reputation was so bad in the past, we would have had difficulty finding new disciples. Therefore, I brought them here to join us, and we will also accept cultivators whose cultivation is still in the Seven Divine Realms in the future."

"You’re right," You Feiling replied with a heavy sigh. "Moreover, we’ve been in their shoes in the past, and we’ve gone through a long process to reach our current level, so I think it’s fine if we accept disciples at that level. Outside of your people, we should only accept those who have reached the Divine Transformation Realm and above, so we won’t waste too much time with them."

"I thought so." Zhang Fei [5] then checked the areas under the mountain. "Since there will be a lot of them later, I think we’ll open many more areas, and we’ll use them for disciples at that level, including my people from the Three Mortal Realms. By the way, I’ll help Zhenxia convert her Qi first, and I want you to gather all the elders this morning."
"What do you want from them?"

Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained. "I want to know their abilities in other fields, especially since we can’t rely solely on charm and dual cultivation techniques to develop, and they need to learn new things to adapt to the future changes in the sect."
"Alright, I will have them gather at the main hall this morning, and you can check their abilities yourself." You Feiling pulled Su Yao away with her.

With Zhang Fei [5]’s help, it wasn’t difficult for Long Zhenxia to convert her qi. In less than an hour, all the qi in her body had become Celestial Qi. Although it didn’t have a direct impact on her cultivation, the changes in her still amazed her.
Zhang Fei [5] then asked Long Zhenxia to absorb the Qi from the air, and she eagerly did it, as the Celestial Qi was too powerful compared to the Divine Qi.
"How do you feel?"
"The Celestial Qi is simply too amazing!" Long Zhenxia answered excitedly.
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] helped her up. "Let’s go back now, and you can talk to your parents about this."
"Yes."

They were already sitting in front of Long Zhenxia’s parents and little brother, and she explained the situation to them. She asked them to join them, but they refused and chose to stay in the Three Mortal Realms.

Long Zhenxia tried to persuade them, but Long Xiaogang and Long Xinran did not budge from their decision. Instead, they asked her to go with Zhang Fei [5], especially since they knew that she had been thinking about him ever since they left the Sky Dragon Realm.
Long Zhenxia was disappointed with their decision, but Zhang Fei [5] told her that she could return to that realm whenever she wanted, and she only needed to tell him about it.
In the end, Long Zhenxia accepted their’ decision, and Zhang Fei [5] sent her to the training space, especially since she was lagging far behind the others.
After he said goodbye to Long Zhenxia’s parents, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Grand Royal Realm.
Zhang Fei [5] and Wei Xiaoya were already sitting with Wei Hongtian, Hun Liying, and Wei Zhutong.
Meanwhile, Wei Xiaolu, who was still fat, sat at a distance, fiercely staring at Zhang Fei [5] while cursing him in her heart.
"What is your cultivation level now, son?" Hun Liying asked.

"Mother-in-law, Xiaoya and I have already reached the One-Sun Celestial Lord Realm." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer shocked them, prompting him to explain everything. "Father-in-law, I know that this kingdom is your ancestral inheritance, but I hope you are willing to hand it over to the rest of your family, and I will take you all to the Paradise Realm."

Seeing her parents hesitating, Wei Xiaoya immediately spoke to them. "Father! Mother! My husband wants to build his own force there, and he has found a suitable place for it. Moreover, Uncle Hun Di and the others have also moved there, so I hope you guys will not refuse our request this time and please come with us to the Paradise Realm."
"What do you think, husband?"

Wei Hongtian let out a soft sigh. "It’s not that I don’t want to leave this kingdom, but I’ve always been afraid that it would be destroyed if I handed it over to another member of my family. However, our son-in-law is right; it’s time for me to let go of this kingdom and look for a better future."
"Are you serious, Father?" Wei Xiaoya asked with a joyful smile.
Wei Hongtian nodded. "I’ll summon your second uncle, and I’ll hand over this kingdom to him. However, the process won’t be completed in a day, and I need to prepare some things first."
"That’s no problem, Father-in-law."

chapters.title: Chapter 1161: Serpentra-Tian Kui’s Decision
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] decided to leave Wei Xiaoya in the Wei Kingdom and went to the other three kingdoms, taking the three princesses with him.
Huangfu Ziqian, Qiang Yin, and Zhu Jing looked at Zhang Fei [5] with puzzled looks, mainly because of his age and cultivation.
"How can you age so fast?"
"Has your cultivation surpassed our parents?"
"The last time we met you was four months ago, right?"

The three princesses asked in unison, which amused Zhang Fei [5]. "I age much faster because I went to a higher realm called the Paradise Realm, and my cultivation has already surpassed the Seven Divine Realms after being cultivated for more than two decades."
"Two... two decades!" The three princesses were stunned in shock, especially since their last meeting was four months ago according to their time.

Zhang Fei [5] shared various details with them, which left the princesses dumbfounded for quite a while. "I will be bringing my in-laws with me, and my father-in-law will hand over the Wei Kingdom to his second brother. Therefore, I hope the three of you can help me manage my shop there, and my subordinates will occasionally come to replenish the stock in all the shops."
"Why don’t you offer us to go with you?" Zhu Jing spoke with a tone of jealousy.
Qiang Yin was also jealous. "We’ve known each other and worked together for quite some time, but you only brought Wei Xiaoya with you."

Unlike them, Huangfu Ziqian didn’t say anything, especially since he was no different from Zhang Fei [5]’s slave, even though he never enslaved her. Despite this, she hoped in her heart that he would offer her to go with him to the Paradise Realm.

"Do you guys want to go there?" The three princesses looked eager and hesitant when Zhang Fei [5] asked that. "I can take you three there, but you have to think it through first. All of you hold high statuses and live comfortably in this realm, but you will be ordinary people there. Moreover, the cultivators there are far stronger than you, and you won’t be able to go anywhere until you break through to the Five Celestial Realms. Even after reaching that stage, you won’t necessarily be able to travel freely because you don’t have backers there, and I can’t possibly protect you all the time. Additionally, I don’t get along with your three families, so I won’t take them there, and you’ll have to leave them."

Although they wanted to go to the Paradise Realm, the three princesses were too comfortable with their lives and statuses in their home realm, which made it difficult for them to live new lives as ordinary people. In the end, they chose to give up, preferring to stay in their realm and live their lives as usual.

After discussing some matters, Zhang Fei [5] sent the three princesses back to their respective kingdoms. He then went to the Jiang Kingdom to meet Ling Yingfei and Jiang Bai, but he didn’t spend much time there, and he left again after finishing his conversation with them.
Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the Demon Purgatory Realm, but Serpentera and Tian Kui suddenly appeared in front of him. "I already expected you two to be here."
"Haha." Tian Kui laughed as he patted Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulder. "Great job, kid! You have reached the Five Celestial Realms according to our original estimation."
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "You two estimated that I would break through to this stage in five years, but in fact, it took me 20 years to reach it."

"That’s because you took too many cultivation paths at once." Serpentera then touched Zhang Fei [5]’s other shoulder. "Kid, we haven’t told you about this matter, but we decided this a long time ago. Since you have reached the Five Celestial Realms, we will make a contract with you."
"What—"

"Please don’t reject us, kid." Tian Kui spoke with a low sigh. "We are both the last of our races, remember? Even though two of your wives have inherited our bloodlines, they are two different races."

Serpentera then spoke. "Back then, my master asked me to choose a new master if I managed to find the right person to become one, and I believe you are the one. We are still stronger than you now, but we believe you will surpass us. No! You will surpass all cultivators in this universe, including the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon Emperor. Therefore, we have decided to become your beast contracts, and we will be your strength to face the obstacles that will come your way in the future."
"But—"

"Alright! This is not a discussion!" Tian Kui and Serpentera immediately restricted Zhang Fei [5]’s movement. "We have decided this with mature thought, and we will be your strength from today onward."

After that, Tian Kui and Serpentera took turns making contracts with Zhang Fei [5], leaving him helpless. In a few minutes, the contract between them was formed, and the two ancient beasts officially became his beast contracts. "Master."
"Sigh." Zhang Fei [5] let out a soft sigh before cupping his hands to them. "Old Kui! Old Snake! Thank you for your trust in me."
"Hahaha!" Tian Kui laughed at that. "We’ve known each other for a while, and you’re our master now, so drop the formalities."
"So, what are your plans now?" Serpentera asked.

Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly explained his plans regarding the Moonlit Passion Sect and several others, surprising both Tian Kui and Serpentera. They didn’t expect that he had gone that far, and he even managed to get one of the supreme sects in the Paradise Realm in his grasp. "I will take you two there, and I hope you two can help me protect it for now."

"You are our master now, so we will help you to protect your sect." Tian Kui and Serpentera answered in unison. "However, we must keep our identities hidden from the public, or the situation will turn dire if those four evil beasts learn of our return, and they will attack your sect with full force to capture us."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "You two don’t need to think too much about it, and I will use my body modification ability on you two later. This way, no one will recognize your true identities, and the situation will definitely be under control."
"We will follow your plan."
Serpentera then turned Zhang Fei [5] to the palace. "We haven’t found a solution to Wang Yin’s situation, and she kept waiting for you for the past few months, so you should go see her now."
"I’ll go see Wang Yin now."
"Wait a minute." Tian Kui suddenly stopped him. "I think you should go to the Abyssal Realm after this, as there are changes in that realm that might benefit you."

Huangfu Ziqian, Qiang Yin, and Zhu Jing looked at Zhang Fei [5] with puzzled looks, mainly because of his age and cultivation.
"How can you age so fast?"
"Has your cultivation surpassed our parents?"
"The last time we met you was four months ago, right?"
The three princesses asked in unison, which amused Zhang Fei [5].
"I age much faster because I went to a higher realm called the Paradise Realm, and my cultivation has already surpassed the Seven Divine Realms after being cultivated for more than two decades."
"Two... two decades!" The three princesses were stunned in shock, especially since their last meeting was four months ago according to their time.
Zhang Fei [5] shared various details with them, which left the princesses dumbfounded for quite a while.
"I will be bringing my in-laws with me, and my father-in-law will hand over the Wei Kingdom to his second brother.
Therefore, I hope the three of you can help me manage my shop there, and my subordinates will occasionally come to replenish the stock in all the shops."
"Why don’t you offer us to go with you?" Zhu Jing spoke with a tone of jealousy.

"We’ve known each other and worked together for quite some time, but you only brought Wei Xiaoya with you."

"Do you guys want to go there?" The three princesses looked eager and hesitant when Zhang Fei [5] asked that.

paragraphs: [Ding]
[Additional Quest: Kill 9 soul wraiths.]
