A notification appeared in Zhang Fei’s [5] mind as soon as they arrived at the Abyssal Realm. However, the atmosphere was extremely tense, with eerie screams ringing out from all corners, and the temperature dropped dramatically.

"What exactly happened in this realm, Fei? Why has it become like this?" Wang Yin looked around the realm in confusion, but she trembled when she sensed a chilling and deadly aura coming from several directions.
Zhang Fei [5] summoned Feng Yichen out of the training space. "The situation in this realm happened because of the Nine Yin Soul Banner, Master."

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "According to Old Kui, the Nine Yin Soul Banner broke free from the control of the demon emperor of this realm, and the nine soul wraiths within it turned against them."
"Here one of them comes."
Zhang Fei [5] summoned the demon extermination sword, channeled his light element into it, and slashed it toward the soul wraith. "Dust Slash!"
*Shriek*
The soul wraith let out an eerie shriek after Zhang Fei [5]’s slash split its body, but its body fused again and flew even faster towards them.
"Master."
Zhang Fei [5] slashed his sword again, but he didn’t use his light element; instead, he imbued the Eternal Flame into his attack.
*Shriek*
The soul wraith shrieked in pain as the Eternal Flame burned its two halves, split in two by Zhang Fei [5]’s attacks, and the result was as expected, as it was instantly burned to nothing.
"The Eternal Flame is truly too terrifying, Master. It can incinerate anything, including souls." Feng Yichen spoke as she hugged her trembling body, imagining the flames hitting her.
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] then tried to find the other eight soul wraiths, finding them scattered across several areas quite far away and disturbing cities in those areas.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Morgana, Oz the First, the demon emperor, and several demon elders suddenly appeared in front of them.

The demon emperor and his subordinates frowned as soon as they saw Feng Yichen, especially since she once helped Xereth to attack their realm. However, none of them dared to attack her, mainly because her aura was much stronger than any of them.
Unlike them, Morgana and Oz the First were shocked once they sensed that Zhang Fei [5] had become much stronger than them.

"I’ve gone to the realm beyond before, and I spent more than two decades in seclusion." Morgana and Oz the First nodded in understanding to Zhang Fei [5]. "After I take care of those soul wraiths, I will take you two to that realm."
After saying that, Zhang Fei [5] disappeared from their sight and went to bury the rest of the soul wraiths.
"Where is the Nine Yin Soul Banner?" Feng Yichen asked the demon emperor and the others. "Hand it over to me now."
"We—"

Morgana stopped the demon emperor. "Just hand the banner to her, Emperor. The banner once belonged to the Heavenly Fiend Demon God, who was a demon from the realm beyond and much stronger than Xereth. The banner suddenly turning against you might have something to do with him, and we’ll be in danger if he descends to this realm."
"Over there." The demon emperor pointed in one direction. "I kept the banner there, but I couldn’t approach it anymore after it turned against me, and the area was covered by a strange barrier."
"Hmm?" Feng Yichen looked in that direction and found the Nine Yin Soul Banner there, but she did not immediately go there because she sensed something strange from it.
"Why do I feel like you are not your usual self?" Morgana asked Wang Yin after observing her behavior.

Wang Yin shook her head in response. "Nothing happened to me, and I’m fine as usual. I just miss Zhang Fei because we haven’t seen each other for a long time, and I’ll be going to that realm with him after this."

"Hmm?" Morgana raised an eyebrow upon hearing that, especially since she remembered for sure that Zhang Fei [5] and Wang Yin didn’t have such a relationship before, and their relationship was nothing more than friends back then.

On the other hand, Oz the First followed Zhang Fei [5]’s movement in circling the realm and killing those soul wraiths. "The last time we met him was over a year ago, and he has already surpassed all the cultivators in the Three Mortal Realms. Moreover, his flame is truly peculiar, and it burns them without a trace."
"That’s true." Morgana then asked Feng Yichen. "How can his progress be so fast? What did he mean before by doing seclusion for more than two decades?"

"You’ve trained in his training place before, right?" Morgana nodded at Feng Yichen. "The flow of time in there has become four times faster after he ascended to the Paradise Realm, and the flow of time in that realm is also much faster than here. Moreover, we no longer cultivate using Divine Qi but Celestial Qi, but I won’t explain it in detail to you, and you can experience it for yourself when he takes you two there."

Morgana nodded in understanding before turning to the demon emperor and the others. "Apparently, it’s time for us to part ways; my husband and I will follow Zhang Fei [5] to that realm. If you all want to go to that realm, you can try challenging the Dark Tower in the Dark Moon Realm. If you succeed in reaching the top of that tower, you can ascend to that realm."

The demon emperor and his subordinates could understand that, especially since they did not have any relationship with Zhang Fei [5]. "The Dark Tower in the Dark Moon Realm, right? We will try to challenge that tower and ascend to the Paradise Realm, and we will meet again in the future."
"I hope so." Morgana nodded slightly.

*Shriek*

The notification appeared along with the shriek of the last soul wraith, which quickly disappeared after being burned by Zhang Fei [5]’s Eternal Flame. Without the flame, he wouldn’t have managed to eliminate them so quickly, especially since his light element was ineffective against them.
*Swoosh*

Feng Yichen brought Wang Yin, Morgana, and Oz the First to Zhang Fei [5]’s side directly. She then pointed toward the location of the Nine Yin Soul Banner. "The banner is there, Master. However, I’m not sure we can get through the barrier that covers it, especially since it’s stronger than both of us."
"Let’s check it first."
They had arrived at the location of the Nine Yin Soul Banner, but a black barrier covered the area. Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his demon form and touched it, but it knocked him back.

[Master, the strength of this barrier is equivalent to the strength of Qi Qingxiu, Nalan Shizhe, and Ye Mingran. If you force yourself to breach it, you will definitely suffer serious injuries, so you should not do it.]
Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. ’How can this barrier activate suddenly? Could it be that the Heavenly Fiend Demon God activated it?’

[Master, this Nine Yin Soul Banner has been in the Three Mortal Realms for a long time, so I think your guess is wrong. If the Heavenly Fiend Demon God activated it remotely, he should have done it a long time ago, and he didn’t need to wait until today.]
While Zhang Fei [5] and Mei were discussing, Wang Yin’s eyes suddenly turned blank, and she directly jumped into the barrier, shocking everyone.

"Yin’er!" Zhang Fei [5] shouted out to her, but Wang Yin didn’t turn around or reply to him, and she walked toward the Nine Yin Soul Banner. He tried to attack the barrier, but it knocked him back once again, stronger than before. "Shit!"
"What happened, Master? How did she manage to enter this barrier?" Feng Yichen asked, touching the barrier before being knocked back.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at her. "I’m sure it wasn’t Wang Yin who did it, but the mysterious woman who controlled her."
"Is that true, Zhang Fei? Is she really under a woman’s control?" Morgana asked in panic, especially since Wang Yin was her old friend.

"Look." They immediately looked at the shadow of the woman pointed at by Zhang Fei [5]. "That woman came from the Ancient Nether Clan, and her name was Yuan Xiajie. She has controlled Wang Yin for a long time, and the change in her character also occurred because of her, as she deliberately manipulated her memories."

’How did this kid learn about my identity? That phoenix woman does know my race, but she shouldn’t know my name.’ Yuan Xiajie looked at Zhang Fei [5], but he couldn’t see her shocked expression because she was wearing a mask. ’Fortunately, she is a corpse demon; otherwise, she wouldn’t be able to take this banner in a situation like this.’

Yuan Xiajie then ordered Wang Yin to take the Nine Yin Soul Banner before storing it in a special container, causing the barrier to slowly disappear. She looked at Zhang Fei [5] for a moment before taking the female corpse demon away from that realm.
"Fuck!" Zhang Fei [5] cursed after the two had disappeared. "What is that damn woman’s real purpose? Why did she take Wang Yin away with her?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1163: Return To The Sect
paragraphs: "What should we do now, Zhang Fei?"

"Nothing." Zhang Fei [5] answered Morgana with a shake of his head. "Yuan Xiajie is a member of the Ancient Nether Clan, and the ancient clan is far stronger than the cultivators in the Paradise Realm. None of us can fight her, including my acquaintances from that realm."

"Once you arrive at the Paradise Realm, you two will realize the difference in cultivator strength between the two realms. We previously met two people from the Ancient Clans, and one of them slaughtered hundreds of thousands of demons and beasts who had reached the Five Celestial Realms in a matter of seconds." Feng Yichen, who then asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Do you still have business in the Three Mortal Realms, Master?"
"I still have to meet a few more people, and I’ll return to the sect after that." Zhang Fei [5] then opened the gate to the Moonlit Passion Sect. "Bring Morgana and Oz there first, Yichen."
After the three disappeared, Zhang Fei [5] immediately went to the Red Sun Realm to meet Miao Miao, whom he had sent there some time ago.

The demon emperor and his subordinates appeared at that location, and they sighed heavily because of the Nine Yin Soul Banner. Moreover, they had overheard Zhang Fei [5] and the others’ conversation earlier, and he asked his subordinates to prepare to head to the Dark Tower in the Dark Moon Realm.
Upon arrival at the Red Sun Realm, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Miao Clan, but not all members of the clan were enthusiastic about going to the Paradise Realm, even though Miao Miao had persuaded them.

In the end, Zhang Fei [5] only sent Miao Miao and her main family to his training space. He then went to the Zhang Clan in that realm, and he also sent some people there, such as Shang Xinyu’s parents, Mai Yuzhen, and members of the Lunar Shadow Cat race.

Zhang Fei [5] then went to the Xi Clan before summoning Xi Hongyan and Xi Wuhei, but they didn’t spend much time there due to their small number of members, and he sent them to his training space directly.
As for the remaining members of the Hong and Jin Clans, they chose to remain in the realm, and Zhang Fei [5] didn’t force them to leave.

Zhang Fei [5] took Balena to visit her parents in the Blue Water Realm, but they were still stuck on their decision to stay in their home realm. Then, he went to the Shandian Realm to meet Feng Xishui, who resided there and sent him to his training space.

Zhang Fei [5] went to the middle realm, and his first destination was the Shrouded Sky Realm. Since he needed more alchemists, he sent Huoyun Zhiyan, Sun Jianming, and Xiu Hanyu, to his training space. He did not forget Luo Xuejia, who had been helping him handle the alchemy union.

Zhang Fei [5] then visited the Divine Flames Realm, but Jiang Shen and Wan Xueyuan declined his offer to go to the Paradise Realm. They felt they were too old and no longer able to adapt to the harsher life of cultivators.

Zhang Fei [5] did not visit the Netherworld Realm, the Wasteland Realm, or the Blossom Heaven Realm. He went directly to the Nine Stars Realm, and he brought several people there, such as Long Huang and Long Baiyun, who had previously lived on Sky Dragon Island. He also brought Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling back, and he asked them to prepare the natural races from that realm.

Zhang Fei [5] sent Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua to the Yun Kingdom, especially since his brother-in-law was still the emperor of that kingdom. He wanted to bring Yun Aotian and Li Yao to join them in the Paradise Realm, so he asked his parents-in-law to help them sort things out.

Zhang Fei [5] left them there and went to the Bai Kingdom, but he did not meet the Bai Royal family. Instead, he went to the Han Clan and brought Han Yuanzhi to her clan, asking her to arrange for her Han Clan’s move to the Paradise Realm.

Zhang Fei [5] did not go to the Huangfu and Zhou Kingdoms; Instead, he ordered his slaves to take care of them and his shops on the artificial island. He then went to his residence in that realm, especially since he had left Polypus there for several years.
Zhang Fei [5] found Polypus in the sea behind the residence, and he immediately met him there. "Big Brother! I thought you had forgotten me!"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed as he hugged him. "I’m sorry; I’ve left you in this realm for too long. I won’t leave you again, and I will take you away to the Paradise Realm after this."
"The Paradise Realm?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "That realm is beyond the Three Mortal Realms, and you’ll meet many more people there later."
"Have Big Sis Lingxue and the others also gone to that realm?"

"They’re still in my personal space now, but they’ll be moving there soon." After that, Zhang Fei [5] sent Polypus to the beast space, but he was frightened by the many powerful beasts there; that was also the reason he had never brought the beast with him before.
Since Yun Shang and the others still needed time to arrange the transfer of their members to the Paradise Realm, Zhang Fei [5] decided to return to the Sky Jade Realm.

Since the Chu, Ye, Zhang, and Chang Clans had lived with him for a long time, Zhang Fei [5] did not go to the central and western regions. He visited the Desolate Sect to meet Jinshu Gang, especially since Shi Xi missed the old man.

Zhang Fei [5] and Shi Xi didn’t stay there for long, and he sent her back to the training space before going to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, which had changed quite a lot after his last visit.

Zhang Fei [5]’s last stop was the Hidden Sea Palace, and he immediately barged into the sect, shocking the disciples. His goal is Hai Yuzhen and the core disciples of that sect.
"The Paradise Realm?"

Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained a few things to Hai Yuzhen. "Hai Dongxin and Hai Dongyin have already reached the middle stage of the Seven Divine Realms, and Chu Xing is almost at the Five Celestial Realms. Everyone hopes that you will join them in the Paradise Realm, and if you prefer not to go alone, I will take your entire sect with us, and all of you will be part of my sect."

"I haven’t even broken through to the Seven Divine Realms, but you’re already telling me about the Five Celestial Realms and the Paradise Realm." Han Yuzhen massaged her forehead. "Is your sect a dual cultivation sect?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] answered with a nod. "However, you don’t need to worry about that because I have started rebuilding it, and I will turn it into a universal one. If you are willing to accept my offer, you can prepare them from now on, and I will come back here later to pick you all up."

Hai Yuzhen thought about Zhang Fei [5]’s offer seriously for some time before coming to a decision. "Alright, I accept your offer. I’ll ask my disciples to pack right now, but it might take a few days."
"Don’t worry, you guys can pack at ease."

After Zhang Fei [5] left, Hai Yuzhen immediately went to the elders and disciples, informing them of her decision. All of them were shocked after hearing about the Five Celestial Realms and the Paradise Realm, but they were also enthusiastic about going to that realm.
When Zhang Fei [5] returned to the Moonlit Passion Sect, You Feiling had already gathered the elders in the main hall. "Do you guys have any other abilities besides dual cultivation?"
"In addition to dual cultivators, we are also sword masters, but our swordsmanship is not as skilled as yours." Hua Xiang answered as she pointed to the other two, Mei Ruyan and Yin Huayan.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "In that case, I want the three of you to deepen your understanding of swordsmanship from Old Han. He is a god-rank sword master like me, and he is a good teacher."
"We’ll meet him after this." The three women immediately agreed.
Zhang Fei [5] looked at the others. "What other abilities do you have besides dual cultivation?"
"Elder Ling Yao and I are healers." Yue Xi answered him.
Ling Yao nodded at him. "The two of us usually take care of the medical hall, but our healing abilities are still limited."

Zhang Fei [5] looked at the two of them for a while. "Before you two go to rest each day, I want you to learn healing techniques from Elmyra. Although her cultivation is still low, she has saved me many times, so I dare say her techniques are excellent. Additionally, I will bring two expert healers from the Three Mortal Realms soon, so we can treat injured or sick disciples more quickly."
"Yes."

chapters.title: Chapter 1164: Nine Cycles Vitality Pill
paragraphs: "I was interested in alchemy since I was a child, but my abilities never developed, and I decided to become a dual cultivator."

Zhang Fei [5] directly observed Han Yueqin and found that her affinity with the fire element was good. However, he sensed that his Fire Qi was untamed, making it difficult for her to control it, especially in alchemy. "Since you’re interested in alchemy, you can learn it directly from Lin Jingxia, but the first thing you must learn is to control your Fire Qi. Alchemists need extraordinary control over fire because each herb requires different heat, and they will be wasted if the heat is too low or too strong."
"Can you show me how to do it?"
Zhang Fei [5] opened his palm, and several small flames leapt out of it. He adjusted their strength; one looked weak and not hot, while the other looked strong and extremely hot.
Not only did Han Yueqin’s jaws drop after seeing the many flames of varying intensity, but You Feiling and the other elders also showed the same reaction as her.

Han Yueqin tried to imitate Zhang Fei [5] by releasing some flames, but her control over them was too weak. Every time she lowered the intensity, they weakened, and when she increased the intensity, they simultaneously strengthened. "How can you control each of your flames using different intensities?"

"Practice non-stop, of course." Han Yueqin pursed her lips after Zhang Fei [5] said that. "I’m not lying, okay? To become a skilled alchemist, you must practice fire control, and you can reach this stage with tireless practice. To make it easier, you must understand the flame dao."
"Flame... flame dao." Han Yueqin stuttered. "Have you truly comprehended the Flame Dao?"

"Fire destroys, fire purifies, and fire rebirths. Where my flame walks, all falsehood turns to ash. My flame burns away the heavens, igniting eternity. My flame dao is unyielding, eternal, and all-consuming." Han Yueqin fell into a daze when Zhang Fei [5] uttered these words. "Heaven gives birth to materials, Earth nurtures them, and Man refines them! Alchemy is not just about concocting pills, and it is a miracle from the heavens. My flame can burn anything, but it can also create anything! This is my Dao of alchemy!"
Upon hearing that, You Feiling, Han Yueqin, and the other elders muttered the same words as what Zhang Fei [5] said just now.

Zhang Fei [5] then stood up from his seat and activated his flame domain, shocking them. "You already know that I am a god-rank alchemist, but you have never seen me concoct pills, so I will show you now."

Zhang Fei [5] took out five types of herbs, controlled them with his Qi, and started preparing all of them at once. Everyone’s eyes widened when they saw that, especially Han Yueqin. None of them made a sound, and their eyes focused on watching him do all that.
In a few minutes, all the herbs had been separated into leaves, stems, and roots. Zhang Fei [5] began extracting their essences, and he once again did everything at the same time.

As he had demonstrated before, Zhang Fei [5] used varying heat intensities to process each herb, and his fire control did not waver in the slightest. Once he finished extracting their essence, he immediately moved on to the next step.

’Is he really going to use his flame domain as the furnace? Is it possible to do such a thing in concocting pills?’ They wondered in their minds, especially since they only knew that alchemy had to be done using an alchemy furnace.

Once everything was ready, Zhang Fei [5] began to combine all the ingredients together to form the pills. His expression was so calm when doing all that, especially with his long experience as an alchemist.

Two hours later, everyone was left stunned as five superior-grade blue pills floated before their eyes. Zhang Fei [5] extinguished his flame, dispelled his domain, and grabbed the pills. "Rank 10 Nine Cycles Vitality Pill! Whoever swallows one of these pills will be able to dual cultivate for a whole day without the slightest fatigue, whether they are male or female. However, they must swallow a Qi restoration pill because this pill will not stop orgasms, and each person’s orgasm varies depending on their body’s sensitivity, or else they will die from Qi depletion."

All of them were drooling after hearing the effects of the pill, especially the five male elders. You Feiling immediately approached Zhang Fei [5] and took a pill from his hand. "Did you give this pill to my big sis when you two were dual cultivating yesterday?"

"I got the pill recipe a long time ago, but I only concocted it today, and I used another method to make Qiu’er last longer." Zhang Fei [5] then threw the other four pills to the four male elders, but one of them looked jealous that he didn’t get one, so You Feiling gave him the pill in her hand. "I will concoct more pills later, and we will sell them in the treasure hall for the disciples. However, I will not sell them using sect points, and they have to buy them by exchanging equivalent goods. As for the price, I don’t understand the alchemy market in this realm yet, so you guys will determine the price."

You Feiling pointed at Bai Qinghe. "He has been in charge of the treasure hall all this time, but he often finds it difficult to handle the disciples. You can put someone there to help him, and they will determine the price."
"Alright, I will choose one of my people to help him." Zhang Fei [5] then asked them. "Are any of you interested in anything other than dual cultivation?"
"We are interested in formation arrays." Shui Qianrou, Xue Ling, and Rong Yuchen raised their hands.
Lan Qingyan immediately told him. "I want to learn about blacksmithing."
"I choose artifact crafter." Ying Hanli said.
"I’m more interested in knowledge for creating new techniques." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Qiu Yue in surprise. "Since Shang Ziyuan is skilled in that, I’ll learn from her."

"Alright, I will tell Ziyuan about it." Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to those who wanted to learn arrays, blacksmithing, and artifact crafting. "Elder Qianrou, the three of you can meet Luolan after the construction is complete, and she will guide you three in formation arrays. Elder Hanli, you can learn from Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji about artifact crafting, especially since they are experts in that field. Elder Qingyan, you can learn from Ji Changlan about blacksmithing, and I will also teach you privately about that."
"Yes." All of them nodded to Zhang Fei [5], but Lan Qingyan was a little awkward, especially since he had expressed his interest in her from the start.
"What about you, Elder Yuefeng and Elder Roulan?" Zhang Fei [5] asked the two remaining elders.

Chen Yuefeng thought for a moment and considered his options. "Elder Zhang, I think I will join the puppetry hall later. Actually, I’m also interested in becoming a domain master, but I’m not sure I can learn both at once, so I chose the puppetry first."

"Not everyone is capable of learning so many things at once. Since you’ve chosen puppetry, you can learn from my senior brother and Miao Miao later." Zhang Fei [5] then asked Fang Roulan. "What about you? Is there anything that interests you?"

Fang Roulan shook her head with a bitter smile. "Elder Zhang, I am the most careless and clumsy among all the elders, so I don’t have the confidence to learn any of it. Actually, I am also a soul cultivator, but my carelessness often injures my partners, so I hesitate to continue walking the soul cultivation path."

Upon hearing that, Zhang Fei looked at the five male elders, who responded with bitter laughs. "Elder Zhang, all of us had dual-soul cultivated with Elder Fang before, but she always got out of control, and our souls were repeatedly injured because of her. Since then, we never did it with her again, or we would really die."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] then walked away. "Follow me, Elder Ruolan."
Fang Roulan was stunned to hear this, but You Feiling pushed her forward. "Go, follow him."
"Okay." Fang Roulan hurriedly followed Zhang Fei [5].
"Are you sure Elder Zhang won’t have any problems if he dual-soul cultivates with her, Sister Feiling?" Xue Ling asked.

You Feiling shrugged her shoulders, indicating that she didn’t know the answer. "Since Zhang Fei [5] decided to deal with Fan Roulan, I think he has a solution to help her, so we just need to wait for the results. Since our discussion is over, we should join the others to continue opening those areas."
"Who exactly are those people Elder Zhang sent to our sect?" Qiu Yue asked, walking side by side, leaving the main hall.

"They are people from the Phoenix Race." All of them stopped walking and stared at You Feiling in shock. "You guys don’t know about this yet, but Zhang Fei [5] is actually a mythical beast, a nine-tailed fox beast to be exact. Additionally, he is the son-in-law of the phoenix race, so he brought them all here."
"What?" They shouted. "Are you serious about that? Why can’t we sense his beast aura?"
"Alright, don’t ask too many questions, and you will get to know him better in the future." You hurriedly left them and headed down the mountain.

"We are interested in formation arrays." Shui Qianrou, Xue Ling, and Rong Yuchen raised their hands.
Lan Qingyan immediately told him.
"I want to learn about blacksmithing."
"I choose artifact crafter." Ying Hanli said.
"I’m more interested in knowledge for creating new techniques." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Qiu Yue in surprise.
"Since Shang Ziyuan is skilled in that, I’ll learn from her."
"Alright, I will tell Ziyuan about it." Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to those who wanted to learn arrays, blacksmithing, and artifact crafting.
"Elder Qianrou, the three of you can meet Luolan after the construction is complete, and she will guide you three in formation arrays.
Elder Hanli, you can learn from Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji about artifact crafting, especially since they are experts in that field.
Elder Qingyan, you can learn from Ji Changlan about blacksmithing, and I will also teach you privately about that."
"Yes." All of them nodded to Zhang Fei [5], but Lan Qingyan was a little awkward, especially since he had expressed his interest in her from the start.
"What about you, Elder Yuefeng and Elder Roulan?" Zhang Fei [5] asked the two remaining elders.
Chen Yuefeng thought for a moment and considered his options.
"Elder Zhang, I think I will join the puppetry hall later.
Actually, I’m also interested in becoming a domain master, but I’m not sure I can learn both at once, so I chose the puppetry first."
"Not everyone is capable of learning so many things at once.
Since you’ve chosen puppetry, you can learn from my senior brother and Miao Miao later." Zhang Fei [5] then asked Fang Roulan.
"What about you?
Is there anything that interests you?"
Fang Roulan shook her head with a bitter smile.
"Elder Zhang, I am the most careless and clumsy among all the elders, so I don’t have the confidence to learn any of it.
Actually, I am also a soul cultivator, but my carelessness often injures my partners, so I hesitate to continue walking the soul cultivation path."
Upon hearing that, Zhang Fei looked at the five male elders, who responded with bitter laughs.
"Elder Zhang, all of us had dual-soul cultivated with Elder Fang before, but she always got out of control, and our souls were repeatedly injured because of her.
Since then, we never did it with her again, or we would really die."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] then walked away.
"Follow me, Elder Ruolan."
Fang Roulan was stunned to hear this, but You Feiling pushed her forward.
"Go, follow him."
"Okay." Fang Roulan hurriedly followed Zhang Fei [5].
"Are you sure Elder Zhang won’t have any problems if he dual-soul cultivates with her, Sister Feiling?" Xue Ling asked.
You Feiling shrugged her shoulders, indicating that she didn’t know the answer.
"Since Zhang Fei [5] decided to deal with Fan Roulan, I think he has a solution to help her, so we just need to wait for the results.
Since our discussion is over, we should join the others to continue opening those areas."
"Who exactly are those people Elder Zhang sent to our sect?" Qiu Yue asked, walking side by side, leaving the main hall.
"They are people from the Phoenix Race." All of them stopped walking and stared at You Feiling in shock.
"You guys don’t know about this yet, but Zhang Fei [5] is actually a mythical beast, a nine-tailed fox beast to be exact.
Additionally, he is the son-in-law of the phoenix race, so he brought them all here."
"What?" They shouted.
"Are you serious about that?
Why can’t we sense his beast aura?"
"Alright, don’t ask too many questions, and you will get to know him better in the future." You hurriedly left them and headed down the mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1165: Four Sect Masters
paragraphs: "Why did you bring me here, Elder Zhang?" Fang Roulan asked with a puzzled look when they arrived at the Celestial Lake.

"I will help you control your Yin Qi while dual-soul cultivating, so you won’t harm your partners again." Zhang Fei [5] pulled Fang Roulan onto the lake, where the two sat facing each other, their bodies floating just above the water’s surface. "Release your soul."

Fang Roulan was dumbfounded as soon as Zhang Fei [5] released his soul, mainly because of the giant white lotus inside. After reaching the divine soul level, his soul was no longer small and was several times bigger than hers. "How did your white lotus become this big, Elder Zhang?"

"Before I met Qiu’er, I already had more than a hundred white lotuses, and she merged them into one." Fang Roulan stared at Zhang Fei [5] in a daze, especially since each lotus symbolized the bond with his partner. "You’re right, I have over a hundred wives, and their number will probably still increase in the future. Release your soul and absorb as much Yin Qi from this lake as you can, and then channel it all into my body and soul without restraint."
"What!?" Fang Roulan exclaimed in shock. "Elder Zhang, I am having difficulty controlling my Yin Qi, and your soul will—"

"It’s okay." Fang Roulan hesitated to do that, forcing Zhang Fei [5] to explain to her. "Another man might get injured if he gets too much of your Yin Qi and it gets out of control, but I’m used to dual-soul cultivating with several of my wives at once, and some of them have excessive Yin Qi."
"Alright." Fang Roulan finally agreed and released her soul.
Zhang Fei [5] grabbed Fang Roulan’s hand, and his soul was the same as hers. "Start it, Elder Roulan."

"Yes." Fang Roulan closed her eyes and did so, but her Yin Qi went out of control as soon as she channeled it into Zhang Fei [5]’s body and soul. She tried to pull it back, but she suddenly sensed his Yang Qi flow into her body and soul, forcing her to abandon her intention.

With the help of Zhang Fei [5]’s Yang Qi, Fang Roulan’s Yin Qi gradually became more controllable, which confused and excited her. She absorbed the Yin Yi from the lake more quickly and channeled it into his body and soul at an increasing rate.

Sometime later, Fang Roulan’s Yin Qi had completely stabilized, allowing their Yang and Yin Qi to flow into each other with stable circulation. Once they reached balance, the Yin-Yang diagram began to appear beneath them, followed by white and black light shooting up into the sky, forming two pillars.
"Push your black lotus out of your soul." Zhang Fei [5] spoke as he pushed his white lotus out of his soul.

Fang Roulan pushed her black lotus out of her soul, but Zhang Fei [5]’s white lotus quickly enveloped it. In a few moments, the two fully merged and turned into a Yin-Yang lotus, causing the Yin-Yang diagram and pillars to light up even brighter.

Qing Qiu’er, who was previously sleeping due to exhaustion, suddenly appeared in the Celestial Lake. She smiled faintly when she noticed that Fang Roulan’s Yin Qi was fully stable. She floated behind Zhang Fei [5], sat there, and released her soul. ’Can I join you two?’
’Do it.’ Unlike Fang Roulan, who was completely focused on their dual-soul cultivating, Zhang Fei [5] was totally relaxed thanks to his habit of doing it with several of his wives at once.
Qing Qiu’er touched Zhang Fei [5]’s back, and her soul touched his. She absorbed the Yin Qi in the pool and channeled it to the two of them, which quickly blended with Fang Roulan’s Yin Qi.
Qing Qiu’er then pushed her black lotus out of her soul and merged it with Zhang Fei [5]’s white lotus, which made the Yin-Yang Diagram and pillars bigger and brighter.

Meanwhile, a middle-aged man and a middle-aged woman stood side by side on a balcony with their gazes focused on the black and white pillars that towered into the sky from the floating plateau. "Where did those two pillars come from, Chi Hongchen? Did Qing Qiu’er do something in her sect? Why have I never seen them before?"

The middle-aged woman has long, straight silver-gray hair with a streak of red running through the front, tied back neatly with a red band. Her face was well-defined with straight brows, large eyes, a small nose, and red lips. Her figure was slender, with a modest chest that matched her refined appearance. She wore layered robes in teal, white, and black tones.

The middle-aged man had long, dark hair and a trimmed beard. He wore a black robe with sun and moon accents. His posture was tall and a bit muscular, and his expression was overly serious as he looked in that direction. "I don’t know how Qing Qiu’er managed to do that, Guang Yue. However, those two pillars represent Yin-Yang, and she wouldn’t have been able to form them without a man’s help, which means she’s found her partner."

"Wouldn’t that make it even more difficult for us to reclaim the floating plateau from them, Hongchen?" Guang Yue looked at him. "Qing Qiu’er is already too strong with her Forbidden Lotus Codex, and she will be even stronger if she gets a partner."
Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue were the Sect Masters of the Sun Moon Sect, which was the strongest dual cultivation sect in the Twin Flames Domain, and the former owners of the floating plateau.

Chi Hongchen nodded at her. "You’re right about that, Yue. Actually, I’ve sent my distant nephew and niece to her sect to get the Forbidden Lotus Code, but unfortunately, they haven’t made it into the Core Disciples. Moreover, she didn’t teach that technique to the core disciples; instead, she only taught it to ten special disciples, so our chances of getting that technique are slim."
"The only way we can obtain that technique is through her ten special disciples, so—"

"No." Chi Hongchen cut off Guang Yue’s idea straight away. "Naturally, I have the same idea as you, but you have to remember that those ten people are not ordinary disciples, and their backgrounds are too strong even for us. If their clan finds out we did something to them, their ancestors will come here to attack us, and we won’t be able to handle them all."

"Sect Masters." Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue turned to the young man who had just arrived. "Some of our disciples are in Blossom City right now, and they heard that the Moonlit Passion Temple is rebuilding their sect. According to the news, Qing Qiu’er is going to transform her sect into a universal one, and they have already recruited many people to join them. Additionally, our disciples also heard about a new elder of the sect named Zhang Fei [5], but I find it strange because he is still in his forties, and his cultivation is in the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm."
"An elder in his early forties with a cultivation at the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm?" Both Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue were shocked to hear that.

Guang Yue turned to Chi Hongchen. "Has Qing Qiu’er gone crazy? Why did she appoint such a young and weak young man as an elder? Isn’t she afraid that the other elders will turn against her? Moreover, all the sects in this domain are dual cultivation sects, but she suddenly decided to change her sect to a universal one."

"I don’t have any idea about that." Chi Hongchen then looked at the two pillars in the distant sky. "If my guess is correct, that young elder is Qing Qiu’er’s new partner, and those two pillars are proof of that."
"Hmm?" Guang Yue also looked at the pillar. "How about we visit the Moonlit Passion Temple now to find out the truth of the news in person?"
Chi Hongchen nodded in agreement. "Let’s go there."
In another sect, a middle-aged man and a middle-aged woman dual cultivated on a bed while listening to a young woman, who reported several things to them, including news about Zhang Fei [5].

Before long, the two of them ended their dual cultivation session, and the middle-aged man immediately sat on the side of the bed, looking at the young woman. He has long black hair tied up in a topknot. He was quite handsome despite his age, and his muscular torso revealed muscles protruding from beneath his skin. "Are you sure about the news, Ru Xian?"

"Sect Master Ming Tianhe, I got the news from our disciple who was shopping in the Blossom City." Ru Xian then pointed towards the window. "If my guess is correct, Sect Master Qing and the new elder produced those two pillars."

Ming Tianhe, the sect master of the Blazing Union Sect, immediately moved towards the window. He looked at the location of the Moonlit Passion Sect. "Hmm? Yin-Yang Pillars, huh? Has Qing Qiu’er really found her partner?"
"Are you jealous, Tianhe?" The middle-aged woman asked with a seductive voice as she walked toward him.

The middle-aged woman has long, straight black hair tied into a high ponytail, with several strands left loose to frame her face. Her expression was sharp and striking, with thick eyebrows, red-tinted eyes, a straight nose, and red lips. Her figure was tall and slim yet athletic, with a well-toned build.

chapters.title: Chapter 1166: People Visit
paragraphs: "Why should I be jealous, Qiu Meixuan?" Ming Tianhe responded with a hint of coldness in his voice.

Qiu Meixuan hugged him from behind. "Your desire for Qing Qiu’er has long been no secret, and you’re infatuated with her. Unfortunately, she kept rejecting you for the past thousands of years, and she has already chosen her partner now."
Ming Tianhe said nothing; his gaze was solely focused on the far distance with both of his fists tightly clenched.
"How about we go to that sect now?" Qiu Meixuan slowly caressed his chest, feeling the muscles there. "I’m curious about their new recruits."
"Do you think I am unaware of your curiosity about their new elder?"

"Do you think I would be interested in such a young and weak cultivator like him?" Qiu Meixuan grabbed his dick and squeezed it. "I’ve never been dissatisfied with it, so you don’t have to worry about that."
Ming Tianhe frowned briefly before pushing her back. "Get dressed! We’re going there now!"

Sometime later, Chi Hongchen, Guang Yue, Ming Tianhe, and Qiu Meixuan were already at the outer perimeter of the Moonlit Passion Temple. However, the protective barrier of the sect stopped them. They don’t need to use the teleportation portal in the Blossom City to go to the Moonlit Passion Temple like other guests, but they can’t enter the sect at will.
"Did you come here because you were curious about the young elder, Sect Master Guang?" Qiu Meixuan asked Guang Yue, but her tone was sarcastic.
Guang Yue ignored her and gazed at the thousands of people working on the ground below the mountain, causing Qiu Meixuan to grumble to herself.
Meng Tianhe and the others tried to examine the area of the Celestial Lake, but none of them could do so because something was blocking their senses, confusing them.

Guang Yue was quite amazed to see many people working together in opening those areas, both old and new. However, the cultivation of the new recruits puzzled her. "Why did Qing Qiu’er recruit so many cultivators with cultivation only in the Seven Divine Realms, Hongchen?"

"Our sects’ reputation is too bad as dual cultivation sects, remember? Since Qing Qiu’er wants to make this sect universal, she has no choice but to lower her standards. Although this sect is still not as big as our sect, it is still one of the supreme sects in this realm." Chi Hongchen then pointed at the people from the phoenix race, who had never trained in Zhang Fei [5]’s training space before. "Judging from their predicament, they haven’t ascended to this realm for long, and they haven’t been able to adapt to the gravity."

"I agree with you, Hongchen." Meng Tianhe spoke, observing those people. "Where did Qing Qiu’er get these people? Did she go to the Three Mortal Realms without our prior knowledge? Moreover, all of them are not human cultivators but beast cultivators, and they are not ordinary beasts but mythical ones."
"Are you sure they are mythical beasts, Tianhe?" Qiu Meixuan asked in shock.

"I don’t know their race, but I’m sure they are mythical beasts." Meng Tianhe then pointed at Feng Zhen and Feng Xueying. "That man has a high affinity with the fire element, and the woman has a high affinity with the ice element. If my guess is correct, they are fire and ice phoenixes."
"Is it true?" Guang Yue asked her partner.

"I’ve met several people from the phoenix race in the past, so I’m sure they are indeed phoenixes. The man is a fire phoenix, and the woman is an ice phoenix." Chi Hongchen looked at other areas and found several other mythical beasts there. "All of them are also mythical beasts, and they come from different races. However, I don’t understand their reason for joining this sect, and they should have gone to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, especially since that domain is most suitable for beasts like them."
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

The five people looked at You Feiling, who had just appeared, accompanied by Serpentera and Tian Kui. Zhang Fei [5] had informed her that the two ancient beasts were his contract beasts, and they would be the protectors of their sect.

Chi Hongchen and Meng Tianhe frowned as they looked at Serpentera and Tian Kui; they could feel that the two ancient beasts were slightly stronger than them. ’Since when did this sect get such powerful beasts as their guardians? Did the new elder bring them to this sect? How could he subdue them with his cultivation still at the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm?’
"What brings you all to our sect today?" You Feiling asked from behind the barrier. "Oh, allow me to introduce our two new protectors, Mu (Serpentera) and Kui."
Guang Yue immediately asked her. "Can you let us in first?"

"Unfortunately, we are not accepting guests until the rebuilding is complete, Sect Master Guang." You Feiling replied with an apologetic look. "Once everything is complete, we will send invitations to all sects in this domain and other domains, and we will hold a banquet to celebrate the opening of our new sect. At that time, we will no longer be a dual cultivation sect, and we will fully operate as a universal sect."
"Does that mean you guys will change the name of this sect in the future?"

"We won’t, Sect Master Guang." You Feiling shook her head slightly. "Although we will become a universal sect, we will still keep the name of the Moonlit Passion Sect. In the process, we will separate disciples who wish to cultivate normally from those who wish to become dual cultivators, but we will not differentiate them in status, and all of them will be able to enjoy the same benefits."
"Hey, Feiling! Please tell us the reason you opened so many new areas."

You Feiling answered Qiu Meixuan directly. "Sect Master Qiu, we can’t rely on dual cultivation if we want to become a universal sect, right? Therefore, we’re opening new areas on this plateau to build new halls, such as the Sword Hall, Alchemy Hall, and many others. However, I won’t go into too much detail about all that today, and my big sister will explain everything at the banquet we’ll be holding in a few months. At that time, you will meet the people of this sect’s new formation, and everyone will get a lot of surprises then."
"Cheapskate!" Qiu Meixuan then turned to Ming Tianhe. "Since we can’t go in to take a look, we should return to our sect now, as I’m still not satisfied with our previous dual cultivation."
"Let’s go back." Meng Tianhe directly took her away from the sect.
On the other hand, Chi Hongchen asked You Feiling, "Did you two go to the Three Mortal Realms before and recruit these people?"

"Sect Master Chi, we have never descended into the Three Mortal Realms since we were born, and someone brought these people to us." Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue were curious about it, but You Feiling had no intention of saying anything to them. "We still have many things to do, so we’ll head back now, and you two can wait for our banquet invitation."

"Do you think she’s telling the truth, Hongchen?" Guang Yue asked as she looked at the areas of the sect. "Aren’t we going to stop them? If they become a universal sect and the body becomes stronger, they will probably surpass our sect, and we will never succeed in seizing this plateau from them."

"Are you still not aware of the strength of those two male beasts?" Guang Yue raised an eyebrow at Chi Hongchen. "I can’t recognize their beast identities, but I can feel that both of them are powerful, especially the one named Kui. Even so, I will never give up on reclaiming this floating plateau from them, but we are not evil cultivators, and we will use honorable means to do so."
Guan Yue released a heavy sigh. "Let’s go back and wait for their invitation, and we will know the identities of those new people at that time."
"Yeah."
Three hours later, Zhang Fei [5] and the two women had finished their dual-soul cultivation, causing the Yin-Yang Diagram and two pillars to disappear on their own.

Fang Roulan hurriedly opened her eyes and smiled with joy. "Amazing! I’ve never felt my Yin Qi so stable before, and we did it for three whole hours! How were you able to stabilize my Yin Qi, Elder Zhang?"

"I only used my Yang Qi to do it." Fang Roulan knew that, but she still couldn’t understand how Zhang Fei [5] could do it. "The dao of dual cultivation is to unite and balance the two different forces, Yin and Yang. True dual cultivators must resonate spiritually, not just physically, with their partners. Dual cultivation path is a mutual path; your gain and pain are mine, and we will grow together. Unlike you, I have long understood that, and I use my Yang Qi to bring your Yin Qi into stability."
"The dao of dual cultivation, huh?" Fang Roulan muttered under her breath, looking at Zhang Fei [5]. "Don’t tell me you’ve comprehended all the dao."

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Elder Roulan, there is not just one dao in this universe; there are countless of them, and even breathing has its own dao. I can teach you all about the Dao, but I cannot help you understand it, and everyone must try for themselves to understand the true dao."

"I agree with Sister Lian, husband." Zhao Ziqin and the women from the lower and middle realms also agreed with Ye Lian.

Zhang Fei nodded to them. "In that case, I will prepare an area specifically for us behind the mountain close to the Celestial Lake. This way, all of you can go back and forth between the two places more easily, and you won’t meet those male dual cultivators."

"Hahaha." Ma Kuangyu laughed at that. "Thank you for your help, Fenghan and Xiaoyi. If it weren’t for you two, we definitely wouldn’t have reshaped our bodies."

Luo Fenghan shook his head. "There’s no need for thanks between old friends, right? I don’t recommend you return to the Nirvana Sky Domain, especially since your cultivation hasn’t returned to its peak."
"I know." Ma Kuangyu then asked. "Where is Zhuang Qihong? What about my Ma Clan members? Do you have any information about the Spirit Temple?"

Luo Fenghan directly handed him some documents. "You can read all the information about the Spirit Temple in these documents. The Zhuang Clan lives in the eastern region, and Zhuang Qihong has brought some people from your Ma Clan there."
"Let’s go there, Fenghan."

Huang Xiaoyi explained to the two women all the events that occurred while they were away, including those in the Forbidden Land.
Nalan Yushu frowned when she heard about the appearance of the Soul-Devouring Demon God. "Does she know about my relationship with my master?"

"Zhang Fei did meet Nalan Shizhe, but she shouldn’t know about the relationship between the two of you." Nalan Yushu looked relieved after hearing that. "What are your plans now? Are you going back to your domain to meet your demon god?"
Nalan Yushu smiled bitterly. "My cultivation hasn’t returned, so I’ll focus on restoring my cultivation with my master’s help."

"Me too." Huli Yaohu was excited and looked forward to meeting Zhang Fei. In the past, they had often engaged in dual cultivation, but they did it using their souls; therefore, she wanted to meet him again soon.
Huang Xiaoyi nodded in understanding. "One of his clones is in the Moonlit Passion Sect, so you can ask him to pick you up."
Nalan Yushu immediately contacted Zhang Fei [5], and he arrived in front of them a few moments later. He hugged her and Huli Yaohu in turn. "Congratulations! You guys finally got your lives back."
"Hehe." Nalan Yushu giggled. "Master, please send me to your real body right now."
"Me too," Huli Yaohu spoke with anticipation.
Zhang Fei [5] turned to her directly. "Yaohu, I know you have an old grudge against Huli Xianniang because she destroyed your old body, but I hope you’re willing to forget that."

"I can create one, but some strong cultivators, who have a profound understanding of the void element, can still get through." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding to Bing Xinying.

"What about Zhe Wuming?

chapters.title: Chapter 1169: Pick Up His People
paragraphs: "Her cultivation has already reached the Five Celestial Realms, right?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Huli Yaohu, who immediately sighed. "I’m alive again, but my strength regressed a lot, and my current cultivation is at the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm. Even if I wanted to fight her, I wouldn’t be able to with my current strength."

Zhang Fei [5] pulled her into his embrace. "Your cultivation has indeed regressed a lot, but you’re no longer alone. You have me, Yumei, and the others, remember? With me by your side, your cultivation will return quickly, and I will help you break through to the Five Celestial Realms like the others."
"Yeah." Huli Yaohu nestled into his chest.
"Master, stop being lovey-dovey and send us to your real body now." Nalan Yushu protested.

Zhang Fei [5] sent the two women into the training space before handing several invitations to Huang Xiaoyi. "Mother-in-law, these are the invitations for the opening of the new Moonlit Passion Sect, and I would like to invite many clans and sects from many domains to attend the opening. I want to use this opportunity to improve our bad image, and I will demonstrate some things during the event to achieve that."
"For example?"
"Live performance of alchemy, blacksmithing, and other things."

Huang Xiaoyi nodded in understanding. "However, you and your sect will face a lot of trouble if you do that, and those greedy old cultivators will probably use any means to destroy you. Not to mention, there are some cultivators who are already targeting you, like the Fairy King, and he will give you a lot of trouble after that event."

"I’m aware of that, but I’ve decided on this, and I’ll carry it out soon." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer made Huang Xiaoyi inwardly sigh. "I understand your worries, but sister-in-law Xingying already helped me create a void barrier around the sect half a year ago. Not many cultivators can pass through it, especially since few cultivators have a profound understanding of the void element. Therefore, I believe that my sect will be fine, and we will become stronger in the process."
"Phew!" Huang Xiaoyi exhaled softly. "Alright, I’ll have some people send these invitations to the sects and clans in this domain, but I’m sure not all of them will attend your event."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "It’s okay; I can understand if they are unwilling to attend my events."
"By the way, Ma Kuangyu went to the Zhuang Clan with your father-in-law, and you can meet them there if you want to meet him." Huang Xiaoyi spoke to him as she summoned some people to meet her.

"I’ve contacted Old Ma and asked him to meet me at the sect after his business is finished." Zhang Fei [5] then summoned the other four clones of the training space before opening a few gates to go to several realms. "Mother-in-law, I will pick up the people from the Three Mortal Realms, and I will return directly to the sect afterward."
"Alright."
The five of them divided up the tasks of going to various realms, such as the Sovereign Heaven Realm, the Xianjin Realm, and several other realms, to pick up the people.

They didn’t send the people from the beast and natural races to the training space; instead, they sent them to the sect directly. They sent humans from the Sky Jade Realm and the Nine Stars Realm to the training space, especially since their physique was not as strong as beasts and natural races. Therefore, they wanted them to train first before sending them to the sect, or they would become a laughing stock.

Since the natural races from the Sovereign Heaven Realm had trained under Jin Zhongli’s gravity techniques before, they didn’t have much difficulty in the Paradise Realm, but those from the Nine Stars Realm had difficulty withstanding the gravity in the Paradise Realm.
The only one who decided to stay in the Nine Stars Realm was Aqua, especially since she didn’t want to leave the underwater city.

Zhang Fei [5] tried to go to the Demon Purgatory Realm, but he couldn’t find Wang Yin there. The demons living in her palace informed him that she had not returned since he took her away, making him sigh helplessly.
After all matters in the Three Mortal Realms were finished, Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to the Moonlit Passion Sect, and the other four clones returned to the pavilion in the training space.

Since the cultivation of the former disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect and the Yin-Yang Pavilion had reached the Seven Divine Realms, and they had also trained to level 4 of the gravity feature, one of the clones sent them to the Moonlit Passion Sect to join the sect.

Like their original cultivation path, the former disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect will join the universal section. Meanwhile, the former disciples of the Yin-Yang Pavilion joined the dual cultivation section.
"Sect Master! Senior Sisters." Chu Xing and Wei Luan ran over to Hai Yuzhen, Yue Lanxin, and the people from the Hidden Sea Palace, followed by Hai Dongxin and Hai Dongyin behind them.
Chu Xing and Wei Luan hugged each other in turn as they laughed with joy. "Hahaha! This way, we’ll all be together again, just like in the past!"
"You two are already much stronger than me, especially you, Xing’er." Hai Yuzhen softly spoke.
Yue Lanxin then asked them, "What cultivation level are you two at now?"
"Senior Sister, my cultivation is still at the 1-Moon Divine Transformation Realm." Wei Luan was the first to answer.

"Hehehe." Chu Xing giggled as she made a V-shaped gesture. "My cultivation has already reached the pinnacle of mortal cultivation, the Divine Ascension Realm. However, I still need some more time to break through to the Five Celestial Realms."

Hai Yuzhen and the others sighed, especially since their cultivation was still at the Ten Mortal Realms. They were still far from breaking through to the Seven Divine Realms, let alone the Five Divine Realms.
"What about you two, Dongxin and Dongyin?" Hai Yuzhen asked her two sisters.
Hai Dongxin answered her directly. "Big Sis, we have reached the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm now."

"Big Sis, your cultivation is still in the Ten Mortal Realms now, but you don’t need to worry about that." Hai Dongyin then explained to them everything in the training space, including the four times faster time flow compared to the outside world, leaving them all stunned. "Since we left with Zhang Fei that day, we’ve been cultivating for almost three decades. Even though we have reached this stage, our cultivation is still slower than Xing’er and his other wives."
Hai Yuzhen nodded in understanding. "After all, Xing’er is a dual cultivator like Zhang Fei, so it is natural that her cultivation surpasses the two of you."
"Yes." Both Hai Dongxin and Hai Dongyin nodded to her.

"Here." Chu Xing placed two storage rings into Hai Yuzhen’s hands. "There are many pills in both to support your cultivation, but the Qi in this place is the Celestial Qi, and you need a special method to absorb it. Therefore, we will help you with that first, and all of you will break through to the Seven Divine Realms in no time after you cultivate using it."
Hai Yuzhen nodded at her. "Zhang Fei has already told me about Celestial Qi, so please help us now, and we will begin our cultivation to catch up with you all."
"Let’s go to the Cloud Mansion first to choose your rooms, and we’ll teach you the method afterward." Chu Xing pulled Wei Luan along with her.
As they followed the two women, Hai Yuzhen asked her two sisters. "Has Wei Luan become Zhang Fei’s wife?"

"Not yet, Big Sis." Hai Dongxin explained it to her. "Luan’er had already loved Zhang Fei, and she cultivated using his Yang Qi. However, her relationship with her mother left a stumbling block in her heart, even though they have been together for almost three decades."
"I see." Hai Yuzhen still had many questions for them, but she couldn’t wait to change her Qi in her body into the Celestial Qi.
After they chose their rooms in the Cloud Mansion, Chu Xing, Wei Luan, and the Hai Twins immediately helped Hai Yuzhen and the others to convert their Qi into the Celestial Qi.
Shang Yumei and Huli Yaohu sat together in the main garden, but the latter repeatedly stole glances at Huli Xianniang, who was at a distance with the other women.

"Master, I’m glad that you’ve finally returned to my side and that you’re alive again." Shang Yumei sincerely spoke as she embraced Huli Yaohu. "I understand your feelings about Huli Xianniang, but you should forget that, especially since you both belong to our husband. He will not be happy if there is hostility among the members of his harem, especially since it will destroy the harmony that has existed for decades."
Huli Yaohu let out a soft sigh and nodded slightly. "I understand that, but my grudge against Huli Xianniang is too long-standing. I cannot simply forget it, and I need time to remove it."

"I know." Shang Yumei lifted her master to her feet and pushed her forward. "Go to the main bedroom and join them. You’ve been waiting for this day since your soul had sex with his, and your cultivation will return quickly if you regularly dual cultivate with him."
"Haha." Huli Yaohu laughed and dashed toward the main bedroom.

The first party is Tian Qiye’s group, and the second party is Tian Yizu’s group. According to the story I heard, the split between them occurred because of their first ancestor, who had been reincarnated as Xu Ling’er."
"Hmm? What did their first ancestors have to do with their split?"

"Didn’t Tian Huangjin tell you the details?" Zhang Fei shook his head at Nalan Yushu. "Tian Yizu’s group is more conservative, and they have always been loyal to the teachings of their first ancestor. On the contrary, Tian Qiye’s group does not want to continue living behind the shadow of their first ancestor."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned. "Why did Tian Qiye and her group want to do that?"

Nalan Yushu let out a soft sigh. "Master, the Winged Race isn’t as pure as it appears from the outside, and many of them are hypocrites. Although Tian Yizu’s group also often kills demons, they only kill those who have committed evil. On the other hand, Tian Qiye and her group have a superiority complex, and they want to get rid of their first ancestor’s loyalists. They indiscriminately slaughtered our races in the name of righteousness, which almost caused a war to break out between the winged race and the demon races. Fortunately, the Golden Dragon Emperor intervened and stopped them; otherwise, the situation in the Paradise Realm would not be the same as now."

Zhang Fei frowned deeper when Nalan Yushu said that. "Therefore, you must keep Xu Ling’er’s identity as safe as possible, or she and her group will relentlessly hunt her down to kill her."

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Ling’er is my wife, so I will do anything to protect her from Tian Qiye and his group. Some people from the Winged Race already know her identity, but they are from the Tian Yizu’s group. However, traitors are everywhere, and people from his side could betray him or accidentally let the news about her slip out, so I have to be more careful about that."
"Why don’t you give them your demon partner mark, Master?" Huli Yaohu asked.

Zhang Fei looked at her straight away. "Actually, I have implanted my demon partner mark in all of them, whether they are my main wives or my clones’ wives, since several years ago. After all, they wanted to live outside after they reached the Five Celestial Realms, so I had to do something to protect them from evil cultivators."

Zhang Fei laughed and planted his demon partner mark on them, binding them to him for their entire lives.
Nalan Yushu and Huli Yaohu immediately pounced on Zhang Fei. "Master, our souls have had sex with yours countless times, but this time, we’ll have sex for real."
"Don’t you want to meet your mother first, Yushu?"

Nalan Yushu shook her head. "My mother should already know that I’m back by now, but I miss you more than her. I want to dual cultivate with you until I’m satisfied first, and I’ll bring one of your clones to see her later."

"Where—"

"They came." Zhang Fei [5] pointed to the outside of the barrier, where Tian Huangjin and Tianshi Shengjie were. However, the two women did not come alone, and they came with several other people. "Let’s meet them first."

chapters.title: Chapter 1171: Representative of Two Races
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er led their guests into the sect, but Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing did not join them.

"I didn’t expect you to bring these people into this realm." Tian Huangjin spoke after seeing many familiar faces. After all, she had been living in the Three Mortal Realms for a long time to hunt down Xereth, and she had met many of them before.
Tian Shengjie asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Aren’t some of them people from the Yin-Yang Pavilion and the Heavenly Sword Sect?"

"They are indeed people from those two sects; I also brought people from the Hidden Sea Sect and people from various clans across different regions." Zhang Fei [5] then answered Tian Huangjin. "As you already know, they are my closest acquaintances, and they have helped me a lot. Therefore, I brought them here, and they will help me to develop this sect."
Both Tian Huangjin and Tian Shengjie nodded in understanding. "So, when is your sect opening ceremony?"
"In a month." Zhang Fei [5] handed two invitations to them. "We are making final preparations, and this sect will officially become a universal sect by then."
"Why is there another barrier in that area?" Tian Huangjin pointed in one direction.
Tianshi Shengjie pointed in another direction. "That area too."

"The barrier to the east is where the beast races live, and I deliberately separated their residence from the rest. Since you’re a beast yourself, you should already understand my reasoning, right?" Tianshi Shengjie told Zhang Fei [5], who then pointed to the back of the mountain. "That area will be the location of my residence, and I set up several formation arrays there to separate my family from the rest."
"I previously thought that you wouldn’t let them out of your private place because you’re too possessive." Tianshi Shengjie said this with a teasing tone.

Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his nose. "They have been focused on their cultivation for decades in isolation, so they want to come out and go on an adventure in this realm to prove the results of their training."
"Are you really going to let them go on an adventure? Aren’t you worried that some evil cultivators will target them?" Tian Huangjin asked.

"Naturally, I will always worry about their safety, but cultivators aren’t birds, and we can’t keep them in cages forever." Zhang Fei [5] then asked her. "I’m sure there are some cultivators in your race with high cultivation, but they don’t have any experience of the outside world, especially since they’ve been living under the protection of their families, right?"

"You’re right about that, Zhang Fei." Tian Huotian answered him first. "I won’t talk about other people, but some of my brothers and sisters are like that. Their cultivation has reached the Celestial King and Celestial Emperor Realms, but their experience cannot be compared with yours. Maybe, they won’t be able to do anything if they spar with these people whose cultivation is still at the Seven Divine Realms."

"The best teachers in shaping a cultivator’s character are experience, dangers, life-and-death battles, and many more." Tian Huotian agreed with Zhang Fei [5]. "In fact, many of my wives are experienced cultivators, and they have often faced such situations in the past. However, I am overly paranoid and worried about their safety, and I treated them like birds for so many years."

"Hahaha." Tianshi Shengjie laughed out loud. "I’ve been following your progress since you started your cultivation path in the Sky Jade Realm, and all your actions there are still fresh in my memory. Back then, I was amazed by your action to save Liu Qingyu from Pang Hong because you had only cultivated for two days, but you were brave enough to face an expert cultivator like him, and you managed to save her and Liu Hua. After that, you fought almost many strong clans there, and you also succeeded in destroying them. Your most remarkable achievement was leading them to purge those heretics, but you suddenly turned too cautious, and you took them to your private place to avoid danger, which is quite disappointing to me."

"Hey! Just admit that you’ve fallen in love with me; otherwise, you wouldn’t have been stalking me for so long, right?" The two people from the beast race frowned as soon as Zhang Fei [5] said that to Tianshi Shengjie.
Tianshi Shengjie neither denied nor agreed; instead, she asked him again. "What made you change your mind about letting them live freely?"

"I made this decision after experiencing several incidents in the past that almost cost me my life." Tianshi Shengjie and the others were shocked to hear that, but Zhang Fei [5] told them a few things without mentioning his cursed demon heart. "Thus, I changed my mind, and I agreed to their request to live outside. I will allow them to wander to other domains to gain more experience, but I won’t let them leave just like that, and I will provide them with several things to ensure their safety."
Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er did not bring them to the main hall; instead, they took their guests to the mountaintop.
Upon their arrival, Zhang Fei [5] asked Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin directly, "Why did you bring them here? I contacted both of you simply to provide the invitation."

"Zhang Fei, the woman is an Aurora-Plume Peacock, and her name is Kong Que. The man is a Golden Fang Lion, and his name is Shi Yajin." Zhang Fei [5] immediately observed the two people, but they looked haughty even though they were only divine beasts. "My emperor has heard about this sect, and he sent them as our representatives to establish closer relations with you."

Tian Huanjin then explained. "My father wanted to send some other people as representatives of our race, but I decided to join you myself. However, Huotian and Zhiling decided to join me, so I brought them here today."
"Eh?" Tian Huangjin’s decision surprised Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er. "Hey, you are the daughter of a grand elder, so it wouldn’t be appropriate for you to join my sect, right?"

Tian Huangjin shook her head in response. "I never cared about my status as the daughter of a grand elder. My father and I are two different people, and I can decide for myself regardless of my status. Furthermore, he has agreed with my decision, so I will be staying here starting today."
"Please take care of us." Tian Huotian and Tian Zhiling spoke.
Kong Que and Shi Yajin nodded at them. "Please take care of us."
"Will you accept them?" Zhang Fei [5] asked Qing Qiu’er.

Qing Qiu’er nodded slightly. "Since they’ve decided, we’ll accept them. Even if they don’t mind their status, Tian Huangjin, Tian Huotian, and Tian Zhiling cannot be our disciples; instead, they will become new elders. Meanwhile, Kong Que and Shi Yajin’s cultivation is still at the Celestial King Realm, so they will become our inner disciples."

"Do you guys mind that?" All of them shook their heads at Zhang Fei [5], who immediately handed them several tokens. Elder tokens for Tian Huangjin, Tian Huotian, and Tian Zhiling. Disciple tokens for Kong Que and Shi Yajin. "What about you, Shengjie? Would you like to join us?"

"No." Tianshi Shengji’s answer disappointed Zhang Fei [5]. "I know your purpose in inviting me to join this sect, so I won’t do it, and I will go straight back to my domain to report to my emperor after this."

"You can run away now, but I’ll have you in the future." Tianshi Shengjie simply smiled at Zhang Fei [5]. "I need your help contacting Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun, and please tell them that I’m inviting them to this sect’s opening ceremony."
"Why do you want to invite them both? Aren’t you afraid that the Fairy King will discover your location?" Zhang Fei’s request confused not only Tianshi Shengji but also Tian Huangjin.

"I can’t say anything for now, but I hope they’ll be willing to attend then. As for the Fairy King, I’ve already prepared several plans to counter him if he manages to find me and attack me." Tianshi Shengji stared at Zhang Fei [5] for a while before agreeing. "Thank you."
"No need." Tianshi Shengjie then asked him about something else. "Why don’t you bring the natural races from the Evergreen Spirit Haven to this realm?"

"You still dare ask that, huh?" Tianshi Shengjie laughed as Zhang Fei [5] put on an annoyed look. "I don’t like them, and I only consider them to be my servants, which is because of what you did back then. Therefore, I will never bring them to this realm, but I have already told them how to ascend here."
"Hahaha." Tianshi Shengjie laughed at that. "Hey! More than two decades have passed for you since then, but you still hold a grudge against me regarding that matter."
Zhang Fei [5] shrugged his shoulders. "Before I can get you and spank your ass, I will never forget the events of that day."
"Up to you, then." Tianshi Shengjie sighed helplessly. "Since my business is finished, I will go to see Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun, and we will meet again in a month."

After Tianshi Shengji left, Qing Qiu’er brought the five new members to the area designated for elders and inner disciples. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] stood by the artificial lake and thought about something, but a voice transmission suddenly came in, making him smile.
