"In a month." Zhang Fei [5] handed two invitations to them.
"We are making final preparations, and this sect will officially become a universal sect by then."
"Why is there another barrier in that area?" Tian Huangjin pointed in one direction.
Tianshi Shengjie pointed in another direction.
"That area too."
"The barrier to the east is where the beast races live, and I deliberately separated their residence from the rest.
Since you’re a beast yourself, you should already understand my reasoning, right?" Tianshi Shengjie told Zhang Fei [5], who then pointed to the back of the mountain.
"That area will be the location of my residence, and I set up several formation arrays there to separate my family from the rest."
"I previously thought that you wouldn’t let them out of your private place because you’re too possessive." Tianshi Shengjie said this with a teasing tone.
Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his nose.
"They have been focused on their cultivation for decades in isolation, so they want to come out and go on an adventure in this realm to prove the results of their training."
"Are you really going to let them go on an adventure?
Aren’t you worried that some evil cultivators will target them?" Tian Huangjin asked.
"Naturally, I will always worry about their safety, but cultivators aren’t birds, and we can’t keep them in cages forever." Zhang Fei [5] then asked her.

"I’m sure there are some cultivators in your race with high cultivation, but they don’t have any experience of the outside world, especially since they’ve been living under the protection of their families, right?"
"You’re right about that, Zhang Fei." Tian Huotian answered him first.
"I won’t talk about other people, but some of my brothers and sisters are like that.
Their cultivation has reached the Celestial King and Celestial Emperor Realms, but their experience cannot be compared with yours.
Maybe, they won’t be able to do anything if they spar with these people whose cultivation is still at the Seven Divine Realms."
"The best teachers in shaping a cultivator’s character are experience, dangers, life-and-death battles, and many more." Tian Huotian agreed with Zhang Fei [5].
"In fact, many of my wives are experienced cultivators, and they have often faced such situations in the past.
However, I am overly paranoid and worried about their safety, and I treated them like birds for so many years."
"Hahaha." Tianshi Shengjie laughed out loud.
"I’ve been following your progress since you started your cultivation path in the Sky Jade Realm, and all your actions there are still fresh in my memory.

Back then, I was amazed by your action to save Liu Qingyu from Pang Hong because you had only cultivated for two days, but you were brave enough to face an expert cultivator like him, and you managed to save her and Liu Hua.
After that, you fought almost many strong clans there, and you also succeeded in destroying them.

Your most remarkable achievement was leading them to purge those heretics, but you suddenly turned too cautious, and you took them to your private place to avoid danger, which is quite disappointing to me."
"Hey!

Just admit that you’ve fallen in love with me; otherwise, you wouldn’t have been stalking me for so long, right?" The two people from the beast race frowned as soon as Zhang Fei [5] said that to Tianshi Shengjie.
Tianshi Shengjie neither denied nor agreed; instead, she asked him again.
"What made you change your mind about letting them live freely?"

"I made this decision after experiencing several incidents in the past that almost cost me my life." Tianshi Shengjie and the others were shocked to hear that, but Zhang Fei [5] told them a few things without mentioning his cursed demon heart.
"Thus, I changed my mind, and I agreed to their request to live outside.
I will allow them to wander to other domains to gain more experience, but I won’t let them leave just like that, and I will provide them with several things to ensure their safety."
Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er did not bring them to the main hall; instead, they took their guests to the mountaintop.
Upon their arrival, Zhang Fei [5] asked Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin directly, "Why did you bring them here?
I contacted both of you simply to provide the invitation."
"Zhang Fei, the woman is an Aurora-Plume Peacock, and her name is Kong Que.
The man is a Golden Fang Lion, and his name is Shi Yajin." Zhang Fei [5] immediately observed the two people, but they looked haughty even though they were only divine beasts.
"My emperor has heard about this sect, and he sent them as our representatives to establish closer relations with you."
Tian Huanjin then explained.
"My father wanted to send some other people as representatives of our race, but I decided to join you myself.
However, Huotian and Zhiling decided to join me, so I brought them here today."
"Eh?" Tian Huangjin’s decision surprised Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er.
"Hey, you are the daughter of a grand elder, so it wouldn’t be appropriate for you to join my sect, right?"
Tian Huangjin shook her head in response.
"I never cared about my status as the daughter of a grand elder.
My father and I are two different people, and I can decide for myself regardless of my status.
Furthermore, he has agreed with my decision, so I will be staying here starting today."
"Please take care of us." Tian Huotian and Tian Zhiling spoke.
Kong Que and Shi Yajin nodded at them.
"Please take care of us."
"Will you accept them?" Zhang Fei [5] asked Qing Qiu’er.
Qing Qiu’er nodded slightly.
"Since they’ve decided, we’ll accept them.
Even if they don’t mind their status, Tian Huangjin, Tian Huotian, and Tian Zhiling cannot be our disciples; instead, they will become new elders.
Meanwhile, Kong Que and Shi Yajin’s cultivation is still at the Celestial King Realm, so they will become our inner disciples."
"Do you guys mind that?" All of them shook their heads at Zhang Fei [5], who immediately handed them several tokens.
Elder tokens for Tian Huangjin, Tian Huotian, and Tian Zhiling.
Disciple tokens for Kong Que and Shi Yajin.
"What about you, Shengjie?
Would you like to join us?"
"No." Tianshi Shengji’s answer disappointed Zhang Fei [5].
"I know your purpose in inviting me to join this sect, so I won’t do it, and I will go straight back to my domain to report to my emperor after this."
"You can run away now, but I’ll have you in the future." Tianshi Shengjie simply smiled at Zhang Fei [5].
"I need your help contacting Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun, and please tell them that I’m inviting them to this sect’s opening ceremony."
"Why do you want to invite them both?
Aren’t you afraid that the Fairy King will discover your location?" Zhang Fei’s request confused not only Tianshi Shengji but also Tian Huangjin.
"I can’t say anything for now, but I hope they’ll be willing to attend then.
As for the Fairy King, I’ve already prepared several plans to counter him if he manages to find me and attack me." Tianshi Shengji stared at Zhang Fei [5] for a while before agreeing.
"Thank you."
"No need." Tianshi Shengjie then asked him about something else.
"Why don’t you bring the natural races from the Evergreen Spirit Haven to this realm?"
"You still dare ask that, huh?" Tianshi Shengjie laughed as Zhang Fei [5] put on an annoyed look.
"I don’t like them, and I only consider them to be my servants, which is because of what you did back then.
Therefore, I will never bring them to this realm, but I have already told them how to ascend here."
"Hahaha." Tianshi Shengjie laughed at that.
"Hey!
More than two decades have passed for you since then, but you still hold a grudge against me regarding that matter."
Zhang Fei [5] shrugged his shoulders.
"Before I can get you and spank your ass, I will never forget the events of that day."
"Up to you, then." Tianshi Shengjie sighed helplessly.
"Since my business is finished, I will go to see Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun, and we will meet again in a month."
After Tianshi Shengji left, Qing Qiu’er brought the five new members to the area designated for elders and inner disciples.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] stood by the artificial lake and thought about something, but a voice transmission suddenly came in, making him smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1172: Blazing Nirvana Domain
paragraphs: "Is this your private domain, Yao’er?" Feng Jiu asked when they arrived at the Blazing Nirvana Domain.
Feng Tian also asked her. "Why did you suddenly decide to bring us here, Yao’er? Do you want to revive this domain?"

The Blazing Nirvana Domain is shrouded in eternal crimson flames. Mountains of blackened obsidian stretch endlessly, their peaks crowned with fire lotuses that bloom amidst the inferno. The air ripples with unbearable heat, distorting vision and scorching the unprepared.

At the domain’s heart lies the Nirvana Sea of Fire, an ocean of molten fire said to incinerate the body while tempering the soul. Within it resides the legendary Eternal Flame Heart, a divine fire spirit that embodies both destruction and rebirth. Cultivators who dare to enter face the agony of burning away their mortal shell; those who manage to endure may undergo a complete transformation, rising stronger, as if reborn from ashes.

"My people have long awaited my return." Feng Yao smiled as she looked around the domain. "Moreover, your son-in-law will host cultivators from various domains at the opening ceremony of his new sect in a month, and he doesn’t yet have truly powerful backers. Therefore, it’s time for me to revive this domain, and they will become his backers."

Feng Jiu and Feng Tian exchanged glances after Feng Yao said that. "Yao’er, please tell us about your true feelings toward Zhang Fei. Sometimes, we feel you two are distant from each other, but we can see that you are always supportive of him, and you are willing to do many things for his sake."
"Do you love Zhang Fei or not, Yao’er?" Feng Tian asked her too.

"Feelings and love are insignificant things, and I have neither." Feng Yao’s response confused Feng Jiu and Feng Tian. "I was born for a certain purpose, and I will disappear once the purpose of my birth is fulfilled."
Feng Jiu grabbed her hand. "What do you mean by that, Yao’er? What do you mean that you will disappear once the purpose of your birth is fulfilled?"

"Mother, I won’t say anything for now, and you will know the answer far in the future." Feng Yao led the two of them to fly to the crimson palace, which floated on the sea of fire right in the center of the domain.

As they flew there, the sea of flames below began to churn, and countless flame beasts leaped out from within. Even the sky above the domain rumbled with unusual sounds, and many crimson lines resembling a rainbow appeared in the distance.

The temperature in the domain became scorching, followed by the appearance of countless crimson flames, which immediately turned into crimson women. They kneel with one leg in the midair, welcoming the return of their long-lost master.
Feng Jiu and Feng Tian were completely shocked by what they saw. They knew Feng Yao was no ordinary woman, but producing such a phenomenon with just her presence was not a simple feat.

Huo Ling immediately emerged from Feng Yao’s body and smiled at all this. "Look at them, Master. You’ve been gone for a long time and reincarnated as your current self, but they’ve never forgotten you, and they immediately appeared to welcome your return."

"Yeah." Feng Yao looked towards the crimson palace, and a faint smile appeared on her face as she watched three women, all crimson-haired and crimson-dressed, walk out from within. However, she was more focused on the young woman who was leading at the front. "Huo Lanyin."

Huo Lanyin has long, flowing crimson-red hair that cascades down her back. Her face was refined, with smooth pale skin, straight eyebrows, bright crimson eyes, a slender nose, and soft red lips, giving her a striking yet elegant appearance.

Huo Lanyin’s figure was tall and curvaceous, with long legs and a straight posture. Her breasts were full and prominent, accentuated by the design of her attire. She wore a fitted, ornate crimson dress with golden patterns that traced along her curves, showing off the smooth skin of her chest. The fabric was layered with sheer, flowing material that draped like flames around her, creating a seductive and alluring aura.
"Who is that woman, Yao’er?"

"Mother, her name is Huo Lanyin, and she comes from the third generation of my Huo Clan." Feng Yao’s answer left Feng Jiu stunned. "She has followed me since she was five years old, and I taught her all my knowledge about alchemy. Right now, she is the best female alchemist, and Jin Nanqing is the best male alchemist in the entire Paradise Realm."

Before long, they landed in front of the palace. Huo Lanyin immediately led the other women to salute Feng Yao. "Welcome back, Empress Huo. We have heard that you have returned to this realm, and we have been waiting for your arrival."

"Hehe." Feng Yao giggled and lifted Huo Lanyin. She rubbed her cheeks before hugging her, which she immediately reciprocated. "I’m sorry; I’ve made you and the others wait for thousands of years, Lanyin."

"Thousands of years is only a short time for cultivators like us, so you don’t need to apologize to us, Empress." Huo Lanyin then parted their embrace, looked at Feng Yao, and touched her face. "Even though you have been reincarnated, your face is almost no different from the past, but you look much younger."
Feng Yao smiled at that and placed two pills into Huo Lanyin’s mouth directly. "I got them from a friend, and you’ll definitely love their effects."
"Uhm." Huo Lanyin nodded slightly and swallowed both pills.
Feng Yao then looked at the two women behind Huo Lanyin. "How are you two, Huo Hao’er and Huo Yu’er?"
"We are fine, and we really missed you, Empress." Both women answered in unison. Huo Hao’er’s voice was more husky, and Huo Yu’er’s voice was more feminine.

Huo Hao’er has striking bright crimson hair, cut short in a layered style that frames her face with sharp. Her face was soft yet confident, with sharp eyebrows and almond-shaped crimson eyes. Her lips were naturally full. She has a voluptuous figure, with a slender waist and attractive curves. She wore a deep crimson, high-slit outfit tailored from glossy fabric that stretched to her shape. Her bold, sleeveless dress features a plunging neckline that showcases her large and firm breasts, creating deep cleavage.

Huo Yu’er had long crimson hair that was left flowing down past her buttocks. She wore a striking red dress adorned with silver-gilded patterns resembling flowing vines and blossoms with revealing cutouts on the sides and shoulders. Her face was sculpted with fair skin, gentle blush, graceful brows, a slender nose, and naturally tinted red lips.
Huo Yu’er immediately walked to Feng Yao’s side, hugged her arm, and shook it. "Where are my pills, Empress?"

"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed at Huo Yu’er’s childish behavior before stuffing two pills into her mouth, and she also gave them to Huo Hao’er. "Swallow them now, and we’ll talk after you three are finished."
"Yes, Empress." Both Huo Hao’er and Huo Yu’er immediately swallowed the pills.
Feng Jiu then asked her daughter. ’If Huo Lanyin is the third generation of my Huo Clan, then who are these two women?’

’Mother, neither of them are members of my Huo Clan, and I found both of them almost dead in front of a ruin. Their real names are actually Chen Hao’er and Ling Yu’er, but they changed their surnames, following mine. As you can see, Hao’er is a pure human, but Yu’er is a half-elf race.’ Feng Yao then explained to her mother several things about the two women. ’Since then, they have followed me, but they are not alchemists like Lanyin. Hao’er is more interested in artifacts and ruins, and Yu’er is more interested in arrays.’
’Oh.’ Feng Jiu nodded slightly. ’Are there only three of them living in this palace?’
Feng Yao shook her head at her. ’There are still hundreds of women inside, and you two will meet them soon. However, their status is different from Lanyin, Hao’er, and Yu’er.’

A while later, Huo Lanyin, Huo Hao’er, and Huo Yu’er had finished taking the pills and were admiring their changed appearances in the mirror. Although the three of them still looked youthful before swallowing the pills, their faces had become much younger after taking them, which amazed them.
"Empress, who concocted the two pills?" Huo Lanyin curiously asked.
"His name is Zhang Fei, and he—"
"He is our son-in-law." The three women immediately looked at Feng Jiu in shock before returning their gazes to Feng Yao.
Feng Yao introduced them directly. "They are my parents in this lifetime, Feng Jiu and Feng Tian. As you can see, they are not ordinary humans but mythical phoenix beasts, and so am I."
After hearing that, the three women hurriedly paid their respects to Feng Jiu and Feng Tian. "Does that mean you are married in this life, Empress?"
"Not yet." Feng Yao immediately led them into the palace. "Let’s meet the others first, and I will explain things to the three of you afterward."
"Yes, Empress."

A while later, they arrived at the throne room, where a large, crimson throne sat at the front. Hundreds of crimson-haired and crimson-clad women lined up neatly on both sides, but not all of them were human, and they came from various races: humans, beasts, natural races, and even demons.
All of them immediately lowered their heads as Feng Yao led the others inside, but they couldn’t hide the excited smiles on their faces.

chapters.title: Chapter 1173: Feng Yao’s Order
paragraphs: As Feng Yao walked forward, the torches on the walls lit up one by one. Her appearance transformed into her past self, Huo Yanling. A crimson flame covered her body before transforming into a crimson royal robe with its hem trailing along the floor, and a crimson crown appeared above her head, making her truly resemble an empress.

Feng Tian and Feng Jiu, who were walking on either side of Feng Yao, smiled proudly at the change in their daughter. Huo Lanyin, Huo Hao’er, and Huo Yu’er casually walked behind them. Meanwhile, Huo Ling had flown to the throne and sat on one of the armrests, waiting for her master to arrive.

Lined up on both sides of the room, all the women began humming a song. Outside the palace, the entire domain area and the sky echoed with noisy voices until Feng Yao sat on her throne. Feng Tian and Feng Jiu stood on either side of him, and the three women stood behind them.
"Long live the empress!"

Feng Yao nodded slightly and waved his hand. In an instant, hundreds of pill bottles floated before the women, and they grabbed them with joy. "Those pills are my gift to all of you, especially since I’ve kept you guys waiting for too long."
"Thank you, Empress!"

"They are both my parents in this lifetime, and they will live here with us now." All of them looked at Feng Tian and Feng Jiu before saluting them, leaving both of them feeling awkward. Feng Yao then spoke to her people again. "I’m back now, and our Blazing Nirvana Domain will be active again with my return. For now, I want to hear all the information and events that happened after I left back then, and I will determine our next steps afterward."

Thereafter, ten women came forward and stood in front of the throne, representing all the women present. They took turns speaking, and they conveyed to Feng Yao all the events that happened after her death.
Feng Tian and Feng Jiu, who were listening to their report, were stunned in their spots. ’All the problems in this realm are much more complex than in the Three Mortal Realms!’

A while later, they had finished reporting everything, and Feng Yao issued her order. "From now on, all of you don’t need to hold back anymore, and we’ll show those people that they have made a fatal mistake by disturbing us. Whether they are humans, beasts, or demons, I want you to visit those who tried to invade our domain in the past and exterminate them down to their roots."

Feng Tian and Feng Jiu were shocked after hearing Feng Yao’s order, but they didn’t say anything and chose to wait for the right time to talk to her. ’Why do I feel like she is much crueler than Zhang Fei?’
Feng Yao immediately continued. "If Wang Wuzhao and the ten demon gods try to stop you from carrying out my orders, tell them to visit me, and I will handle them myself."
"What about the winged races and natural races, Empress?"

Feng Yao thought for some time before answering. "Tian Shangdi and Zhong Zuzhen should already know about my return, and I’m sure they won’t stop you as long as you don’t attack their members. Therefore, you don’t need to pay attention to them; just carry out my orders, and by that time, everyone will know about my return."
"Yes, Empress! We will leave now, and we will exterminate them."

After they all left, Feng Yao spoke to her parents directly. "You two might think I am cruel, but this realm is different from the Three Mortal Realms. If we show weakness even once, the other cultivators will try to harass and oppress us. Therefore, we must show them that we are superior to them, and we must not have mercy for people like them. We will not bother or bully others, but we will destroy those who try to bully us."
"Aren’t they going to face any problems out there, Yao’er?" Feng Tian asked.
Feng Yao shook her head. "Father, my people are powerful even without me; otherwise, this domain would have long fallen into the hands of those who are after it, right?"

Her lips were thin and covered with black lipstick.

The woman figure was tall with a slender waist and long arms; her chest was proportionate, accentuated by the high-neck, form-fitting design of her attire, which enhanced her curves without being overly revealing.
She wore a black gown with a high collar and her shoulders bare, with long, draped sleeves.
The young man wore a simple, plain black dress.
His hair was tied high at the back, and a serious expression adorned his handsome face.
His figure is quite tall—not slim but not stocky, with two black wings on his back.
"Do you know where my little sister is now, Mother?
Who freed her soul from the Star Tower?"
"I don’t know who freed Yuzhu’s soul from that tower or where she is now, Wangzi and Huanzi." Nalan Shizhe turned to face them and showed the purple stone in her hand.
"This stone suddenly sparkled by itself, indicating that she had reshaped her body.
Therefore, I was sure she had returned, but she still hasn’t contacted me until now.
I want both of you to go to the Star Tower to search for information about your little sister; I believe Wan Jiang knows something about her.
Don’t be impudent in front of him, or he will lock you up there, and I won’t be able to free you."
Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi nodded to her.
"In that case, we will leave for the Star Tower right away, Mother."

chapters.title: Chapter 1175: Sudden Phenomenon
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] led the three members of the winged race to inspect the areas they had recently opened, especially since they would be part of them from now on.

Although each hall was quite far apart, wide stone paths connected them, adorned with numerous green trees on both sides. Zhang Fei [5] deliberately designed it like public places on Earth, and he forbade people from flying from one hall to another. He did this so that the disciples would often meet each other, which could strengthen the relationship between them. He also prepared strict rules for all the disciples and elders, but he planned to implement them after the opening ceremony of the new sect.

Zhang Fei [5] explained to the three members of the winged race about his purpose in building each hall. He also introduced them to those who would lead those halls, such as Hun Di, Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, and Lin Jingxia.

Unlike Tian Huangjin, who had already met some of them, Tian Zhiling and Tian Huotian were quite surprised by their abilities, especially since all of them had reached the pinnacle of their respective fields despite still being at the early stage of the Five Celestial Realms.

Their final stop was the Medical Hall, where Elmyra, Chiel, Tian Jianxia, Tian Gongzhu, Yue Xi, Ling Yao, Tian Yishen, and Xiao Laoshu were arranging and installing all the medical devices brought by the last two people from the Xianjin Realm.

Zhang Fei [5] introduced the three members of the winged race to them, and he asked them to join the Medical Hall, especially since they had powerful light elements, which were useful for treating their sect members if they suffered injuries.
Tian Huangjin, Tian Zhiling, and Tian Huotian frowned when they saw Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu, especially since both of them were now heavenly fox demons.

"They used to be ordinary heavenly foxes, but I turned them into demons." Tian Huangjin was not surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s response, but Tian Zhiling and Tian Huotian were shocked by it. "Their ancestors sent them to capture me, and they wanted to kill me because of my status, so I did that to them."
The two nodded in understanding, but Tian Zhiling then pointed at Chiel. "Who is she?"

"My home realm is connected to three other realms, and she comes from the Tian Realm, which is the home of the winged race in the lower realms." Zhang Fei [5] pulled Chiel to his side. "Back then, one of Xereth’s men manipulated her race with the intention of ruling over my home realm, but I stopped them and killed many of them, and she has become my servant and partner since then."
Even though they were both winged races, Tian Huangjin and the other two didn’t think about it, especially since they didn’t know each other. "Do you have other winged races by your side?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "Tian Yinghua, Meng Tianshi, and Daniella belong to the same winged race as all of you. They are still in seclusion with my real body because their cultivation has not yet broken through to the Five Celestial Realms, but I will bring them here once they have successfully reached that stage."
Tian Zhiling briefly glanced at Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu before asking him. "Since you brought them both here, does this mean you will allow demons to join this sect?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] answered her without the slightest hesitation. "I can understand your long-standing enmity with the demon races, but the three of you already know that I am a human, a beast, and a demon. Additionally, you guys should already know about the writings left by the ten-tailed fox about me, and I have thought about fulfilling them. I won’t do it on a large scale right away, and I will start from this sect, which will be the home of all the races."
"Are you sure you can bring peace to all races?"

"Phew." Zhang Fei [5] exhaled softly. "Naturally, I won’t be able to do that for now, but the future is still very long, right? I will never stop honing and improving myself, and I will continue to become stronger. At that time, I might have enough power to reconcile all races, and this universe will be a better place to live if they can be at peace with each other."
Tian Huangjin then spoke. "Honestly, many people want that peace, including us. Unfortunately, many others never wanted peace for this universe, and they would rather destroy each other."
"An example is Tian Qiye, right?"

Tian Huangjin replied with a nod. "Elder Qiye never thought about peace, and she only cared about slaughtering the demon races, regardless of whether they were truly evil or innocent. Like the winged race in your home realm, she harbored a dream of ruling over this realm, and she also didn’t care about the teachings left by our ancestors, which brought disunity within our race."

"Does Tian Qiye really intend to kill your first ancestor?" The three members of the winged race exchanged glances for a moment before nodding to Zhang Fei [5], and they gave him a deeper explanation of the situation within their race. "Did you tell anyone apart from your family members about Xu Ling’er?"
"No."

"That’s good." Zhang Fei [5] sighed in relief as he nodded. "Even though I can hide and protect Ling’er, I still prefer to avoid direct conflicts with your race. If Tian Qiye finds out about her, I’m sure she’ll send people to hunt her down. This way, it will be inevitable that problems will arise between us, and I don’t want that to happen."

"Don’t worry, my father and the others have always followed the teachings of our ancestors, so they won’t spread the news about Xu Ling’er to anyone. As for our other members, you also don’t need to worry about them, especially since they won’t be able to say anything." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow, prompting Tian Houtian to explain a few things to him. "Therefore, you don’t need to worry about that, and her whereabouts will be safe."
"I hope so." Zhang Fei [5] looked at the outside as he sensed an unusual change in the domain. "Can you three feel it?"
"Yes."
They immediately ran out of the Medical Hall to check, but Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling suddenly appeared in front of them. "What happened here?"

"Look at the two moons." Zhang Fei [5] and the others looked up at the sky directly. "Once in a thousand years, the twin moons will align, revealing the path to the Endless Night Dungeon. A thousand years later, the twin suns will also align, revealing the path to the Zenith Solar Sanctum."
"What are the Endless Night Dungeon and the Zenith Sun Sanctum?"

Qing Qiu’er immediately explained. "I don’t know the origins of these two dungeons, or how they could appear in this domain. However, people from the past say that the two dungeons are linked to those tales, especially the one about the two male twins and the two female twins who fell in love with each other."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] seriously observed the twin moons. "Where are the entrances to the two dungeons? What’s inside them?"

"Let’s fly up." They followed Qing Qiu’er, who then pointed to the central area of the Twin Flame Domains. "There is the sacred area of this domain, and the two moons will shine their light there when they align perfectly, revealing the entrance to the Endless Night Dungeon. The moon is always associated with Yin, and the dungeon is filled with various areas and items that are closely related to the Yin."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] and the three members of the winged race looked at Qing Qiu’er with surprise. "For example?"

"The Endless Night labyrinth, mausoleum, palace, sanctum, garden, and many more. We can find many valuable items there, and you will definitely like the garden area, especially since it is filled with countless types of Yin herbs." Qing Qiu’er then looked at the surrounding area. "However, our competitors are not only cultivators from this domain, and many cultivators from other domains will also join in, so the competition will be very tight."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "When will the two moons be perfectly aligned?"

"If I’m not mistaken, the two moons will be perfectly aligned in a month." Zhang Fei [5] frowned after You Feiling answered him. "It does coincide with the opening ceremony of our new sect, but I don’t think it’s a problem since our event will take place from morning to noon."
"In that case, I want you two to prepare them to enter the dungeon, and I will prepare my wives."

"Huh?" That shocked both Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling. "Are you sure you want to take them there? The cultivators who will be entering the dungeon are not weak cultivators, and almost all of them are experienced senior cultivators."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "Naturally, I won’t bring all my wives into that dungeon, and I’ll only bring some of those who are ready."
"Alright, we will ask the others to prepare." Qing Qiu’er then asked him. "Shall we bring those special disciples with us?"
"Yes."
Afterwards, Qing Qiu’er gathered the elders in the main hall, and You Feiling met the ten special disciples on the mountain, informing them to prepare to explore the Endless Night Dungeon in a month.

chapters.title: Chapter 1176: Wan Jiang’s Decision
paragraphs: Somewhere in the Divine Origin Main Domain, Tianshi Shengjie stood on the edge of a cliff, looking at the two people floating down toward him. "I thought you two wouldn’t come, Senior Shengyun and Senior Lingzhu."
"Haha." Jia Shengyun laughed as he and his wife landed in front of her. "You are the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, so how could we dare not accept your invitation, Princess?"
"Why don’t you want to talk in our forest, Princess?" Tianshi Shengjie handed the invitation to Jia Lingzhu, confusing her and her husband. "What is this?"

"Please read first, Senior Lingzhu." Jia Lingzhu nodded to Tianshi Shengjie and opened the invitation, but she and Jia Shengyun were confused after they read the name of the Moonlit Passion Sect in it. "Zhang Fei asked me to hand over this invitation to you two."
"Zhang Fei?" Both Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu were shocked when they heard the name.

Tianshi Shengjie then explained. "Zhang Fei joined the sect several months ago, and Qing Qiu’er appointed him as an elder. He has made extensive preparations to transform the sect into a universal one, and he has planned to invite many sects and clans from various regions to attend the opening ceremony. If you two want to know his reason, you should attend the event and ask him directly. Since my business is finished, I will leave now, and both of you should keep this matter hidden from Jia Zizhen."
"We know." After Tianshi Shengjie left, Jia Lingzhu directly asked her husband a question. "Do you think Zhang Fei invited us because of our granddaughter?"

"That’s for sure." Jia Shengyun nodded at her. "After all, Yuyan lives with Zhang Fei as his wife. However, I think he has another reason for inviting us, so we should attend his event, and we’ll talk to him in person."
"What about Jia Zizhen? If we attend the event, I’m sure he will send people to monitor our movements, and he will find Zhang Fei’s whereabouts." Jia Lingzhu looked worried.

"Since Zhang Fei has made such a decision, I’m sure he has considered the risks." Jia Shengyun took the invitation from his wife and destroyed it. "He won’t be able to hide forever, and Jia Zizhen will find him someday, but his decision will speed it up."

Jia Lingzhu released a soft sigh after hearing that. "Zhang Fei was destined to be the heir of the ten-tailed fox, but many races are unwilling to accept this fact, including Jia Zizhen. What do you think will happen next?"

"I don’t know." Jia Shengyun shook his head and looked into the distance. "Zhang Fei will probably face a lot of trouble soon, but I think he’ll be fine. We’ve both heard reports from our members who met him in the Forbidden Land months ago that he has a connection with the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling, so I believe he’ll be fine with her protection."
"I hope that’s true."
"Let’s go back now, or Jia Zizhen will be suspicious of us."
"Yeah."
"What brought you two here, Princess Wangzi and Prince Huanzi?" Wan Jiang asked the two demons, who had just arrived.
Sima Yun, Helian Xun’er, and Hua Mei’er also looked at them with unfriendly gazes.
"Senior, we didn’t come here to cause trouble, and we only wanted to find out information about our little sister." Nalan Huanzi was the first to answer.

Nalan Wangzi then explained. "Our mother discovered that Yushu has come back to life, but she hasn’t contacted her or returned to our territory. Since you were the one in charge of this tower, she believes you know something about the person who freed her soul and helped her reshape her body, and we hope you can tell us about it."

"Someone did free your sister’s soul from this tower, but unfortunately, I promised someone else not to reveal her savior’s identity to anyone." Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi narrowed their eyes at Wan Jiang, but they still didn’t dare to be impudent in front of him. "Actually, your sister and her savior are already in our realm, but I don’t know their current location because I haven’t met them again."
"What do you think about that, Brother?" Nalan Wangzi asked.

Nalan Huanzi shook his head slightly. "Since they are in our realm, and Yuzhu has reshaped her body, I’m sure she will return to us sooner or later. Moreover, we both know her character, and I think she’s having fun somewhere out there, especially since her soul has been imprisoned in this tower for so long. Therefore, we don’t need to bother looking for her, and she will come back by herself after she’s had enough fun."
"Yeah." Nalan Wangzi then asked Wan Jiang. "Does Tian Qiye know about this matter, Senior?"

"Not a single cultivator from our realm knows that your sister’s soul has been freed." Wan Jiang’s answer relieved Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi; they were afraid that Tian Qiye would find their sister, and Nalan Yushu would die again if that happened. "Leave and wait for her return."
"We will leave now, Senior."

After the two left, Hua Mei’er immediately spoke. "Master, my big sister told me that Nalan Shizhe met Zhang Fei in the Forbidden Land more than half a year ago, but she was unaware that her daughter was with him."

"You’re as stupid as ever, Mei’er!" Hua Mei’er looked at Sima Yun with a furious look. "Do you know how long it takes to reshape our body? At that time, Nalan Yushu was obviously not there with Zhang Fei, so it was natural that she was not aware that he was related to her daughter."

Helian Xun’er shook her head at Hua Mei’er. "Mei’er, you are so old now, so you have to use your brain every time you speak. Moreover, you are an experienced cultivator, and people will laugh at you if you always act foolish and childish."
"Humph!" Hua Mei’er snorted at the two.

Helian Xun’er then spoke to her master. "I still find it hard to believe that Zhang Fei has already broken through to the Five Celestial Realms, but what shocks me the most is his current bone age, especially since he is aging so quickly. Moreover, he achieved it only a few years after he arrived in our realm, and all his breakthroughs caused a lot of commotion there, especially his breakthrough in the Moon Illusion Domain. He may still be safe now, but those old fogeys will target him sooner or later."

"Do you think they would dare to do that, Xun’er?" Unlike his disciple, Wan Jiang is not the least bit worried about Zhang Fei. "Did you forget about the information Hua Xiang’er gave Mei’er? Empress Huo Yanling and the Eternal Flame have returned, and both of them are by his side now. No sane person would dare attack him, or they would end up facing both of them."
Helian Xun’er nodded in agreement. "If they—"

"My big sister just sent me a new message about Zhang Fei, Master." Wan Jiang and his other two disciples turned to Hua Mei’er directly. "As you all know, he joined the Moonlit Passion Sect and became an elder in the sect. He carried out his previous plan to transform the sect into a universal one, and he sent out invitations to many cultivators from various domains to attend the opening ceremony of his new sect in a month."

"Insane! Did Zhang Fei want to commit suicide? Why would he do something like that?" Sima Yun let out an ear-splitting scream. "If he appeared now, those people would definitely attack him and his sect. Even if Empress Huo Yanling and the Eternal Flame protected him, they wouldn’t be able to protect him from his many enemies."
Helian Xun’er nodded in agreement with Sima Yun, and she also felt that Zhang Fei was too reckless in doing such a thing.
Unlike them, Wan Jiang still didn’t show the slightest worry about him. "Xun’er, I want you to go to the Moonlit Passion Sect and join them."
"Huh?" Wan Jiang’s sudden decision surprised Helian Xun’er and the others. "Why are you asking me to join them, Master?"
"Do you need to ask my reasons?" Wan Jiang responded, shaking his head. "However, you only need to go there during the opening ceremony in a month, and you can join them afterward."
"What if I join that sect too, Master?"
"No." Wan Jiang rejected Sima Yun. "I want you to return to our sect in the Peach Garden Domain, and you must inform our sect master to attend the ceremony if Zhang Fei sends the invitation."
"Master, what—"

"Yes." Wan Jiang nodded to Helian Xun’er directly. "We’ve all seen Zhang Fei’s actions in this tower many times, and we also know quite a lot about the abilities of the people around him. Moreover, he has Empress Huo and the Eternal Flame by his side, so building a positive relationship with him and the Moonlit Passion Sect is our best option, and this is our best opportunity to do so."
"I will return to our sect now." Sima Yun immediately ran to the location of the portal to the Paradise Realm.
Hua Mei’er then spoke. "Master, I will return to our domain, but I will not stay in our sect, and I will go to see my big sister directly."
"Go now." Hua Mei’er immediately left Wan Jiang and Helian Xun’er. "Xun’er, I wish you the best."
"Thank you, master."

We’ve both heard reports from our members who met him in the Forbidden Land months ago that he has a connection with the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling, so I believe he’ll be fine with her protection."
"I hope that’s true."
"Let’s go back now, or Jia Zizhen will be suspicious of us."
"Yeah."
"What brought you two here, Princess Wangzi and Prince Huanzi?" Wan Jiang asked the two demons, who had just arrived.
Sima Yun, Helian Xun’er, and Hua Mei’er also looked at them with unfriendly gazes.
"Senior, we didn’t come here to cause trouble, and we only wanted to find out information about our little sister." Nalan Huanzi was the first to answer.
Nalan Wangzi then explained.
"Our mother discovered that Yushu has come back to life, but she hasn’t contacted her or returned to our territory.
Since you were the one in charge of this tower, she believes you know something about the person who freed her soul and helped her reshape her body, and we hope you can tell us about it."

"Someone did free your sister’s soul from this tower, but unfortunately, I promised someone else not to reveal her savior’s identity to anyone." Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi narrowed their eyes at Wan Jiang, but they still didn’t dare to be impudent in front of him.
"Actually, your sister and her savior are already in our realm, but I don’t know their current location because I haven’t met them again."
"What do you think about that, Brother?" Nalan Wangzi asked.
Nalan Huanzi shook his head slightly.
"Since they are in our realm, and Yuzhu has reshaped her body, I’m sure she will return to us sooner or later.
Moreover, we both know her character, and I think she’s having fun somewhere out there, especially since her soul has been imprisoned in this tower for so long.
Therefore, we don’t need to bother looking for her, and she will come back by herself after she’s had enough fun."
"Yeah." Nalan Wangzi then asked Wan Jiang.
"Does Tian Qiye know about this matter, Senior?"

"Not a single cultivator from our realm knows that your sister’s soul has been freed." Wan Jiang’s answer relieved Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi; they were afraid that Tian Qiye would find their sister, and Nalan Yushu would die again if that happened.
"Leave and wait for her return."
"We will leave now, Senior."
After the two left, Hua Mei’er immediately spoke.
"Master, my big sister told me that Nalan Shizhe met Zhang Fei in the Forbidden Land more than half a year ago, but she was unaware that her daughter was with him."
"You’re as stupid as ever, Mei’er!" Hua Mei’er looked at Sima Yun with a furious look.
"Do you know how long it takes to reshape our body?
At that time, Nalan Yushu was obviously not there with Zhang Fei, so it was natural that she was not aware that he was related to her daughter."
Helian Xun’er shook her head at Hua Mei’er.
"Mei’er, you are so old now, so you have to use your brain every time you speak.
Moreover, you are an experienced cultivator, and people will laugh at you if you always act foolish and childish."
"Humph!" Hua Mei’er snorted at the two.
Helian Xun’er then spoke to her master.
"I still find it hard to believe that Zhang Fei has already broken through to the Five Celestial Realms, but what shocks me the most is his current bone age, especially since he is aging so quickly.
Moreover, he achieved it only a few years after he arrived in our realm, and all his breakthroughs caused a lot of commotion there, especially his breakthrough in the Moon Illusion Domain.
He may still be safe now, but those old fogeys will target him sooner or later."
"Do you think they would dare to do that, Xun’er?" Unlike his disciple, Wan Jiang is not the least bit worried about Zhang Fei.
"Did you forget about the information Hua Xiang’er gave Mei’er?
Empress Huo Yanling and the Eternal Flame have returned, and both of them are by his side now.
No sane person would dare attack him, or they would end up facing both of them."
Helian Xun’er nodded in agreement.
"If they—"
"My big sister just sent me a new message about Zhang Fei, Master." Wan Jiang and his other two disciples turned to Hua Mei’er directly.
"As you all know, he joined the Moonlit Passion Sect and became an elder in the sect.

He carried out his previous plan to transform the sect into a universal one, and he sent out invitations to many cultivators from various domains to attend the opening ceremony of his new sect in a month."
"Insane!
Did Zhang Fei want to commit suicide?
Why would he do something like that?" Sima Yun let out an ear-splitting scream.
"If he appeared now, those people would definitely attack him and his sect.
Even if Empress Huo Yanling and the Eternal Flame protected him, they wouldn’t be able to protect him from his many enemies."
Helian Xun’er nodded in agreement with Sima Yun, and she also felt that Zhang Fei was too reckless in doing such a thing.
Unlike them, Wan Jiang still didn’t show the slightest worry about him.
"Xun’er, I want you to go to the Moonlit Passion Sect and join them."
"Huh?" Wan Jiang’s sudden decision surprised Helian Xun’er and the others.
"Why are you asking me to join them, Master?"
"Do you need to ask my reasons?" Wan Jiang responded, shaking his head.
"However, you only need to go there during the opening ceremony in a month, and you can join them afterward."
"What if I join that sect too, Master?"
"No." Wan Jiang rejected Sima Yun.
"I want you to return to our sect in the Peach Garden Domain, and you must inform our sect master to attend the ceremony if Zhang Fei sends the invitation."
"Master, what—"
"Yes." Wan Jiang nodded to Helian Xun’er directly.
"We’ve all seen Zhang Fei’s actions in this tower many times, and we also know quite a lot about the abilities of the people around him.

Moreover, he has Empress Huo and the Eternal Flame by his side, so building a positive relationship with him and the Moonlit Passion Sect is our best option, and this is our best opportunity to do so."
"I will return to our sect now." Sima Yun immediately ran to the location of the portal to the Paradise Realm.
Hua Mei’er then spoke.
"Master, I will return to our domain, but I will not stay in our sect, and I will go to see my big sister directly."
"Go now." Hua Mei’er immediately left Wan Jiang and Helian Xun’er.
"Xun’er, I wish you the best."
"Thank you, master."

chapters.title: Chapter 1177: Ceremony Day
paragraphs: Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi had already returned to their domain, and they reported to their mother, leaving Nalan Shizhe disappointed that the old man was unwilling to tell them the truth. "Where are you now, Yushu? Who exactly is your savior? Why didn’t you come back to us right away?"
"Mother, our father just contacted me, so I will go see him now." After Nalan Shizhe agreed, Nalan Huanzi left her room.

Noticing that Nalan Shizhe was sad, Nalan Wangzi hugged her from behind. "I know you’re worried about my sister, but Wan Jiang said that no one knows that someone has freed her soul and helped her reshape her body, so you don’t need to worry so much. Yushu is probably having fun out there after being imprisoned in the tower for so long, and I believe she will return to us once she’s had her fill."

"I know." Nalan Shizhe turned to face her first daughter. "Your little sister is always like that, and she never stopped making me worry about her. She has indeed succeeded in reshaping her body; however, her cultivation must have significantly regressed after her death. I don’t know who saved her, but she should return to us immediately, and I will provide the best demon resources to help her recover her cultivation."

Nalan Wangzi sighed inwardly. "Mother, I understand your good intentions for Yushu, but we can’t do anything because we don’t know her whereabouts. For now, we just need to wait for her to return, and we’ll help her recover her cultivation then."
"Yeah." Nalan Shizhe then asked her. "How is your relationship with Mo Taizi?"

"Nothing has changed." Nalan Wangzi shared some details with her mother, which made Nalan Shizhe frown. "Mother, I understand your wishes, but Mo Taizi and I have never liked each other. He was only willing to have a relationship with me because of his father’s insistence, and I accepted him because I would rather not put you under Mo Shentian’s pressure. Therefore, our relationship was always stagnant, and we didn’t know whether it would change or not."

Nalan Shizhe wanted to say something to her first daughter, but a woman suddenly appeared, and she reported several things to the two. "Demon God, the people of the Blazing Nirvana Domain have started to move, and they slaughtered many people, whether they were humans, beasts, or demons, which caused mass panic in many domains."
"Hmm?" Nalan Shizhe and Nalan Wangzi were shocked to hear that, but they remembered that Feng Yao had returned. "Have the other demon races made any moves to deal with this situation?"
"None of them have moved yet, Demon God."
"Leave and let them kill our members as they have targeted."
"Yes, Demon God."
"Are you really going to let those people kill our members, Mother?"

Nalan Shizhe nodded to her eldest daughter. "Empress Huo is not a cold-blooded killer, and she would never order her subordinates to kill any innocents. Furthermore, many of our members exhibit arrogance and foolishness, ignoring my warning to never touch her people. Therefore, I will use this situation to purge them, and those people will do it for me."
"I see." Nalan Wangzi nodded in understanding, but another woman suddenly appeared and handed an invitation to her mother. "What is this invitation?"

Nalan Shizhe hurriedly opened it and read the contents. "The Moonlit Passion Temple? Why do they invite us to attend their event? Aren’t they afraid that the other cultivators will brand them as heretics?"
"Didn’t you meet them in the Forbidden Land before, Mother? Did you hear anything about those people there?"

Nalan Wangzi’s questions made Nalan Shizhe look back on her memories of that time. "I heard that Qing Qiu’er accepted a young man into her sect and appointed him an elder; he has a close relationship with Empress Huo and the Eternal Flame."

"What’s his name? Could it be that Qing Qiu’er invited us because of that man? Moreover, her sect was a dual cultivation sect, but she suddenly turned it into a universal sect." Nalan Wangzi tampak penasaran tentang itu.

Nalan Shizhe then told her first daughter some things about Zhang Fei based on what she saw and heard when they were in the Forbidden Land, leaving Nalan Wangzi even more curious. "I think Qing Qiu’er decided it was because of him, but I don’t understand their reason for inviting us, especially since we don’t have any relationship with them."

"Since they’ve invited you, I think you should attend the event, and I will accompany you at that time, Mother." Nalan Shizhe raised an eyebrow at the curious look on Nalan Wangzi’s face. "Why are you looking at me like that? Is it wrong for me to be curious about a young god-rank sword master like him?"
Nalan Shizhe shook her head slightly. "Alright, we will attend the event together."
"Haha." Nalan Wangzi softly laughed and turned to leave. "I will continue my seclusion until next month, Mother."
Nalan Shizhe thought for a while before walking to the balcony, and she immediately flew away to check on some things.
"What brought you here, Futian?" Ye Mingran, who was lying on the sofa, asked lazily.

"Empress Huo ordered her subordinates from the Blazing Nirvana Domain to take action, and they slaughtered many people from several races, including many members of our race." Ye Mingran hurriedly sat up and stared at Ye Futian in shock. "Additionally, my grand-disciple contacted me earlier and told me that Zhang Fei invited us to attend the opening ceremony of the new Moonlite Temple Sect."

"What do you mean by the new Moonlite Temple Sect?" Confused, Ye Mingran asked Ye Futian to explain the situation. "Why did he invite us? Is he thinking of doing something against us with the help of Empress Huo and the Eternal Flame? We have no relationship or problems whatsoever, so it’s natural for me to suspect his intentions, right?"
Ye Futian shook his head. "You’re wrong about that, Mingran. According to Han Ling, Zhang Fei wants to gather all races in his sect—humans, demons, natural races, beasts, and winged races."

"Hmm?" Ye Mingran frowned. "Why would he want to do such a troublesome thing? It is impossible for all races to unite, especially our demon races and the winged race. Even if this universe is destroyed, our two races will never be able to reconcile."
"We can only find out the answer by attending the event."
"Did Zhang Fei invite the other demon races?"
"Han Ling told me that Zhang Fei only invited us and Nalan Shizhe."

Ye Mingran was not surprised to hear Zhang Fei inviting Nalan Shizhe, especially since she already knew his relationship with Nalan Yushu. "Inform your grand-disciple that we will be attending the event."
"Alright."
Ye Mingran lay on her sofa again, wondering about Zhang Fei’s reason for inviting her. "Let’s see later, then."

The other eight demon gods were furious after receiving reports from their respective subordinates about the actions of the women from Blazing Nirvana Mountain. Some of the demon gods moved to confront the women, but the women told them to find Feng Yao in the Blazing Nirvana Domain if they objected to their actions.

The demon gods shut their mouths upon hearing this, especially since they still remembered Feng Yao’s past strength, even though thousands of years had passed. They didn’t immediately go to meet her, and they chose to think about it first while observing the changes in the situation.
Humans and beast races also faced the same situation as the demon races, and Feng Yao’s subordinates slaughtered many people of both races.
The humans chose to avoid those people and not escalate the conflict, and they let Feng Yao’s subordinates kill the people they wanted.

Long Wuzhao immediately contacted Feng Yao to stop her subordinates, but she refused his request and threatened to kill more if he tried to stop them. He wanted to meet her, but she also refused and asked him to meet at the Moonlit Passion Temple in a month.

In the Pavilion, Zhang Fei [1] explained to all the women there about the Endless Night Dungeon, and all of them seemed eager to test their abilities in the domain. However, they were aware that the situation there would be dangerous if the experienced senior cultivators from the Paradise Realm also entered the place, so they chose to follow the plans laid out by their husband.

Moreover, they still have a month before the dungeon appears, which is equivalent to four months in the training space. After their discussion, they resumed their seclusion, especially those who hadn’t yet broken through to the Five Celestial Realms.

In the outside world, the elders of the Moonlit Passion Sect were busy traveling to various domains, visiting sects and clans to invite them to their sect opening ceremony. Many of them explicitly rejected their invitations, especially the supreme sects and clans.
Zhang Fei [5] had already told them not to force those sects and clans, as he believed they would regret rejecting his invitation, especially since he had prepared many special things for that event.

Time passed quickly, and another month had elapsed. Since midnight, the people of the Moonlit Passion Sect, both elders and disciples, have been busy preparing to welcome the guests who will arrive in the morning.
The first guests to arrive were not people from the Twin Flames Domain; instead, they were a group from the Empyrean Main Domain, led by Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi.

chapters.title: Chapter 1178: Family Reunion
paragraphs: "This sect has changed a lot compared to the last time I came here." Huang Xiaoyi spoke as she surveyed the area around the floating plateau from the air.

Luo Fenghan smiled bitterly upon hearing this, especially since the last time Huang Xiaoyi visited the Moonlit Passion Sect was hundreds of years ago, which was because he was affected by Qing Qiu’er’s abilities. "Our son-in-law wasn’t joking; he completely overhauled it."
"Who are those people, Sect Master Luo?" A woman in her early thirties asked Luo Fenghan a question while pointing to several people below them.

The woman has a mature, serious but pale face. Her lips were covered in a bold shade of red. Her eyes were sharp and slanted, framed by long dark lashes, and her gaze carried calmness. Her dark hair was swept back neatly, decorated with an ornate little golden crown. She has a slim, tall, and strong build. She wore a black and gold outfit, crafted with intricate details and patterns that emphasized her modest and firm breasts.

Luo Fenghan turned to her. "They are people that my son-in-law brought from the Three Mortal Realms, Nong Qinwei. They are not just humans but also many mythical beasts, like dragons, phoenixes, vermilion birds, and several other races."

"Those two women are demon foxes, right?" Nong Qinwei, the Sect Master of the Hidden Moon Sect, pointed at Tian Gongzhu and Tian Jianxia, who were standing in front of the Medical Hall along with several others.

"You’re right, Sect Master Nong." Huang Xiaoyi answered her. "If I recall correctly, they were Tian Gongzhu and Tian Jianxia. They were originally ordinary foxes, but our son-in-law turned them into demons, mainly because their race wanted to kill him."
"Oh." Nong Qinwei tilted her head to the side. "Did you meet them before, Yin Chang?"
Yin Chang, the Vice Sect Master of the Hidden Moon Sect, shook her head. "Back then, Zhang Fei summoned many beasts, but he didn’t summon those two, Big Sis."
"I see." Nong Qinwei then asked Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi again. "Does Zhang Fei intend to accept demons in this sect?"

Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi exchanged glances for a moment before nodding. Not all demons are evil, and many of them are more righteous than self-proclaimed righteous cultivators, like the winged race. He will accept everyone in this sect regardless of their races."

"Yes." Nong Qinwei didn’t deny it. "Do you think Zhang Fei will succeed in uniting all the races in this sect? Cultivators like us might not think it, but many cultivators out there will despise him and this sect, and they might consider this sect a heretic sect."
"Only time can tell, Sect Master Nong."

Nong Qinwei nodded slightly before looking at Qing Qiu’er, who was flying toward them. "Welcome to our sect, Sect Masters and Clan Leaders. Since you’ve arrived ahead of schedule, you’ll have to wait for the other guests to arrive first. Shall I lead you on a tour of our new sect? For the past seven months, we’ve built many new things to transform this sect."
"Where is Zhang Fei, Sect Master Qing?" Ma Kuangyu asked.
"Over there." Qing Qiu’er pointed toward the back of the mountain. "That place is covered by a special barrier now; only he and those closest to him can enter."
"I’ll go see him first." Ma Kuangyu directly flew there.

"Please lead us, Sect Master Qing." Huang Xiaoyi furiously glared at Luo Fenghan, making him laugh bitterly in his heart. ’Tch! We’re already an old couple, and Qing Qiu’er is Zhang Fei’s partner now, but she’s still jealous of her.’

Qing Qiu’er naturally noticed Huang Xiaoyi’s reaction, but she said nothing and led them to look over the results of rebuilding their sect. She explained to them about the functions of each hall, including the people who were in charge of them.

What surprised them most was the presence of Tian Huangjin, Tian Huotian, and Tian Zhiling in the medical hall. Moreover, Qing Qiu’er informed them that the three had decided to join their sect, and they would be in charge of the hall alongside Elmyra and several others.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately came out as soon as he sensed Ma Kuangyu’s presence. "I went away to reshape my body for a few years, and you gave me a lot of surprises once I came back, kid."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed and hugged Ma Kuangyu for a moment. "Congratulations! You’re alive again now, Old Ma. As I promised, I will remove my soul mark from your soul, and you will no longer be bound to me."

"You don’t have to do that, kid." That confused Zhang Fei [5], but Ma Kuangyu patted his shoulder and clarified. "We’ve been together for decades, and we’re more than just friends now. Moreover, your soul mark isn’t a slave mark, so I don’t mind it. By the way, are you ready to face many obstacles? Your decision today will attract the attention of many people, especially those greedy and arrogant old cultivators. With their character and disposition, I’m sure they will bring you a lot of trouble in the future."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. Old Ma, you have lived with me for such a long time, so you should already be familiar with my character, right? I’m not doing all this to show off, but I have no other choice if I want to build my strength in this realm. Unlike in the Three Mortal Realms, I can’t waste time here, and I have to move faster. Otherwise, I will continue to be several steps behind them, and I will have difficulty building my strength. Eventually, those people will find out about me. If they’re truly jealous of me, they’ll definitely attack me and this sect for whatever reason, and my actions today will only speed things up."

"That’s true," Ma Kuangyu then told him something else. "I’ve met and discussed with several members of my Ma Clan, and I’ve also spoken with Zhuang Qihong before. Starting today, our two clans will join your sect, and we will move them here soon."

Zhang Fei [5] was quite surprised to hear that, but he was thrilled that the Ma and Zhuang Clans joined them, especially since both clans were much stronger than his people. "I think that’s good, and I will ask the giants to construct a new area where your two clans will reside."

"Alright." Ma Kuangyu and Zhang Fei [5] suddenly sensed two powerful auras heading toward their sect, and they immediately looked outside the barrier, where two people had just arrived. "Aren’t they—"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "I’ll meet them first, and you can explore the other areas of the floating plateau to choose a good location for your Ma Clan and the Zhuang Clan."

"Our son-in-law wasn’t joking; he completely overhauled it."

Her lips were covered in a bold shade of red.
Her eyes were sharp and slanted, framed by long dark lashes, and her gaze carried calmness.
Her dark hair was swept back neatly, decorated with an ornate little golden crown.
She has a slim, tall, and strong build.
She wore a black and gold outfit, crafted with intricate details and patterns that emphasized her modest and firm breasts.

"They are people that my son-in-law brought from the Three Mortal Realms, Nong Qinwei.

"If I recall correctly, they were Tian Gongzhu and Tian Jianxia.

"Oh." Nong Qinwei tilted her head to the side.

He will accept everyone in this sect regardless of their races."

chapters.title: Chapter 1179: Open Challenge
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5], accompanied by You Feiling and the female elders, welcomed the guests who were starting to arrive.

The first to arrive were Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue, the two Sect Masters of the Sun Moon Sect. They were annoyed and amazed to see the changes on the floating plateau, which used to be sparsely populated with buildings but was now full of buildings. Moreover, almost the entire area is lush with trees, making the atmosphere there much more comfortable than before.

Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue frowned when they detected another barrier besides the original barrier, but they couldn’t see it because it was created by Bing Xingying using her void element, and it was completely transparent.
"Welcome to our sect."
Both Chi Hongchen and Guang Yue immediately looked at Zhang Fei [5] and the others. "So, you are the new elder who gave Qing Qiu’er the idea to turn it into a universal sect?"

"That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "I am a dual cultivator myself, so I understand that dual cultivation sects will never be able to rival the other sects. Therefore, I propose that we transform this sect into a universal one while still retaining our dual cultivation hall for those who wish to pursue that path.

"You are absolutely right about that." Chi Hongchen nodded in agreement. "Most dual cultivators don’t care much about other cultivation paths, and they are more focused on pursuing higher cultivation to achieve a longer life, which makes them weak in true combat. Even so, many of them still pursue some other cultivation paths, like the two of us, and we also walk the sword and body Cultivation Paths."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Sword cultivation is the best solution for self-protection, and body cultivation is essentially a crucial part of dual cultivation. Since the event time is still quite long, Vice Sect Master You will lead the two of you to look around new areas of our sect first, and you will find many interesting things there."
"Alright." Chi Hongchen then looked at You Feiling. "Please lead us, Vice Sect Master You."
"Follow me."
The two guests immediately followed You Feiling, while Guang Yue glanced at Zhang Fei [5] several times and contemplated various thoughts.

Not long after, they saw three people flying toward that location. Fang Roulan informed Zhang Fei [5] directly. "They are the two sect masters of the Blazing Union Sect, Ming Tianhe and Qiu Meixuan. The woman behind them is a core disciple of their sect, Ru Xian. Her status is a bit different from the other disciples, especially since she is also Sect Master Ming’s partner."

"Elder Zhang, you have to be careful of Ming Tianhe." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Qiu Yue. "That man is infatuated with Sect Master Qing, and he might do something crazy if he finds out that you are his partner."

"I think he already knows about our relationship." Zhang Fei [5] could already see the hatred and jealousy in Ming Tianhe’s eyes even though the three of them were still quite far away; he didn’t even bother to hide his killing intent.
Before long, the three arrived in front of them. Qiu Meixuan looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a flirtatious gaze and a seductive smile, unlike Meng Tianhe, who regarded him with hostility.

Naturally, Zhang Fei [5] was not interested in a woman belonging to the streets like Qiu Meixuan. He didn’t even spare a glance at her and spoke to Ming Tianhe directly. "Welcome to our new sect, Sect Master Ming. I understand why you are so hostile toward me, but Qing Qiu’er is mine. I will never hand her over to anyone, so you can forget about her and stop acting like this."

Qiu Yue and all the women there were stunned by Zhang Fei [5]’s boldness, especially since his cultivation was still at the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, and Ming Tianhe’s cultivation had reached the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.

Although she was initially annoyed that Zhang Fei [5] ignored her, the corners of Qiu Meixuan’s lips lifted slightly after she said that. ’Haha! He’s still young, but he has the guts to openly challenge Tianhe!’
"Hmm?" Ming Tianhe narrowed his eyes. "What can you do to me with your weak cultivation? I don’t care if Qing Qiu’er is already your woman, but I want her, and I will definitely get her."

Zhang Fei [5] smiled faintly in response to that. "Sect Master Ming, your cultivation is indeed much higher than mine, but you are no different from other dual cultivators, and you are lacking in many things because your brain is only filled with sex."
"Pftt! Hahaha!" Qiu Yue and all the female elders laughed when they heard that.
Qiu Meixuan almost laughed because of Zhang Fei [5]’s words, but she suppressed her laughter so as not to make Ming Tianhe enraged. ’This kid! I want to see how far he dares to challenge Tianhe.’

Ru Xian looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a faint smile on her face, especially since she had never met anyone who dared to so blatantly challenge Ming Tianhe; even the families of his victims never dared to do that.

Ming Tianhe’s face turned red and black with anger, especially since the female elders kept laughing at him. However, Zhang Fei [5] immediately activated his sword, soul, and dual cultivation domains at the same time, shocking not only him but also Qiu Meixuan and Ru Xian. ’Three domains at once!’
Ming Tianhe, Qiu Meixuan, and Ru Xian frowned as they sensed that their Qi was flowing out by itself and entering Zhang Fei [5]’s body, followed by a strong pressure on their souls.

Zhang Fei [5] did not stop there, and he created several swords made of Qi, pointing them at Ming Tianhe. "Do you understand the difference between us, Sect Master Ming? Your cultivation is indeed high, but you are not a fighter cultivator like me. Even if you can suppress me with your high cultivation, I am still superior in real combat, and I am fully confident in defeating you in a one-on-one fight."

Ming Tianhe clenched both of his fists tightly and wanted to attack Zhang Fei [5], but Serpentera and Tian Kui suddenly appeared on both sides of them, and their cultivation greatly shocked him and his two women. ’Since when does this sect have such powerful guardian beasts?’

Zhang Fei [5] canceled his three domains and spoke to him. "Today is the opening ceremony of our new sect, so I would rather not spoil it with a fight. If you are still interested in attending our event, Elder Hua Xiang will lead the three of you to look around our new areas while waiting for the other guests to arrive."
"Let’s go, Tianhe! I’m curious about the changes in this sect." Qiu Meixuan took Meng Tianhe’s hand. "Elder Hua, please show us around."
"Please follow me." Hua Xiang immediately flew away, followed by Ru Xian and Qiu Meixuan, who pulled Ming Tianhe along.
"Hahaha!" Tian Kui laughed after they left. "You are truly bold, master. However, that man is indeed weak despite his high cultivation, and I’m sure you can defeat him in just a few moves."

Serpentera nodded in agreement. "In fact, the people from the Yin-Yang Pavilion you brought with you are much better than that man, Master. If their cultivation is equal, I believe they will have no trouble defeating him."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "That’s why I didn’t hold myself back, and I openly challenged him. If he still thinks about snatching Qing Qiu’er from me, I won’t have any qualms about beating or killing him."

"I think you should beat him up and take his sect from him, Master." Tian Kui then pointed toward the Blazing Union Sect. "There’s a Yang Celestial Lake in their sect, which would greatly benefit you and everyone close to you."

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I do want to obtain the Yang Celestial Lake, but this isn’t the right time to do so, especially since this sect is about to begin a new era. If I attack them now, the cultivators in this domain will probably join forces to attack us directly."

"It’s the opening day of your new sect, but you’re already thinking of such a thing." Zhang Fei [5] and the others looked at Feng Yao, who had just appeared with Feng Tian, Feng Jiu, and three other women.

Their attire made Mei Ruyan and the remaining female elders gasp in shock. ’What are the people from the Blazing Nirvana Sect doing in our sect? Could it be that the woman leading them is the famous Empress Huo Yanling? I heard the people from that domain would never move without her, but they are here now.’

"Girls, he is Zhang Fei." Feng Yao then introduced her three subordinates to him. "They are Huo Lanyin, Huo Hao’er, and Huo Yu’er. Lanyin is the best female alchemist in this realm, Hao’er is more interested in artifacts and ruins, and Yu’er is more interested in arrays."
All the female elders held their breath after Feng Yao introduced the three women, making them even more certain that she was Empress Huo Yanling.
"Zhang Fei, I want to compete in alchemy with you today." Huo Lanyin suddenly issued a challenge.
"As expected." Huo Hao’er and Huo Yu’er shook their heads. "Sister Lanyin’s spirit flares up every time she meets a skilled alchemist."
