chapters.title: Chapter 1180: Two Demon Gods’ Arrival
paragraphs: "Senior Huo, I want to compete in alchemy with you, but we don’t have time today." Zhang Fei [5] pointed towards the sky, where the two suns and the two moons appeared together. "The two moons will fully align tonight, and—"
"The Endless Night Dungeon will appear tonight." Feng Yao continued his words.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Once the opening ceremony is over, we must prepare to enter the dungeon. Therefore, we cannot compete today, and we will do so after we leave that place."
"Alright, I’ll wait." Huo Lanyin replied, nodding slightly.

"What is the Endless Night Dungeon, Yao’er?" Feng Yao explained to her parents about the dungeon and the challenges they would face in it. "So, it would be optimal for female cultivators to explore it, right?"

"Not really." Feng Yao shook her head in response. "Even though everything in the Endless Night Dungeon is directly related to Yin, there are some things that require the help of male cultivators. As long as your son-in-law is with us, we don’t have to worry about that. I won’t explain the details now, or it will take the fun away. You both need to be careful, as thousands, or even tens of thousands, of cultivators will participate in this event, and numerous traps could randomly transport us to different locations."
’Son... son-in-law!’ The female elders stammered in their hearts as they stole glances at Zhang Fei [5], not expecting that he was the husband of Empress Huo Yanling.

Both Feng Jiu and Feng Tian nodded to Feng Yao, but Zhang Fei [5] then asked her. "Who actually created the Endless Night Dungeon and the Zenith Sun Sanctum? Is the story about the two male twins and the two female twins real?"

"The story of the four of them is a true story, and it happened in the ancient era. However, they were not immortals as the story describes, and they were simply ordinary humans." Feng Yao’s answer shocked the female elders, especially since there had never been any concrete evidence to prove the story’s veracity before. She then told them the truth behind the story, shocking the female elders even more. "The Endless Night Dungeon and the Zenith Sun Sanctum have nothing to do with that story, and they were once the residences of members of the Silver Moon Clan and the Golden Sun Clan. Both clans were destroyed by a deadly disaster during that era, leaving their home to become mysterious dungeons for cultivators after their era. However, I don’t know how those two places relate to the two suns or moons."
Zhang Fei [5] didn’t think much about it and asked him again. "What about the statues of the female winged race and the male demon at the ends of the two rivers?"

"The Winged Race and Demon Race began their feud long since the era of Tian Huangjin and the Primordial Demon, and the two statues represent the last two of their races who were able to reach their peak." Feng Yao observed both locations before continuing. "They fought for hundreds of years until they died at each other’s hands, and ancient people built their statues to commemorate their fierce battle. The statues were originally built with their heads intact, but irresponsible people later destroyed them."
"Could it be that the perpetrators are people from the winged race and the demon race, Empress?" Huo Lanyin asked.
"It’s possible." Feng Yao then looked into the distance. "Did you invite those two female demon gods?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "I have personal matters with Nalan Shizhe, so I invited her here. As for Ye Mingran, I have some plans for her demon race."
Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "Father! Mother! You all enter the sect first, and I’ll accompany him to meet them."
Zhang Fei [5] asked the female elders to enter, and he also asked one of them to take Feng Jiu and the others to tour their sect.
"Master, send us to your beast space first." Tian Kui spoke.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately sent the two ancient beasts into his beast space, and he asked Han Ling to come out, especially since Ye Futian was his grandmaster.
Not long after Han Ling came out, Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe’s group arrived in front of them, and they brought their family with them.
"Senior Ye! Grandmaster!" Han Ling saluted Ye Mingran and Ye Futian, surprising the four young demons behind them.

Both of them nodded to Han Ling, but Ye Mingran briefly glanced at Feng Yao before asking Zhang Fei [5]. "What’s your reason for inviting us to your sect opening event? There’s no way you invited us just because of your master’s relationship with us, right?"
"Since my master has a relationship with you guys, I should be the same, right?" Zhang Fei [5] then cupped his hands to Ye Futian. "Great-grandmaster."

Ye Futian nodded at him, rubbing his long beard. "Actually, I would rather not come here because our presence would bring trouble for you, especially since you invited so many cultivators to attend your event. However, Little Han told me about your swordsmanship skills, and he also told me that you were more skilled than him in executing my Forgotten Sword Technique. Therefore, I decided to come, and I wanted to see your abilities in person."
"I’ll show you later, but we should go somewhere else to talk." Zhang Fei [5] enveloped them with his aura and took them to the back of the mountain.

Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyun, who were chatting with Jia Yuyan there, were momentarily surprised by the arrival of the two female demon gods and their families. However, they were not surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s decision to invite the demons, especially since their granddaughter had already explained everything to them.
Ye Futian and the two female demon gods were also surprised by the presence of the two seniors from the fairy race there, but they remembered that Zhang Fei [5] had connections with all the races.
"So, what is your purpose in inviting us here?" Nalan Shizhe asked without beating around the bush.
Just like their mother, Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi were also curious about Zhang Fei [5]’s reason for inviting them and the Endless Night Demon Race.

"You are my family, so I have to invite you to important events of my sect, right?" Zhang Fei [5]’s answer perplexed them, especially since it was clear that they didn’t have any relationship, let alone a familial relationship. "Wait a minute."

All the demons raised their eyebrows as soon as Zhang Fei [5] opened the portal to the training space, followed by gasps of shock from Nalan Shizhe, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Huanzi, especially after Nalan Yushu walked out from within.

Ye Mingran and Ye Futian exchanged glances for a moment; they did not expect that Nalan Yushu had already reformed her body. The four young demons behind them were shocked by her return, especially since they had never heard the news about it.
"Hehehe." Nalan Yushu giggled, looking at their reactions. "Mother! Big Brother! Big Sis! I’m back!"

Nalan Shizhe’s body trembled, and tears involuntarily dripped from the corners of his eyes. Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi looked shocked and excited to see their little sister again after tens of thousands of years, but they did not expect that she would be together with Zhang Fei [5].
Nalan Shizhe stretched out her hands, grabbed Nalan Yushu’s cheeks, and rubbed them. "Yushu... Yushu... is this really you?"
"Mother! It’s really me!" Nalan Yushu immediately hugged her mother tightly and began to sob. "I’m sorry; I’ve made you worry for tens of thousands of years, but I’m back now."

"Yushu..." Nalan Shizhe burst into tears as soon as she felt the warmth of her daughter’s body, and she hugged Nalan Yushu so tightly as if she was afraid of losing her again. "My daughter... you finally came back to me."
Nalan Yushu nodded slightly. "Yes, I’m back, Mother."

Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi also cried seeing their mother and little sister finally reunited after tens of thousands of years. They did not disturb the two and waited for them to vent their longings first. However, they noticed something different about their little sister’s body, and they immediately looked at Zhang Fei [5] in shock, especially after they discovered his Yang Qi inside her body.
Zhang Fei [5] naturally understood their reaction and nodded to them. "Yushu is my wife, so it’s only natural for me to call you guys my family, right?"
Nalan Shizhe heard that, but she couldn’t care less, and she focused more on expressing her longing for Nalan Yushu that had been buried deep in her heart for so long.

Ye Mingran, Ye Futian, and the four young demons behind them exchanged looks of shock, as they did not expect that Zhang Fei [5] and Nalan Yushu were already husband and wife, which meant he was part of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race.

Nalan Huanzi walked in front of Zhang Fei [5], grabbed his shoulders, and spoke to him. "I don’t know how your relationship with my little sister has reached this point, but I am truly grateful to you for freeing her soul from the tower, and you also helped her reshape her body."
"Me too." Nalan Wangzi stood by her brother’s side before grabbing Zhang Fei [5]’s hand. "Thank you for helping our sister come back to life and bringing her back to us."

chapters.title: Chapter 1181: Dragon Emperor’s Arrival
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Yushu is my wife, so you two don’t have to be like this. Moreover, it wasn’t me who helped her to collect those materials but my father-in-law, especially since I don’t have any power in this realm."
"Who is your father-in-law?"

"Luo Fenghan." Both of them were shocked to hear that name from Zhang Fei [5]. "He and my mother-in-law didn’t care that Yushu was a demon. Moreover, she wasn’t the only demon by my side, and there were many other female demons by my side."
"Are you serious about that? Do you really have many female demons by your side?" Nalan Huanzi asked in disbelief.
"Are they also your wives?"
Zhang Fei [5] could somehow see the disappointment in the look in Nalan Wangzi’s eyes. "They are my wives, and Yushu knows them very well, especially since she has lived with us for so many years."
"Where are they now? Why didn’t you bring them to the sect?"

Zhang Fei [5] answered Nalan Wangzi directly. "Their cultivation hasn’t broken through to the Five Celestial Realms yet, so I’ll wait for them to break through to that stage before bringing them here."
"Oh." Nalan Wangzi nodded slightly. "What made you decide to take a demon as your wife?"
Zhang Fei [5] responded to Nalan Wangzi by transforming into his lust demon form, which shocked the demons present because they had not sensed his demon aura before.
Ye Mingran observed him. "You are a lust demon form, but I have never seen one with nine tails."
"That’s true." Ye Futian nodded in agreement. "How can you hide your demon aura so neatly? We couldn’t sense it before you transformed, even though we were standing so close to each other."

"I never hide my demon aura, and it will disappear every time I use my human form." Ye Mingran and the others found it hard to believe Zhang Fei [5] because they had not sensed his demon aura prior to his transformation. He then returned to his human form and looked towards the distance. "More and more people are coming, but they are cultivators from this realm."
"They will arrive soon." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Yao directly. "Long Wuzhao and the others will arrive soon, so you should prepare to welcome them."

Ye Mingran had already witnessed Zhang Fei [5]’s closeness with Tianshi Shengjie when they attended the auction in the Forbidden Land, but she did not expect that he would invite Long Wuzhao and the others to attend the opening ceremony of his new sect.

"You guys don’t need to worry about them, especially since Long Wuzhao has been aware of my demon identity for a long time. He also knows that there are many demons on my side, and he doesn’t have any problem with that." They naturally knew that because the Golden Dragon Emperor never attacked demons directly, and he only attacked those who committed excessive crimes. "I’ll go out and wait for them to come."
After Zhang Fei [5] disappeared, Ye Mingran asked Feng Yao directly. "Are you really the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling?"

Ye Mingran’s question made all the demons’ eyes turn to Feng Yao, who smiled casually in response. "Why are you still asking questions you already know the answer to? Do you think the people from my Blazing Nirvana Domain will move without my presence?"
"No." Ye Mingran shook her head. "Will you always support Zhang Fei [5] in the future?"
"What do you think?" Feng Yao returned the question. "My parents already consider him their son-in-law, so—"
"What?" Yi Mingran and the others cried out in shock.

Even Nalan Shizhe, who was still enjoying her reunion with Nalan Yushu, immediately turned his gaze to Feng Yao. She was also shocked to hear that her parents considered Zhang Fei [5] as their son-in-law. "Is that true, Empress Huo?"

"She’s telling the truth, Mother," Nalan Yushu spoke. "They’ve known each other since Zhang Fei had just begun his cultivation path in the lower realms of the Three Mortal Realms. Even though they weren’t officially married yet, her parents already considered him their son-in-law, and they handed over their phoenix race to him."
"I see." Nalan Shizhe nodded in understanding.
Feng Yao smiled slightly before speaking to Ye Mingran and Ye Futian. "He invited Nalan Shizhe because of Nalan Yushu, and he invited you two because of Ye Zhiye."
"What?" Ye Futian screamed when he heard his daughter’s name. "Is my daughter also with him, Empress Huo? Where is she now?"

Feng Yao shook her head before answering. "Your daughter married Shang Xiuluo a long time ago, and they’re hiding in another domain now, mainly because your demon race and the Asura Demon Race want to capture them. Actually, they were with us in the Forbidden Land back then, but they left as soon as Ye Mingran and the others arrived there."
"Then—"

"Ye Futian, I’ve never liked meddling in other people’s affairs, but I want you to forget your personal issues with the Asura Demon Race and accept their relationship." Ye Futian wanted to refute her, but Feng Yao directly released a bit of her aura, causing him to feel a chill down his spine. "They sincerely love each other, so it would be too stupid if you insisted on separating them. If you kill Shang Xiuluo, I dare to guarantee that Ye Zhiye will commit suicide directly, and you will lose her forever. Furthermore, they have a close relationship with Zhang Fei, and he wants them to help him to develop this sect. If you insist on that matter, I will kill you myself."

Feng Yao’s threat not only caused fear in Ye Futian but also in Ye Mingran and their four juniors. "Futian, I think Empress Huo is right. Ye Zhiye and Shang Xiuluo have been missing for so long, so I’m sure their feelings have become very deep now. If we forcefully separate them because of our issues with the Asura Demon Race, you will lose your daughter forever."
"Yeah." Ye Futian then asked Feng Yao. "Are they coming to the sect, Empress Huo?"
Feng Yao nodded at him. "Zhang Fei invited them, but I don’t know when they’ll come, so you have to wait."

"Phew," Ye Futian exhaled softly. "Tens of thousands of years have passed since they fled this realm, and I’ve searched for them repeatedly in the Three Mortal Realms in the past. Unfortunately, I never managed to find them, but they eventually returned on their own."
"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed. "If it weren’t for Zhang Fei, they definitely wouldn’t have returned to this realm, and you would have had to wait even longer to meet your daughter."
Ye Futian nodded slightly. "I hope they will arrive soon."
"Be patient." Feng Yao then looked at the four young eternal night demons. "Who are they?"

Ye Mingran pushed a young man and a young woman forward. "These are my children, Ye Xiufeng and Ye Nichang, whom I brought here to take a look at this sect. The other two are Ye Xuan and Ye Yuanzhi, and I brought them here to join this sect."

"I see." Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "I won’t meddle in this sect’s affairs, even though I’m close to Zhang Fei, so you should ask him about them. I will also help him, but I will only do it if he is in a critical situation because I don’t want him to depend on me."

’Even if you don’t help him directly, people won’t dare to trouble him if they know about your relationship,’ Ye Mingran inwardly muttered. "Are you sure his decision will not bring him trouble, Empress Huo?"

"Trouble will always be a part of life for cultivators, but Zhang Fei [5] has already decided his path. Although many problems will stand in his way after today, I believe he will overcome them all." Feng Yao then looked far away. "They finally arrived."
Just as Feng Yao said that, Ye Mingran and the others felt a powerful aura enter the realm, and they immediately recognized its owner. "Long Wuzhao!"

Zhang Fei [5], who was standing high up in the sky while checking the identities of the cultivators who were arriving, also noticed Long Wuzhao’s arrival. ’Sigh! I actually never expected him to come, but he’s here now, and he brought others with him.’
Long Wuzhao and his party immediately stopped as soon as Zhang Fei [5] appeared in front of them. "We finally meet, Golden Dragon Emperor."

"Hahaha." Long Wuzhao laughed and floated before Zhang Fei [5]. "I’ve heard a lot about you from Little Tianshi, but I didn’t believe her at first, especially the story about you aging rapidly. However, we’ve met now, and I can check on you myself to confirm the truth."

Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Tianshi Shengjie, who was sticking out her tongue from a distance. He observed Tianshi Bailong for a moment before replying to Long Wuzhao. "Like you and all other cultivators, I have my secrets, but I won’t tell you about them."

"Haha." Long Wuzhao laughed again as he grabbed Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulder. "I’m not interested in your secrets, and I’m more interested in your progress. Honestly, my brothers and I want to test your current abilities ourselves, but it looks like we won’t be able to do so today, especially since the twin moons will be fully aligned tonight."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "Let’s talk in my sect."

Feng Yao smiled slightly before speaking to Ye Mingran and Ye Futian.
"He invited Nalan Shizhe because of Nalan Yushu, and he invited you two because of Ye Zhiye."
"What?" Ye Futian screamed when he heard his daughter’s name.
"Is my daughter also with him, Empress Huo?
Where is she now?"
Feng Yao shook her head before answering.
"Your daughter married Shang Xiuluo a long time ago, and they’re hiding in another domain now, mainly because your demon race and the Asura Demon Race want to capture them.
Actually, they were with us in the Forbidden Land back then, but they left as soon as Ye Mingran and the others arrived there."
"Then—"

"Ye Futian, I’ve never liked meddling in other people’s affairs, but I want you to forget your personal issues with the Asura Demon Race and accept their relationship." Ye Futian wanted to refute her, but Feng Yao directly released a bit of her aura, causing him to feel a chill down his spine.
"They sincerely love each other, so it would be too stupid if you insisted on separating them.
If you kill Shang Xiuluo, I dare to guarantee that Ye Zhiye will commit suicide directly, and you will lose her forever.
Furthermore, they have a close relationship with Zhang Fei, and he wants them to help him to develop this sect.
If you insist on that matter, I will kill you myself."
Feng Yao’s threat not only caused fear in Ye Futian but also in Ye Mingran and their four juniors.
"Futian, I think Empress Huo is right.
Ye Zhiye and Shang Xiuluo have been missing for so long, so I’m sure their feelings have become very deep now.
If we forcefully separate them because of our issues with the Asura Demon Race, you will lose your daughter forever."
"Yeah." Ye Futian then asked Feng Yao.
"Are they coming to the sect, Empress Huo?"
Feng Yao nodded at him.
"Zhang Fei invited them, but I don’t know when they’ll come, so you have to wait."
"Phew," Ye Futian exhaled softly.
"Tens of thousands of years have passed since they fled this realm, and I’ve searched for them repeatedly in the Three Mortal Realms in the past.
Unfortunately, I never managed to find them, but they eventually returned on their own."
"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed.
"If it weren’t for Zhang Fei, they definitely wouldn’t have returned to this realm, and you would have had to wait even longer to meet your daughter."
Ye Futian nodded slightly.
"I hope they will arrive soon."
"Be patient." Feng Yao then looked at the four young eternal night demons.
"Who are they?"
Ye Mingran pushed a young man and a young woman forward.
"These are my children, Ye Xiufeng and Ye Nichang, whom I brought here to take a look at this sect.
The other two are Ye Xuan and Ye Yuanzhi, and I brought them here to join this sect."
"I see." Feng Yao nodded in understanding.
"I won’t meddle in this sect’s affairs, even though I’m close to Zhang Fei, so you should ask him about them.
I will also help him, but I will only do it if he is in a critical situation because I don’t want him to depend on me."
’Even if you don’t help him directly, people won’t dare to trouble him if they know about your relationship,’ Ye Mingran inwardly muttered.
"Are you sure his decision will not bring him trouble, Empress Huo?"
"Trouble will always be a part of life for cultivators, but Zhang Fei [5] has already decided his path.
Although many problems will stand in his way after today, I believe he will overcome them all." Feng Yao then looked far away.
"They finally arrived."
Just as Feng Yao said that, Ye Mingran and the others felt a powerful aura enter the realm, and they immediately recognized its owner.
"Long Wuzhao!"
Zhang Fei [5], who was standing high up in the sky while checking the identities of the cultivators who were arriving, also noticed Long Wuzhao’s arrival. ’Sigh!
I actually never expected him to come, but he’s here now, and he brought others with him.’
Long Wuzhao and his party immediately stopped as soon as Zhang Fei [5] appeared in front of them.
"We finally meet, Golden Dragon Emperor."
"Hahaha." Long Wuzhao laughed and floated before Zhang Fei [5].
"I’ve heard a lot about you from Little Tianshi, but I didn’t believe her at first, especially the story about you aging rapidly.
However, we’ve met now, and I can check on you myself to confirm the truth."
Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Tianshi Shengjie, who was sticking out her tongue from a distance.
He observed Tianshi Bailong for a moment before replying to Long Wuzhao.
"Like you and all other cultivators, I have my secrets, but I won’t tell you about them."
"Haha." Long Wuzhao laughed again as he grabbed Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulder.
"I’m not interested in your secrets, and I’m more interested in your progress.
Honestly, my brothers and I want to test your current abilities ourselves, but it looks like we won’t be able to do so today, especially since the twin moons will be fully aligned tonight."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him.
"Let’s talk in my sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 1182: Four Race In A Place
paragraphs: "Did all those beasts come from the Sky Dragon Island?" Long Wuzhao asked once they arrived outside the barrier.
"How did you create this void barrier without the void element, kid?" Long Xukong asked him. "This void barrier is quite powerful, but it’s not strong enough to prevent me from breaching it."

Zhang Fei [5] answered him straight away. "Senior, you are an old void dragon, and your cultivation is already at the peak, so it won’t be able to stop you. Even so, it is strong enough to stop other cultivators without understanding the void element, right? A friend helped me to create it, but I’m sorry I can’t reveal that person’s identity."

"It’s okay." Long Xukong touched the barrier and analyzed it thoroughly. "This barrier is enough to stop a cultivator at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm as long as that person doesn’t have any understanding of the void element. However, cultivators who possess the void element can easily break through it, even if their cultivation is still at the Celestial King Realm. Therefore, you must never lower your guard, and you must keep monitoring the situation."

"Thank you for your advice, Senior." Zhang Fei [5] then explained to Long Wuzhao. "Many of them come from the Sky Dragon Realm, and the rest come from their respective main realms. There are still many mythical beast races in the Three Mortal Realms, but I have no connection with them."
Long Wuzhao nodded in understanding. "So, who are their leaders? Are you going to lead them yourself?"

"Some of my wives come from these beast races, except for the Mythical Deer Race. Therefore, I will ask them to lead their races, and I will support them from behind." Zhang Fei [5] then opened the portal to the training ground, surprising Long Xukong, who immediately tried to analyze it. However, he couldn’t do it, which confused him.

Soon, Zhang Yue, Hong Xinxin, Hu Yue, Hu Lili, Feng Xueying, Feng Jinqiu, Feng Qingmeng, Huli Haohao, Huli Xianniang, Huli Zhishen, Zhu Lingyao, Zhu Shanniang, Nu Qichen, and Feng Yichen came out of it.
Long Wuzhao and the others were quite surprised to see them, but they were more interested in Feng Yichen. "A dark phoenix, huh?"

"Yichen used to be Xereth’s subordinate, but she has become my contract beast and wife." Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to them. "They are the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, Long Wuzhao. The Void Dragon, Long Xukong. The Celestial Dragon, Tianshi Bailong."
Zhang Yue and all the female mythical beasts hurriedly cupped their hands and paid their respects to Long Wuzhao and the others, except for Feng Yichen. "Pleased to meet you all, seniors."

"Haha! No need for such formalities with us." Long Wuzhao lifted them up and pulled Hu Yue forward. "I don’t know how you became like this, but I think you’re the most unique among them because you’re no longer a moon fox or a golden fox."

"Yue’er is a golden moon fox." Long Wuzhao and the others turned to Zhang Fei [5] directly. "Her grandfather was a mixed breed of a moon fox and a golden fox, and she inherited the golden fox bloodline from him. However, her golden fox bloodline was too thin, and I used Xianniang’s bloodline to strengthen hers. She eventually became a new fox race, the Golden Moon Fox. Currently, she is the only one of her kin, but her race will increase if we have children in the future."
"The Golden Moon Fox Race." Long Wuzhao muttered while nodding, but then he looked at the two women who had just arrived. "I didn’t expect you to leave your seclusion for this kid, Feng Shizhu."

"Emperor, he has ties with my ice phoenix race, and he invited me to come, so I had to accept his invitation." Feng Shizhu then looked at Feng Xueying, Feng Jinqiu, and Feng Yue, who directly paid respect to her. "The progress of the three of you is truly impressive, especially you, Yue’er. Five years ago, your cultivation had just reached the Quasi Divine Realm, but you almost broke through to the Five Celestial Realms now."
Unlike Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong were shocked to hear that from Feng Shizu. "Are you kidding, Shizu?"

"Her cultivation was truly at the Quasi Divine Realm five years ago." Feng Shizu then checked Zhang Yue’s bone age before nodding in understanding. "I don’t know how you aged so fast, but for you to reach your current level in a little over two decades is truly impressive."
"A little over two decades? Didn’t you just say that the last time you saw her was five years ago?" Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong asked in confusion.
Tianshi Shengjie immediately spoke to them. "Father! Uncle Xukong! Have you forgotten my story that Zhang Fei is aging so fast? Zhang Yue is his wife, so it’s normal for her to age this fast, right?"
"Yes." Both Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong looked at Zhang Fei [5], but his expression showed that he had no intention of telling them the truth, leaving them sighing in their hearts.

After Zhang Fei [5] sent all of his wives back to the training space, he took Long Wuzhao and the others to the back of the mountain. Their arrival caused Ye Mingran, Ye Futian, Nalan Shizhe, and the young demons to become tense.
"Golden Dragon Emperor." Jia Lingzhu and Jia Jia Shengyun greeted Long Wuzhao directly while bringing Jia Yuyan before him.
"I didn’t expect you two to be here too." Long Wuzhao then observed Jia Yuyan. "She is your granddaughter, right?"
Both Jia Lingzhu and Jia Jia Shengyun nodded to him. "Yuyan is indeed our granddaughter, but we were surprised to find that she had become his wife."

"After all, this kid is destined to bring peace back to this universe, so it is natural that he has relations with all races." Long Wuzhao’s words confused Ye Mingran, Ye Futian, Nalan Shizhe, and the young demons, mainly because they didn’t know about the writings left by the ten-tailed fox. "You have finally reunited with your second daughter, Nalan Shizhe. The most important thing is that she has become one of his wives."
"Thank you, Golden Dragon Emperor." Nalan Shizhe then asked him. "Could you please explain the meaning of your words just now about him?"
Long Wuzhao turned to Zhang Fei [5]. "Haven’t you told them yet?"

"Not yet." Zhang Fei [5] faced the demons present and transformed into his complete fox form, shocking all of them. "As you guys can see, I am also a mythical beast, a nine-tailed heavenly fox to be precise."
"This—" All the demons struggled to find the words to respond to him.

After Zhang Fei [5] returned to his human form, Nalan Yushu immediately spoke to them. "Mother, he is the chosen heir of the ten-tailed fox. The old fox left many writings in this universe, all of which are about him."
"Writings?" They are increasingly confused by that.

Feng Yao immediately created a Qi screen, showing them several stone monuments left by Hu Tianlang. "One day in the future, the ten-tailed fox will return to this universe once again. He is more than a heavenly fox; he is also a human and a demon. He is the one who will bring peace to humans, beasts, demons, and natural races."

The demons dumbfoundedly looked at the qi screen; none of them expected that Zhang Fei [5] had a direct connection with the ten-tailed fox, the most omnipotent beast. Moreover, their connection is unusual, and he is the chosen heir of the old fox.

Feng Yao spoke to them again. "That’s why I said that both of your races are lucky to have a relationship with him, especially since he is destined to stand above all cultivators in this universe. You should not waste the opportunity in front of you, especially since not everyone gets the same one. Additionally, don’t share everything you see and hear here with others, as it may cause him significant trouble."
"We understand." All the demons nodded to Feng Yao, who immediately removed the qi screen. They then looked at Zhang Fei [5], making a decision in their minds.
Long Wuzhao then asked Feng Yao, "How long are you going to let your subordinates act like that?"

"Those ignorant morons aren’t worth your time, and my subordinates will stop once they wipe them out." Feng Yao’s indifferent answer caused Long Wuzhao and the others to smile bitterly, especially since her subordinates had slaughtered too many people of various races in the past month.
After that, they discussed many things, especially about Zhang Fei [5]’s long-term plans, while waiting for the invited guests to arrive.

Two hours later, the Moonlit Passion Sect was filled with a crowd of cultivators from various domains. Many of them brought their younger generation to take a look at the sect’s transformation. Not only humans, but also other races were present, except for the demon races.

However, many supreme sects and clans were unwilling to attend the event, such as the Divine Samsara Sect. However, some members of the sect attended without carrying their sect’s name, such as Jin Nanqing and his two disciples.
Su Shentian and Jian Kuang were also present, and they were looking for Zhang Fei [5], but he asked them to enjoy their sect opening event first.
They were amazed when they looked around the area under the mountain, especially in front of several halls, such as the blacksmith and alchemy halls.

chapters.title: Chapter 1183: Opening Ceremony
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] left everything to Qing Qiu’er and the elders, but he observed the situation from behind the mountain with Feng Yao and the others. They sensed the changes in the Twin Flames Domain, particularly because countless cultivators continued to arrive.

Those cultivators had no intention of attending the sect’s event; instead, they went straight to the central area, and they waited there for the portal to the Endless Night Dungeon to open, even though night was still far away.

Qing Qiu’er decided to begin the opening ceremony, but they didn’t hold it in the hall as usual. Instead, they held it in the air, and all the guests could watch it without having to gather in one place. However, it did not attract their attention, and they were more interested in watching the live performances in the various halls.
Long Wuzhao, Long Xuekong, Tianshi Bailong, and the demons decided not to appear in public because their presence would only bring commotion and disrupt the course of the event.

As he originally planned, Zhang Fei [5] asked Lin Jingxia, Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, and others to do live performances based on their respective fields of expertise to attract public interest. After all, such live performances were very rare, and he wanted to show the public that their sect had competent people in those fields.

Apart from that, Zhang Fei [5] asked Zhu Yan and several women to prepare many Earth dishes to entertain their guests. He asked them to spread the dishes in all areas so the guests could watch those live performances while enjoying them.
Zhang Fei [5] suddenly received a voice transmission, and he directly went to meet that person.
"Zhang Fei, you have changed a lot since our last meeting in the Sovereign Heaven Realm. Not only did you join this sect, but you also transformed it entirely."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed in response. "How did you know that I was in this sect, Senior Xun’er?"

"Her." Helian Xun’er pointed at Hua Mei’er, who was hiding behind an old man and an old woman. "You invited Beiming Youhuang to attend this event, and Hua Xiang’er told Mei’er about you and this sect. Therefore, I decided to come here, even though you forgot not to invite me."
"To be honest, my busy schedule almost made me forget about the Star Tower, but I’m glad you came here." Zhang Fei [5] then looked at the two seniors. "Who are these two seniors?"
Helian Xun’er directly introduced them. "These two are the leaders of our Emerald Bamboo Sect in the Peach Garden Domain, Li Tianyu and his wife, Lan Yueru."
"Nice to meet you both, and welcome to my sect, Senior Tianyu and Senior Yueru." Zhang Fei [5] cupped his hands to them.

Li Tianyu rubbed his white beard as he nodded. "Initially, we were hesitant to come, especially since we didn’t know each other yet. However, Wan Jiang convinced us to come, so please forgive us for coming uninvited."

"That’s not a problem, senior." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a shake of his head. "I’m actually pleased that you two are willing to attend our event, seniors. After all, I’m still relatively new to this realm, and I don’t know much about the sects and clans here. Furthermore, this sect’s reputation has never been good in the past, so I’m hesitant to invite too many people myself."

Lan Yueru then spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Honestly, we’ve never had a problem with dual cultivation sects because everyone has their own preferences, but we rarely mingle with cultivators from other domains, so not many people know about our sect."
’Tch! This perverted bad egg pretends to be good in front of them!’ Hua Mei’er inwardly grumbled as she listened to them.
"Please let me show you the changes in the sect, seniors." Zhang Fei [5] took them to the alchemy hall’s area first, where Lin Jingxia was doing an alchemy live show.
Li Tianyu and Lan Yueru looked amazed watching Lin Jingxia’s skill and calmness in concocting pills. "She is a god-rank alchemist, right?"
"Yes, Senior."
Helian Xun’er pointed to Zhang Fei [5]. "Seniors, this man is actually also a god-rank alchemist, but he doesn’t seem to want to show his abilities to the public."
"Oh?" Li Tianyu and Lan Yueru looked at him with surprise. "Is it true?"
Zhang Fei [5] showed them his alchemy token. "I’m not interested in appearing in public, and Senior Jingxia’s abilities in alchemy are better than mine, so I asked her to do it."
"You still have other abilities, right? Otherwise, you wouldn’t be able to bring about major changes to this sect." Li Tianyu spoke with certainty.

"I’m a god-rank sword master, a supreme-rank blacksmith, a rank 10 array master, and many more." Li Tianyu and Lan Yueru finally understood Wang Jian’s reasoning to convince them to establish a good relationship with Zhang Fei [5].

Li Tianyu then took out a token and handed it to him. "We’ve never had a relationship before, but I hope we can build a good relationship in the future, and this token is a symbol of our sincerity in establishing a relationship with you and this sect."

"I accept it, Senior." Zhang Fei [5] stored the token before taking out four bottles of pills and handing them two each. "The pills inside are my concoction; please consider them a gift for our new relationship."
"Thank you." Both of them sincerely spoke.

Li Tianyu then told him something else. "I forgot to tell you that Xun’er chose to join your sect, but she will also remain our disciple. This way, she will become the liaison between the sects, and I hope our relationship will become better and better in the future."
Zhang Fei [5] was surprised to hear that. "Why did you suddenly decide to join us, Senior Xun’er?"
"Don’t you already know the answer?" Helian Xun’er turned the question over with a faint smile.
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "That’s right, I shouldn’t have asked that. No matter what, I’m glad you joined us, Senior Xun’er."
Helian Xun’er smiled at that. "Since you already know the answer, please stop calling me senior and just call me by my name."
"Alright, Xun’er." Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] led them to look at the other halls while enjoying the dishes available in each area.

Apart from accompanying Li Tianyu and Lan Yueru, Zhang Fei [5] didn’t forget to observe all the guests who were enjoying themselves by watching live performances and eating the dishes. As usual, Mei displayed their data for him, and she recorded everything into the system.

As time passed, more and more cultivators arrived, making the new areas of the Moonlit Passion Sect increasingly filled with guests. Some went to the mountain to see the dual cultivation hall, mainly due to their interest in the path.

As Zhang Fei [5] expected, the live performances piqued the interest of many guests, especially after they witnessed the abilities of Lin Jingxia, Hun Di, Ji Changlan, and others. Some of them decided to send their younger generation to join the sect, but the number of those who were hesitant was still significantly larger, primarily due to the sect’s reputation.
Even though they had witnessed the sect’s significant changes, they still lacked the confidence to send their younger generation there, as they feared that people would look down on their clans.
"Kid."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Ma Kuangyu, who was running towards him. "What’s wrong, Old Ma?"

Zhang Fei [5] looked back at those people. "Why did they come here?"

"They must want to go to the dungeon, and they probably detected activity in this sect, so they decided to come uninvited." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding to Ma Kuangyu. "The person beside Sheng Yaohun is the one who betrayed me, Gongsun Ye."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly read the statuses of the two people. "Their cultivation has reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, huh?"
"What—"
"Old Ma!" Zhang Fei [5] and Ma Kuangyu looked at Luo Fenghan and Zhuang Qihong immediately. "I think you should hide first, or those people will cause chaos if they find you here."

"The Spirit Temple, huh? You don’t need to hide from them, and I will accompany Zhang Fei to meet them." Without waiting for their answer, Feng Yao immediately grabbed Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulder and brought him out of the barrier.
"Senior Sheng, how could this sect suddenly become this big?"
Sheng Yaohun didn’t answer Gongsun Ye directly and looked at Feng Yao and Zhang Fei [5], who had just appeared in front of them.

Sheng Yaohun did not spare a glance at Zhang Fei [5], especially since he was too weak for him. However, he was quite wary of Feng Yao because he couldn’t sense her aura or presence even though they were so close. "Are you the new leader of this sect?"

"Zhang Fei, you have changed a lot since our last meeting in the Sovereign Heaven Realm.

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed in response.

Helian Xun’er directly introduced them.

Furthermore, this sect’s reputation has never been good in the past, so I’m hesitant to invite too many people myself."
Lan Yueru then spoke to Zhang Fei [5].

’Tch!

chapters.title: Chapter 1184: Corpse-Refining Coffin
paragraphs: Sheng Yaohun recognized the identities of the three women based on their attire, and he swiftly changed his attitude after realizing Feng Yao’s true identity. "Are you perhaps Empress Huo Yanling?"

"Don’t you always think you’re smart, Sheng Yaohun?" Feng Yao asked sarcastically. "I know what kind of person you are, and I’m also clear about your Spirit Temple. We didn’t invite you, so take your people away."
"We—" Sheng Yaohun stopped speaking as a soft hand strangled his neck from behind, and his group was thrown quite far back.

"My master order is absolute; I will never spare anyone who dares to dispute her." Huo Ling coldly spoke as she tightened her grip on his neck. "If you don’t take them away immediately, I will burn your bodies to ashes, and your souls will suffer in my eternal flame until the end of time."

Sheng Yaohun swallowed his saliva after hearing that, and he nodded his head a few times before Huo Ling let go of him. He looked at Zhang Fei [5] for a moment before turning to leave, leading his men to leave the area of the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Like many cultivators, their arrogance made it difficult for Sheng Yaohun and his group to accept Feng Yao and Huo Ling’s treatment of them. They were infuriated by their treatment, and they thought of several plans in their minds.
"Are you sure they won’t cause problems in the future, Empress?" Huo Lanyin asked.

"Whether there is an incident today or not, Zhang Fei is bound to have trouble with them." After Feng Yao made that statement, Huo Lanyin and the other two looked at him. "The Spirit Temple is no longer as good as in the past, and its members are no different from the underlings of the Nine Nether Demon Race now. Ma Kuangyu found an artifact belonging to that race, and he hid it somewhere. However, Gongsun Ye found out about it, and they ganged up on him to death."
"Did they manage to find the artifact, Empress?" Huo Yu’er curiously asked.
Instead, Feng Yao turned to Zhang Fei [5] and spoke to him. "You should ask Ma Kuangyu about it, and it might be useful for you, especially in facing the Nine Nether Demon Race."
"Alright, I’ll ask him after this." Zhang Fei [5] remembered something. "Do you know where Yuan Xiajie is hiding? She kidnapped Wang Yin seven months ago, and I’m worried about her."
Feng Yao shook her head. "I don’t know Yuan Xiajie’s hiding place, but I guarantee that she won’t harm Wang Yin, so you don’t need to worry about her."
"How can you be sure about that?" Feng Yao just smiled at Zhang Fei [5] and disappeared straight away. "Tch!"
"Hehe." Huo Yu’er giggled. "Our Empress has always been like that, so you don’t need to mind her attitude."

Huo Hao’er nodded in agreement. "Moreover, Yuan Xiajie comes from the ancient clan, and your current strength is not enough to face her. Therefore, you should forget about her and focus on the problems in front of you, both those that have already arisen and those that will arise in the future."
"Don’t forget you owe me an alchemy competition, and I’ll collect it after we leave the dungeon." Thereafter, the three women disappeared.
Zhang Fei [5] sighed softly. "Not only is Feng Yao like that, but her subordinates are the same!"

After returning to the sect, Zhang Fei [5] led Ma Kuangyu to another area. "Old Ma, what exactly is that cursed artifact you found in the past? Feng Yao suspects that it had something to do with the Nine Nether Demon Race, especially since the Spirit Temple and those clans have ties with them."

"What do you know about the Nine Nether Demon Race, Kid?" Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at Ma Kuangyu, as he didn’t know anything about the demon race. "Actually, there are nine demon races within the Nine Nether Demon Race: corpse demon, wraith demon, blood demon, bone fiend demon, eye demon, wing demon, ghost-flame Demon, soul-eroded demon, and abyssal sovereign demon."
"So many races in one race."
Ma Kuangyu nodded at him. "The cursed artifact I found belonged to the corpse demon, which is the Corpse-Refining Coffin."
"The Corpse-Refining Coffin?"

"Yes." Ma Kuangyu then explained. "The Corpse-Refining Coffin is a sinister artifact built from corpse flesh and rotwood, sealed with talismans made of blood, bone, and sinew. They used it to transform corpses into a corpse demon or to temper existing ones into stronger evolutions. If living creatures were forced into it, they would slowly disintegrate. Their flesh would melt until it rotted, their bones would harden to the hardness of iron, and their blood would turn poisonous."
Zhang Fei [5] frowned at that. "How did the artifact get there if it’s so important to the corpse demon?"

"I don’t know how the artifact got there," Ma Kuangyu replied with a shake of his head. "As I said back then, I found it by accident, and it was sealed inside a room filled with talismans. I didn’t know the artifact was inside, and the formation was destroyed after I smashed the wall from the outside. I immediately realized it was dangerous, so I didn’t tell anyone about it. Unfortunately, Gongsun Ye found out that I obtained it, and you already know the rest of the story."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] then asked him again. "So, where did you hide the Corpse-Refining Coffin?"
"Are you thinking about taking and using that cursed item?" Ma Kuangyu asked with a deep frown.

"Feng Yao asked me to ask you about that item, and she said that it might be useful for us to fight against the Nine Nether Race." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer surprised Ma Kuangyu, but he remembered that she was the reincarnation of Huo Yanling, and she was also the reincarnation of a primordial being named Shen Yuanzhi. "It’s okay, you don’t have to think too much about it, Old Ma. That—"
"I hid the Corpse-Refining Coffin in the Slaughter Blood Domain."
Zhang Fei [5] was shocked by that. "Did you really hide it in that domain? How did you infiltrate there?"

"When I was alive, I possessed an artifact that could change my aura to resemble that of any race. The asura demons did not recognize my identity when I used a transformation technique to disguise myself as one of them, allowing me to hide that thing in their domain." Ma Kuangyu sighed heavily and looked outside. "Unfortunately, all my old artifacts fell into the hands of Gongsun Ye and the others after my death, so I can’t infiltrate the domain anymore, let alone retrieve that thing."

"Have you forgotten about my abilities, Old Ma? I’m sure I can infiltrate the Slaughter Blood Domain using them, and those asura demons won’t be aware of my identity." Zhang Fei [5] then pointed to the two people walking towards us. "Moreover, we have an asura demon on our side, and he should be able to lead us there. But where is the exact location you hid the artifact?"
"I hid it around the Blood Sea, and I’ve marked it with a special mark."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye, who had just arrived. "Some people are waiting for you two, and you don’t need to hide anymore from today onward."
Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye exchanged confused glances. "Who are the people you are referring to, Zhang Fei?"
"I’ll take them to meet those people first, Old Ma." Zhang Fei [5] enveloped Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye with his aura before taking the two away.
Ye Zhiye froze in her spot as soon as they arrived behind the mountain, squeezing Tian Shuixiang’s hand tightly while her body trembled in fear.
Tian Shuixiang was no less shocked than his wife when he saw Ye Mingran and Ye Futian there. He wanted to take Ye Zhiye to escape from that place, but Feng Yao immediately restricted their movements.

Ye Mingran said nothing as she looked at them, but Ye Futian reacted differently. He was excited and guilty at the same time because Ye Zhiye was his daughter, but he forced her to run away because of her relationship with Tian Shuixiang.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately spoke to calm them down. "You two don’t need to worry anymore because my great-grandmaster won’t do anything to you guys."
"Your great-grandmaster?" Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye asked without taking their eyes off Ye Mingran and Ye Zhiye.
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] summoned the demon extermination sword and used the first technique from the Forgotten Sword Technique. "Silent Edge."
Ye Zhiye was stunned when she saw that, as she surely recognized her father’s sword technique.

Ye Futian moved in front of them and hugged them both, surprising Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye. "Zhiye and Xiuluo, please forgive this old man’s stubbornness. I’ve long been aware that you two love each other, but I was too stubborn, and my personal grudge against the asura demon race has caused you both to suffer for so long."

Ye Zhiye didn’t know what to do to respond to Ye Futian. She missed her father, but she also hated him because he ordered their race members to hunt her and Tian Shuixiang, and he wanted to kill the man she loved the most.
Tian Shuixiang was also perplexed by their current situation, particularly given that it happened without prior warning. ’What should I do now?’

chapters.title: Chapter 1185: Demons Join The Sect
paragraphs: Ye Futian released his embrace from Ye Zhiye and Tian Shuixiang and looked at them, but they remained silent in place as they tried to process the sudden situation, leaving them unable to speak or react.
Ye Futian understood their situation, so he said nothing and let them be, waiting for them to be ready to speak to him.

Zhang Fei [5] patted Ye Zhiye and Tian Shuixiang’s shoulders. "I know you two must be shocked, confused, and unprepared because I didn’t tell you two about this. As I said before, you two no longer need to hide because my great-grandmaster has decided to accept your relationship. If you two are willing, I want you to stay in this sect to help me develop it into a powerful force in this realm."
"Is that true, Father?" Ye Zhiye finally asked. "Do you really approve of my relationship with my husband now?"

"Yes." Ye Futian took his daughter’s hand and rubbed it. "I will never go back on my word, and you can live the life you choose with Xiuluo. Therefore, you two don’t need to run away or hide from me anymore, and I will fully support your relationship."
"Uncle Ye, I—"

"No need." Ye Futian stopped Tian Shuixiang and patted his shoulder. "You two don’t owe me anything, and I am the one who owes you both an apology. Therefore, I apologize to you both for my arrogant and stubborn decisions in the past."
"Father."

Ye Futian stopped them from kneeling. "I’m not a good father, so you don’t need to do such a thing. I have accepted your relationship, but your father is different from me. Shang Zhui will never accept the relationship between the two of you, so you should avoid bringing your wife into your domain. If he finds you two there, he won’t hesitate to kill you both straight away."
"I understand, Father." Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye immediately hugged Tian Futian. "Thank you for finally accepting our relationship, Father."

Ye Futian nodded slightly as he hugged them back. "You two have been married for so long, but you still don’t have children. Since the situation has changed, I hope you will have children soon so I can be a grandfather."

"Haha." Both Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye laughed as they released their embrace from him. "Please forgive us, Father. We are not ready to have children, and we will wait until our cultivation breaks through to the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm first."
Ye Futian exhaled softly. "It seems I will have to wait a little longer to have a grandchild."
"Since you two have returned, are you going back to our domain?" Ye Mingran asked as she approached them.
Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye exchanged glances for a moment before refusing. "Please forgive us, Senior Ye. Zhiye and I have already decided to help Zhang Fei [5], so we will stay in this sect."

"Since you two have made that decision, I won’t force you to return." Ye Mingran looked back and asked the two young demons to come forward before speaking to Zhang Fei [5]. "Since you want to build this sect as a home for all races, I want Ye Xuan and Ye Yuanzhi to join. What do you think about this?"

Zhang Fei [5] observed the two young demons first, especially their souls. After he was sure that neither of them had any problems, he immediately agreed to Ye Mingran’s request. "Alright, the two of them can join this sect, but they might face some obstacles at first. After all, relations between demons and other races have never been good, and many of them always harbor bad prejudices against demons."

"Don’t worry, they are not soft young people, and I’m sure they can adapt well." Ye Mingran then spoke to them. "From now on, you two are part of this sect, and I will not protect you from its rules. If you break any rules here, I will hand over the punishment to him. Do you both understand?"
"Yes, Demon God." Ye Xuan and Ye Yuanzhi then spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Please take care of us, Elder Zhang."

"Go to the registration hall now, and Elder Xue Ling will arrange everything." After Ye Xuan and Ye Yuanzhi left, Zhang Fei [5] turned to Nalan Shizhe. "Are you going to send representatives of your demon race to this sect, mother-in-law?"

Nalan Shizhe felt awkward and strange hearing Zhang Fei [5] address her as such, especially since they didn’t have any relationship before today. However, Nalan Yushu was already his wife, so he was truly his son-in-law.

"I will join this sect, Mother." Nalan Wangzi’s sudden decision not only surprised Zhang Fei [5] but also Nalan Shizhe and her other two children. "In addition, send Nalan Yanxi and Nalan Wuhen here, and I will watch over them both myself."

"You cannot join this sect." Nalan Shizhe immediately rejected her first daughter. "Have you forgotten your relationship with Mo Taizi? What do you think will happen if he can’t find you in our domain? He might not be bothered about your whereabouts, but Mo Shentian will definitely look for you. If he knows you’re in this sect, he will come here directly, and you will endanger everyone here."
"But—"
"Since when did my big sis have a relationship with Mo Taizi?" Nalan Yuzhu hurriedly asked.

"Isn’t it because of you?" Nalan Yuzhu covered her mouth when Nalan Shizhe glared at her. "You were supposed to marry Mo Taizi, remember? Since you died at the hands of Tian Qiye and she imprisoned your soul in the tower, Mo Shentian asked your big sister to replace you. If he knew you had returned and had reshaped your body, he would ask me to hand you over to him too. Therefore, you must hide your presence and don’t move around carelessly like before, or you will bring your husband and the others great trouble."

Nalan Yushu nodded her head repeatedly to her mother, but Zhang Fei [5] suddenly moved to her side and hugged her waist. "Yuzhu is my wife, and I will never hand over any of my women to another man. If Mo Shentian thinks he can snatch her from me, he and his Celestial Demon Race will become my enemies, and I will wipe them down to their roots."
"You—"

"Hahaha." Long Wuzhao suddenly laughed before speaking. "You don’t need to doubt your son-in-law, Nalan Shizhe. He is indeed not Mo Shentian’s opponent now, but you should know that no one has ever been able to reach his level this quickly, including me. He cultivated for about two and a half decades, but he has already reached his current level. If that foolish demon hunts him, he only needs to hide for a few more decades, and I’m sure he’ll have reached his level by then. At that time, the Celestial Demon Race would no longer be able to match him, and they would be wiped out by his hands."

Tianshi Shengjie immediately joined in. "Demon God Nalan, you don’t understand Zhang Fei as well as I do. I’ve been watching him since he started his cultivation path in the Three Mortal Realms, and he’s the only cultivator from there who could ascend here in just three and a half years. I’ve witnessed all of his actions myself in the past, so I can say that his abilities, especially in real combat, are far better than you imagine."

"Mother." Nalan Shu grabbed her mother’s hand. "I understand your worries, but you have to believe in my husband. He may be weak now, but he has me and his other wives, and we will continue to help him become stronger. Moreover, I have learned a lot from my mistakes since my death, and I will not act rashly like in the past, let alone endanger myself and others."
Nalan Shizhe looked at Nalan Yushu and Zhang Fei [5] in turn before sighing. "I don’t know anything about him yet, but since you all believe so much in his abilities, I will also believe in him."
"What about me, Mother?" Nalan Wangzi pointed at her face.
"You—"
"Here." Feng Yao threw a doll at Nalan Wangzi, which she immediately caught. "Drip your blood and a little of your demon essence into the doll first, and you will know the results soon."

Nalan Wangzi hurriedly followed the instructions, causing the doll to grow larger and transform into her, which shocked her and the others. Moreover, everything about the doll was completely identical to her, including her aura, cultivation, and everything else.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] observed the doll. "This doll is much better than Senior Brother Moxian’s humanoid doll that he used when he helped me get the Soul Flame."

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled. "Naturally, you can’t compare our dolls, and mine is far superior to his. Don’t ask how I created it, as I wasn’t the creator, and I snatched it from someone else in the past."
Zhang Fei [5] sighed in disappointment, and Nalan Wangzi asked Feng Yao. "Should I move this doll myself, Empress Huo?"
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at her. "Inject a strand of your consciousness and soul into the doll, and you can control it from afar."

Nalan Wangzi followed Feng Yao’s instructions, and the doll instantly came to life. The doll moved, talked, posed, and did everything according to her instructions. "Hehe! This way, I can join this sect without worrying about Mo Shentian finding me, Mother!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1186: Twin Moons Align
paragraphs: "Why do you insist on joining this sect?" Nalan Shizhe asked with a frown.

Nalan Wangzi pulled Nalan Yushu from Zhang Fei [5] and hugged her. "I haven’t seen my sister for tens of thousands of years, so I miss her, and I want to spend time with her. Since she will stay in this sect, I decided to join it as well."
’A liar!’ Nalan Yushu shouted in her heart while holding back laughter, as she knew her big sister’s character well despite not having seen her for a long time.

Nalan Huanzi thought the same as his little sister, yet he still helped Nalan Wangzi in persuading their mother. "Mother, just let her join this sect. Moreover, Empress Huo has already given this doll to her, and I’m sure Mo Shentian will never know she’s in this sect as long as we don’t tell anyone."

"Hmm?" Nalan Shizhe squinted her eyes at her son and first daughter while observing their expressions. "Fine! You can join this sect! However, you must take responsibility if Mo Shentian finds out and looks for you in this sect."

"Hahaha." Nalan Wangzi laughed with a triumphant smile, irritating Nalan Shizhe. "Ask them to send Nalan Yanxi and Nalan Wuhen here, mother. Moreover, the dungeon will open tonight, so they should head here now and prepare to enter."
Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran immediately contacted the members of their two demon races, ordering their subordinates to bring some people with them.
Long Wuzhao also asked Long Xukong to pick up their clan members, especially those who wanted to explore the Endless Night Dungeon.
On the other hand, Zhang Fei [5] spoke to Feng Yao using telepathy, mainly about her purpose of helping Nalan Wangzi persuade her mother to allow her to join his sect.
Feng Yao simply smiled and said nothing to Zhang Fei [5], annoying him with her secrecy.

Sheng Yaohun and his group had already arrived at the central area of the domain, but they were completely furious because of Feng Yao and Huo Ling’s previous behavior, confusing the cultivators who had arrived there earlier.
"What do you think of them, Senior? Why is Empress Huo protecting the sect?" Gongsun Ye asked.

Sheng Yaohun turned toward the Moonlit Passion Sect. "I have some guesses about that, but I doubt some. First, there’s something valuable in that sect, and Empress Huo discovered it first. Second, her action has something to do with the young man who appeared with her before, and he may be her direct descendant. However, I have never heard that she had a relationship with a man in the past, so I doubt that she has any descendants. Third, that young man may be her lover in this life, but it’s difficult for us to prove that. If we try to investigate them, her subordinates will attack us."

"That’s for sure." Gongsun Ye then conveyed his idea. "Since their sect is in this domain, I’m sure they’ll enter the dungeon tonight. I think we can ask those people to help us investigate them, so Empress Huo won’t be suspicious of us."

"They won’t appear before night, so we have to wait for them to appear first. However, we must be cautious, as Long Wuzhao, the beasts, and other demon gods may show up." Sheng Yaohun then asked him. "Have you still not found Qi Lai?"
"Not yet." Gongsun Ye shook his head. "Those people say that Qi Lai broke his oath by descending to the Three Mortal Realms to help the people there, and they are still hunting him."

"Qi Lai is such an idiot! I can’t understand his reasons for doing that, especially since there’s nothing valuable there." Sheng Yaohun released a soft sigh. "It’s been almost six years since he disappeared, so I hope they will find him soon, and I will force them to hand him over to me."
Gongsun Ye nodded at him. "They won’t listen to my request, but they certainly won’t dare refuse you."
"Yeah."
Several hours passed quickly, and almost all the guests had left, except for a few humans, all the beasts, and all the demons.
After he discussed with Qing Qiu’er and the elders about the outcome of their plan, Zhang Fei [5] decided to meet Su Shentian and Jian Kuang first.
Jian Kuang was eager to spar with him in swordsmanship, but Zhang Fei [5] asked him to wait until they returned from the dungeon.
Zhang Fei [5] tried to persuade Jian Kuang to join his sect, but the sword maniac rejected him outright, especially since he preferred an unfettered life without ties to any party.

Zhang Fei [5] then persuaded Su Shentian to join him, but the speed demon did not agree or refuse, and he asked for time to consider it first. Despite this, the speed demon agreed to his request for him to stay in the Moonlit Passion Sect for some time.

After Su Shentian and Jian Kuang went to the central area, Zhang Fei [5] went to meet Jin Nanqing and his two disciples. They talked about alchemy for quite a while, and they decided to form a partnership in selling their alchemy products. This way, he could sell at the Divine Samsara Sect, and they would sell at the Moonlit Passion Sect, which would benefit both parties.
After they reached an agreement, Jin Nanqing and his two disciples hurriedly left to join the Divine Samsara Sect members who were waiting for them in the central area.
Since there were no longer any outsiders in the sect, Zhang Fei [5] asked the mythical beasts, natural races, and demons to gather in the main hall.
Even though Zhang Fei [5] had already told them about those people, their presence in their sect was enough to make the elders depressed, mainly because of their strength and status.

Unlike them, Qing Qiu’er remained relaxed, not feeling even the slightest pressure from their presence; instead, she was overjoyed. If it weren’t for Zhang Fei [5], she wouldn’t have been able to see the five different races gather in her sect without hostility, especially the winged races and the demon races.

However, Qing Qiu’er was shocked when Zhang Fei [5] told her about Nalan Yushu’s identity and Nalan Wangzi’s decision to join their sect, especially since both women were the daughters of the Soul-Devouring Demon God.
Nalan Shizhe had brought two young demons, Ye Xuan and Ye Yuanzhi, from her demon race to the sect.

As Zhang Fei [5] had previously expected, the core and special disciples greeted the demons with cold indifference for different reasons. After they persuaded them, he and Qing Qiu’er managed to convince those disciples to accept them, and they asked them to get used to the presence of the demons.
Time flew quickly, and night finally arrived. The central area was already filled with tens of thousands of cultivators from various races and domains.
Even though he wasn’t there, Zhang Fei [5] could easily check those people through his maps, and he found many familiar names there, including members of the Jiao Clan and the fairy race.
Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, Tianshi Bailong, and Tianshi Shengjie immediately left the Moonlit Passion Sect, leading their members to the central area.

Ye Mingran, Ye Futian, and Nalan Shizhe also led the members of their two demon races to that area. Even though she had joined the Moonlit Passion Sect, Nalan Wangzi did not join them; instead, she and her brother followed their mother.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] asked the members of the Moonlit Passion Sect not to rush there, even though they were impatient.
As the night grew darker, all the cultivators could see that the two twin moons were starting to move toward alignment.
As soon as the two were fully aligned, they emitted a bright silver light, illuminating the center area of the domain and revealing the portal to enter the Endless Night Dungeon.
All the cultivators, who had been waiting in the area for a long time, immediately scrambled to enter the dungeon, especially those humans.

After the humans disappeared, the beast races began leading members of their respective races into the dungeon. However, Long Wuzhao and the other two dragons did not join them, and they asked Tianshi Shengjie and Long Youjia to lead them before leaving the domain.
Since the other demon gods did not appear, and they only sent members of their races, Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe also did not enter the dungeon.

They asked their four children to lead the members of their two races, but Ye Mingran asked Ye Futian to join them specifically to protect her two children. Thereafter, the two female demon gods immediately left the Twin Flame Domain and returned to their respective domains.

After they all disappeared, Zhang Fei [5] brought many of his sect members and close people to the central area, followed by Feng Yao, her parents, and her three subordinates. "Will we arrive at one place or be sent to random places?"
"We’ll be sent to a random place, and we’ll meet inside." Feng Yao enveloped her parents and subordinates with an artifact before leading them inside.
"Son, we’ll go in first, and we’ll meet inside later." After he said that, Luo Fenghan immediately led his family and the cultivators from the Empyrean Domain in.
Zhang Fei [5] could only shake his head as they disappeared, and Qing Qiu’er asked him, "Are we going in normally? Or are you going to use your secret place to bring us in?"

Since there were no longer any outsiders in the sect, Zhang Fei [5] asked the mythical beasts, natural races, and demons to gather in the main hall.
Even though Zhang Fei [5] had already told them about those people, their presence in their sect was enough to make the elders depressed, mainly because of their strength and status.
Unlike them, Qing Qiu’er remained relaxed, not feeling even the slightest pressure from their presence; instead, she was overjoyed.
If it weren’t for Zhang Fei [5], she wouldn’t have been able to see the five different races gather in her sect without hostility, especially the winged races and the demon races.

However, Qing Qiu’er was shocked when Zhang Fei [5] told her about Nalan Yushu’s identity and Nalan Wangzi’s decision to join their sect, especially since both women were the daughters of the Soul-Devouring Demon God.
Nalan Shizhe had brought two young demons, Ye Xuan and Ye Yuanzhi, from her demon race to the sect.
As Zhang Fei [5] had previously expected, the core and special disciples greeted the demons with cold indifference for different reasons.
After they persuaded them, he and Qing Qiu’er managed to convince those disciples to accept them, and they asked them to get used to the presence of the demons.
Time flew quickly, and night finally arrived.
The central area was already filled with tens of thousands of cultivators from various races and domains.
Even though he wasn’t there, Zhang Fei [5] could easily check those people through his maps, and he found many familiar names there, including members of the Jiao Clan and the fairy race.
Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, Tianshi Bailong, and Tianshi Shengjie immediately left the Moonlit Passion Sect, leading their members to the central area.
Ye Mingran, Ye Futian, and Nalan Shizhe also led the members of their two demon races to that area.
Even though she had joined the Moonlit Passion Sect, Nalan Wangzi did not join them; instead, she and her brother followed their mother.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] asked the members of the Moonlit Passion Sect not to rush there, even though they were impatient.
As the night grew darker, all the cultivators could see that the two twin moons were starting to move toward alignment.
As soon as the two were fully aligned, they emitted a bright silver light, illuminating the center area of the domain and revealing the portal to enter the Endless Night Dungeon.
All the cultivators, who had been waiting in the area for a long time, immediately scrambled to enter the dungeon, especially those humans.
After the humans disappeared, the beast races began leading members of their respective races into the dungeon.
However, Long Wuzhao and the other two dragons did not join them, and they asked Tianshi Shengjie and Long Youjia to lead them before leaving the domain.
Since the other demon gods did not appear, and they only sent members of their races, Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe also did not enter the dungeon.
They asked their four children to lead the members of their two races, but Ye Mingran asked Ye Futian to join them specifically to protect her two children.
Thereafter, the two female demon gods immediately left the Twin Flame Domain and returned to their respective domains.
After they all disappeared, Zhang Fei [5] brought many of his sect members and close people to the central area, followed by Feng Yao, her parents, and her three subordinates.
"Will we arrive at one place or be sent to random places?"
"We’ll be sent to a random place, and we’ll meet inside." Feng Yao enveloped her parents and subordinates with an artifact before leading them inside.
"Son, we’ll go in first, and we’ll meet inside later." After he said that, Luo Fenghan immediately led his family and the cultivators from the Empyrean Domain in.
Zhang Fei [5] could only shake his head as they disappeared, and Qing Qiu’er asked him, "Are we going in normally?
Or are you going to use your secret place to bring us in?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1187: Endless Night Dungeon
paragraphs: "Sect Master, we are experienced cultivators and not weak; we have entered this dungeon before. Therefore, we will enter first, and we will gather in front of the labyrinth later, just like in the past." Kong Mao spoke.
"That’s true, we will go in first, Sect Master." Bao Yunlai agreed with his partner. "What about you, You Shiyan and Fei Yinglin?"
You Shiyan was the first to answer. "Yinglin and I already have some plans for inside, so we’ll leave first."
"Yeah." Fei Yinglin then looked at the other six special disciples. "Shall we enter together?"
"Let’s go!" One of them spoke to Qing Qiu’er. "Sect Master! Elders! We will leave first."

The ten special disciples immediately disappeared into the portal, making Qing Qiu’er sigh heavily while shaking her head. "Young people are always full of enthusiasm, but they don’t think about their safety."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "You’re still young too, okay? We are cultivators, and danger is our middle name. They are stronger than me in cultivation, so you don’t need to worry about them. Once we go inside, I will look for them."

"You won’t be able to find them." Zhang Fei [5] turned to You Feiling. "There are many restrictions inside, and one of them will limit our senses. We won’t be able to search the area beyond a five-mile radius."
"Only a five-mile radius, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding before asking Lin Jingxia and the others. "What do you guys think?"

Xia Tian patted Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulder. "Even though my cultivation is still at the Celestial Lord Realm, I’m an experienced adventurer, remember? I’ve explored almost every mysterious and dangerous place in the Three Mortal Realms, and this dungeon is no different from them, so I’ll go inside manually."

"I agree with you, Old Xia." Hun Di looked at the others. "Even though we don’t have his advantages, we are his seniors. Since he has the courage to enter this dungeon, we will also enter it ourselves."

Gong Ren distributed several bracelet devices to them. "I don’t know if they will be useful inside, but you guys should take them with you. If they work, they will make it easier for us to locate each other. They’ll also send a distress signal if any of us are in danger, and we’ll rush to help."

Lin Jingxia and the others received those devices, wore them on their wrists, and entered the dungeon afterwards. Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye joined them, followed by Tian Huangjin and two members of the winged race.
"Did they always like that?" You Feiling asked Zhang Fei [5].

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "They are weaker than all of you in cultivation, but they have long experience in facing the dangers of the Three Mortal Realms. Therefore, you don’t need to worry about them, and I believe they will be fine."
You Feiling nodded in understanding before taking Su Yao’s hand. "Then, we will go in first, but we must gather in front of the labyrinth as quickly as possible."
"Alright."
After that, You Feiling took Su Yao into the dungeon, followed by all the elders.
"What about your other women?"
"I’ll summon them once we’re inside." Zhang Fei [5] held Qing Qiu’er’s hand. "Let’s go."
