[The host enters the special dungeon.]
[The system has already recorded the Endless Night Dungeon, and the host can access it through the Gate in the future.]
[Generating new quests.]
[Quest: Explore ten dungeon areas.]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Reward: Easy gift pack x 1]
[Quest: Clearing the Endless Night Labyrinth.]
[Quest rank: Medium]
[Reward: Medium gift pack x 1]
[Quest: Uncover the mystery of the dungeon.]
[Quest rank: Hard]
[Reward: Hard gift pack x 1]
[Quest: Set free two souls trapped in the dungeon.]
[Quest rank: Abyss]
[Reward: Abyss Gift Pack x 1]
[Quest: Obtain the most valuable treasure of the dungeon.]
[Quest rank: Special]
[Reward: Special gift pack x 1]

Zhang Fei [5] frowned at the appearance of those quests and read them one by one, wondering to himself. ’This dungeon has ten areas, huh? I hate the labyrinth; I have no other choice but to enter it because of the quest. What mysteries lie in this dungeon? Why does the system give me such a quest? Who are the two souls trapped here? What is the most valuable item in this dungeon?’

As You Feiling said before, Zhang Fei [5] sensed a strong restriction on his senses, preventing him from examining areas too far away. Moreover, the area around them was completely dark without any moonlight or sunlight, making their vision even more limited.

"I didn’t expect us to arrive at the same place, but this is excellent. Unfortunately, the others fell into other areas, so we have to track and look for them." Qing Qiu’er turned to Zhang Fei [5], who was seriously thinking. "What are you thinking about?"

"Wait a minute; I’ll check a few things first." Zhang Fei [5] then opened the system map, and the names of all his acquaintances appeared there, relieving him. The dungeon’s size shocked him; it was truly vast, and the distance from one place to another was simply too far. "All of them arrived in many different areas, and they are still safe now."
"Huh? How did you know their location?" Qing Qiu’er suspiciously asked.

"Naturally, I have my own method to track them, but I can’t explain it to you now." Zhang Fei [5] tried to open a gate, and to his relief, it immediately appeared, proving that there were no space or void restrictions inside the dungeon. "This is great! I will summon them now."

Shortly after Zhang Fei [5] opened the portal, Feng Yichen walked out from the training space, followed by Feng Xueying and all the women who had reached the Five Celestial Realms. He then summoned Xiang Zhan, Sha Huoyan, and Shou Yunzhi out of the beast space.

Zhang Fei [5] intentionally left Serpentera and Tian Kui in the Moonlit Passion sect, especially since he was afraid that the demons would recognize their identities. Moreover, he was sure that the four evil mythical beasts would not miss the opportunity to explore the dungeon, and it would be dire if they recognized the two of them.

Since their number was quite large, and the area of the dungeon was also too vast, Zhang Fei’s other four clones also came out of the training space. This way, they could divide their group into smaller groups, and they didn’t need to waste time going to all the areas one by one, but the most important thing was that they could avoid the other cultivators more easily.
"Are we in the dungeon, husband? Why is this place so dark?" Luo Yunxiao asked, looking at the surrounding area.

"Just like the name, there’s only darkness here, but that’s not a problem for us." Zhang Fei [5] and the other four clones summoned five female winged races made of their light element, illuminating the area around them. "We’re still far from any area, and our numbers are not small. Therefore, we’ll split up into five groups, and the five of us will take the lead."
All of them agreed with that because all of Zhang Fei’s clones had the same strength and abilities, and they felt more at ease when they were with them. "What is the closest location to us?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] observed the map. "The Endless Night Palace is right in the center of this dungeon, but we have to pass through the labyrinth before we can reach it, so those two places will be our final destinations. Besides those two, there are eight other locations, but the closest one to us is the Endless Night Cavern."
"Is there anything interesting in the Endless Night Cavern, Sister Qiu’er?" Shangguan Yan asked.

"There’s nothing interesting there except for the Soul flames." All of them looked at Qing Qiu’er in shock because Zhang Fei had once absorbed the Soul Flame in the Nine Hells Darkland Realm, and most of them still remembered its horror. "Have you guys ever seen a Soul Flame before?"

Zhang Fei [5] and the other four clones stretched their palms forward, shocking Qing Qiu’er with the Soul Flame that appeared above their palms. "I obtained it in a realm filled with evil wandering souls, and their evil nature also affected this flame. Feng Yao and Senior Brother Moxian helped me obtain it, and I spent quite a long time purifying it before I could absorb it."

"I see." Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding. "I don’t know how strong those evil wandering souls are, but I can say that the souls in the Endless Night Cavern are truly powerful. Humans, beasts, and the natural races will usually avoid that place because of the strength of those souls. Not even all the winged races dare to go to that place, but the demons really like it, so we will definitely meet many of them there."
"Hahaha!" Nalan Yushu laughed with joy after hearing that. "Husband! We have to go to that place! Those souls are delicious food for a soul-devouring demon like me!"

Zhang Fei [5] and the others laughed at Nalan Yushu’s antique; he then divided their group into five and divided them equally based on strength. After that, all of them moved to the Endless Night Cavern, and they spread out through different paths, especially since there were quite a lot of other cultivators in the area.

chapters.title: Chapter 1188: First Area: Palace
paragraphs: *Thud... Thud...*

Feng Yao casually landed in front of the Endless Night Castle in the center of the labyrinth, followed by her parents and three subordinates. The palace was built from black stones that have not decayed despite countless ages. They absorbed light, giving it a cold and oppressive atmosphere.

The palace was enormous, with collapsed ponds, dead rivers, courtyards, and broken pillars that stretched for miles. Old ruined lanterns hung on the few remaining walls, burning with an unnatural blue flame that never faded. Although the surrounding area was in disarray, the main building of the palace was still visible, with several large holes in some of the walls of its three floors.
In some areas, they could see many incomplete statues, having been destroyed by time. However, some statues were still physically visible, indicating that they were demon statues.

Even though she had seen many dangerous and scary places in the past, Feng Jiu shivered in fear as they stood in front of the ruined palace. She hugged Feng Tian’s arm tightly while asking their daughter. "Who exactly was the old owner of this dungeon, Yao’er?"

"The Silver Moon Clan was once part of the ancient races, and their clan was divided into two races: humans and demons. The two races coexisted harmoniously despite their differences." Feng Yao led them to enter the castle, and they saw many ruined murals on the walls inside. "Despite the clan name, their members were masters in darkness arts and everything related to Yin. These murals depicted their prowess in war with other clans, and they were much superior to them, except for one clan, the Golden Sun Clan. As for the Endless Night name, people in the past called it that because there was no light whatsoever, and there was only darkness all around."
"Does that mean the Golden Sun Clan and the Silver Moon Clan were the leaders of the ancient clans in the past?" Feng Tian asked while observing the murals in front of them.

"Both clans were the ancient clans’ leaders, and they were no different from the winged and demon races." Feng Jiu and Feng Tian looked at Feng Yao directly. "Both clans already existed long before the other ancient clans, and they were truly powerful. Even though the backbone of the Silver Moon Clan was humans and demons, it was inhabited by quite a lot of evil beast races, but the clan members regarded them merely as tools."
"What about the Golden Sun Clan?"

"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed. "Shouldn’t you already know the answer, Mother? The Golden Sun Clan was inhabited by winged races and humans, and there were also virtue beast races like our phoenix race. However, the true leader of the clan was a member of the winged race, and they excelled in light arts and everything related to Yang. Their history is too long, and it will take up a lot of time to retell it all. The main point is that all the cultivators in the Paradise Realm are distant descendants of the ancients, but era changes caused them to split into many clans and races that exist today."
"So, what is your purpose in bringing us here, Empress?"

"Let’s go to the throne room first." Feng Yao led them forward, but countless blue flames suddenly appeared and attacked them. She shook her head slightly, waved her hand, and instantly wiped them out. "Those blue flames are the remnant souls of the Silver Moon Clan members, but they were unable to enter the cycle of reincarnation because they died with deep regrets weighing on their souls."
"Empress! Don’t tell me that their leader’s soul still resides in the throne room."
Feng Yao tilted her head to the side and teased Huo Yu’er. "Are you afraid of ghosts, Yu’er?"
"Ugh! I’d rather face living beings than ghosts, Empress." Huo Yu’er replied, hugging her shivering body.
"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled. "You are right; their leader’s soul is on the throne now, and we will go to meet her."
"No!" Huo Yu’er screamed loudly and wanted to run away, but Huo Lanyin swiftly grabbed her hand. "Let me go, Sister Lanyin! I don’t want to meet a ghost!"
Huo Lanyin shook her head in response. "What do you have to be afraid of with our empress here? She is stronger than anyone, and she can destroy the ghost easily."
"But—"
"Stop complaining." Huo Lanyin immediately pulled Huo Yu’er away, followed by Huo Hao’er, who laughed out loud.
"Empress! Help me! Sister Lanyin wants to kill me!"
"Let’s follow them." Feng Yao immediately led her parents on their way while explaining some things about the Silver Moon Clan to them.
Sometime later, they arrived in front of the throne room. Although other areas of the palace were in disarray, the black stone gate leading inside was still intact.
"Ugh!" Huo Yu’er hugged Huo Lanyin’s arm tightly when she sensed a strong aura from within the throne. "This ghost must be powerful! Its aura is so cold it’s bone-chilling!"
Huo Lanyin and Huo Hao’er sighed helplessly, especially since Huo Yu’er kept acting like a scared little girl even though she was a powerful cultivator.
"Yao’er, this door is sealed, right?"

"Actually, I sealed this door because she went berserk and killed numerous cultivators who entered this dungeon in the past." Huo Yu’er became even more frightened and her face also turned deathly pale once Feng Yao said that. "If I hadn’t imprisoned her soul back then, those people would never have dared to enter this dungeon, especially since they would die immediately upon entering."
"Empress, we—Mhmm..." Huo Lanyin covered Huo Yu’er’s mouth with her hands immediately.
"Then, what are we doing here now? Do you intend to free her?" Feng Tian asked with a serious look.

"I imprisoned her soul here for millions of years, and she should have already broken free from her berserk state. Therefore, we will go in and check her condition first, and I will decide after confirming it." Feng Yao touched the door and muttered something.
Feng Jiu and the others were stunned when several huge red chains appeared before them with a large padlock in the middle, which was part of the seal that Feng Yao had used to seal the throne room.

Soon, the padlock opened by itself before shrinking to a small size, as did the red chains. Feng Yao stored them into her storage ring and pushed the door open, but a burst of cold air immediately swept through them, pushing the others several steps backwards.

Huo Yu’er panicked until her body trembled violently, and cold sweat began to wet her body, but Huo Lanyin held her very tightly. Huo Ling instantly appeared in front of them, waved her hand, and dispelled the cold air. "Dead woman! You don’t have to scare us! If it weren’t for my master, I would have tortured your soul with my eternal flame long ago!"
"Keh... Keh... Keh..." A woman’s horrified laughter greeted them.
’Ugh! I’m going to die! I will definitely die!’ Huo Yu’er inwardly muttered, closing her eyes tightly.
"Let’s go." Feng Yao directly led them inside, with Huo Ling walking by her side while hugging her waist.
Huo Lanyin forcefully pulled Huo Yu’er, who was frightened of the woman, inside with Huo Hao’er walking beside them.
Huo Yu’er was not the only woman who was frightened by the woman, but Feng Jiu was also frightened by her. She hugged Feng Tian, who led her inside, very tightly.
Feng Yao shot out several small flames in several directions, lighting the torches around the room and illuminating the dark, cold room.

Feng Jiu and Huo Yu’er gasped in shock as they saw the woman’s soul sitting on the throne, but her hands and legs were bound by chains to the side of the room. Several other chains were wrapped around her body, tying her to the throne.
"Keh... Keh... Keh..." The woman kept releasing horrified laughter as she looked at Feng Yao with hostility in her silver eyes.

Feng Yao shook her head at that. "You don’t need to look at me like that, Yin Yue. Since you have been freed from your berserk state, you should have remembered my reason for sealing and imprisoning your soul here. If you didn’t slaughter those people back then, I definitely wouldn’t do this to you."

"Keh... Keh... Keh..." Yin Yue fiercely stared at Feng Yao. "What brings you here today, Guang Zhiyi? You’ve been reincarnated several times, but I can never get over that annoying scent coming from your body."
’Guang Zhiyi?’ Feng Jiu and the others exchanged looks of surprise. ’Could it be her other past name?’
"You—"
"That’s enough, Ling’er." Feng Yao walked in front of Yin Yue. "I came here to give you a chance to reincarnate."

"Keh... Keh... Keh..." Yin Yue laughed loudly, but her expression was one of disbelief. "Who are you trying to lie to? I’ve long been aware of my situation, and my soul is no longer fit to reincarnate due to the regret and resentment that linger within me."

Feng Yao created a qi screen and showed Yin Yue about Zhang Fei, causing her to frown. "I can’t help you reincarnate, but he can. He’s in this dungeon now, and he’ll reach this place later. You may not know him, but I know him well, and I know a lot about his abilities. He may be young, but he’s an expert soul cultivator, and most importantly, he’s Hu Tianlang’s sole heir."

sentences.text: *Thud...
Thud...*
Feng Yao casually landed in front of the Endless Night Castle in the center of the labyrinth, followed by her parents and three subordinates.
The palace was built from black stones that have not decayed despite countless ages.
They absorbed light, giving it a cold and oppressive atmosphere.
The palace was enormous, with collapsed ponds, dead rivers, courtyards, and broken pillars that stretched for miles.
Old ruined lanterns hung on the few remaining walls, burning with an unnatural blue flame that never faded.
Although the surrounding area was in disarray, the main building of the palace was still visible, with several large holes in some of the walls of its three floors.
In some areas, they could see many incomplete statues, having been destroyed by time.
However, some statues were still physically visible, indicating that they were demon statues.
Even though she had seen many dangerous and scary places in the past, Feng Jiu shivered in fear as they stood in front of the ruined palace.
She hugged Feng Tian’s arm tightly while asking their daughter.
"Who exactly was the old owner of this dungeon, Yao’er?"
"The Silver Moon Clan was once part of the ancient races, and their clan was divided into two races: humans and demons.
The two races coexisted harmoniously despite their differences." Feng Yao led them to enter the castle, and they saw many ruined murals on the walls inside.
"Despite the clan name, their members were masters in darkness arts and everything related to Yin.
These murals depicted their prowess in war with other clans, and they were much superior to them, except for one clan, the Golden Sun Clan.
As for the Endless Night name, people in the past called it that because there was no light whatsoever, and there was only darkness all around."
"Does that mean the Golden Sun Clan and the Silver Moon Clan were the leaders of the ancient clans in the past?" Feng Tian asked while observing the murals in front of them.
"Both clans were the ancient clans’ leaders, and they were no different from the winged and demon races." Feng Jiu and Feng Tian looked at Feng Yao directly.
"Both clans already existed long before the other ancient clans, and they were truly powerful.
Even though the backbone of the Silver Moon Clan was humans and demons, it was inhabited by quite a lot of evil beast races, but the clan members regarded them merely as tools."
"What about the Golden Sun Clan?"
"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed.
"Shouldn’t you already know the answer, Mother?
The Golden Sun Clan was inhabited by winged races and humans, and there were also virtue beast races like our phoenix race.
However, the true leader of the clan was a member of the winged race, and they excelled in light arts and everything related to Yang.
Their history is too long, and it will take up a lot of time to retell it all.
The main point is that all the cultivators in the Paradise Realm are distant descendants of the ancients, but era changes caused them to split into many clans and races that exist today."
"So, what is your purpose in bringing us here, Empress?"
"Let’s go to the throne room first." Feng Yao led them forward, but countless blue flames suddenly appeared and attacked them.
She shook her head slightly, waved her hand, and instantly wiped them out.
"Those blue flames are the remnant souls of the Silver Moon Clan members, but they were unable to enter the cycle of reincarnation because they died with deep regrets weighing on their souls."
"Empress!
Don’t tell me that their leader’s soul still resides in the throne room."
Feng Yao tilted her head to the side and teased Huo Yu’er.
"Are you afraid of ghosts, Yu’er?"
"Ugh!
I’d rather face living beings than ghosts, Empress." Huo Yu’er replied, hugging her shivering body.
"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled.
"You are right; their leader’s soul is on the throne now, and we will go to meet her."
"No!" Huo Yu’er screamed loudly and wanted to run away, but Huo Lanyin swiftly grabbed her hand.
"Let me go, Sister Lanyin!
I don’t want to meet a ghost!"
Huo Lanyin shook her head in response.
"What do you have to be afraid of with our empress here?
She is stronger than anyone, and she can destroy the ghost easily."
"But—"
"Stop complaining." Huo Lanyin immediately pulled Huo Yu’er away, followed by Huo Hao’er, who laughed out loud.
"Empress!
Help me!
Sister Lanyin wants to kill me!"
"Let’s follow them." Feng Yao immediately led her parents on their way while explaining some things about the Silver Moon Clan to them.
Sometime later, they arrived in front of the throne room.
Although other areas of the palace were in disarray, the black stone gate leading inside was still intact.
"Ugh!" Huo Yu’er hugged Huo Lanyin’s arm tightly when she sensed a strong aura from within the throne.
"This ghost must be powerful!
Its aura is so cold it’s bone-chilling!"
Huo Lanyin and Huo Hao’er sighed helplessly, especially since Huo Yu’er kept acting like a scared little girl even though she was a powerful cultivator.
"Yao’er, this door is sealed, right?"

"Actually, I sealed this door because she went berserk and killed numerous cultivators who entered this dungeon in the past." Huo Yu’er became even more frightened and her face also turned deathly pale once Feng Yao said that.
"If I hadn’t imprisoned her soul back then, those people would never have dared to enter this dungeon, especially since they would die immediately upon entering."
"Empress, we—Mhmm..." Huo Lanyin covered Huo Yu’er’s mouth with her hands immediately.
"Then, what are we doing here now?
Do you intend to free her?" Feng Tian asked with a serious look.
"I imprisoned her soul here for millions of years, and she should have already broken free from her berserk state.
Therefore, we will go in and check her condition first, and I will decide after confirming it." Feng Yao touched the door and muttered something.
Feng Jiu and the others were stunned when several huge red chains appeared before them with a large padlock in the middle, which was part of the seal that Feng Yao had used to seal the throne room.
Soon, the padlock opened by itself before shrinking to a small size, as did the red chains.
Feng Yao stored them into her storage ring and pushed the door open, but a burst of cold air immediately swept through them, pushing the others several steps backwards.
Huo Yu’er panicked until her body trembled violently, and cold sweat began to wet her body, but Huo Lanyin held her very tightly.
Huo Ling instantly appeared in front of them, waved her hand, and dispelled the cold air.
"Dead woman!
You don’t have to scare us!
If it weren’t for my master, I would have tortured your soul with my eternal flame long ago!"
"Keh...
Keh...
Keh..." A woman’s horrified laughter greeted them.
’Ugh!
I’m going to die!
I will definitely die!’ Huo Yu’er inwardly muttered, closing her eyes tightly.
"Let’s go." Feng Yao directly led them inside, with Huo Ling walking by her side while hugging her waist.
Huo Lanyin forcefully pulled Huo Yu’er, who was frightened of the woman, inside with Huo Hao’er walking beside them.
Huo Yu’er was not the only woman who was frightened by the woman, but Feng Jiu was also frightened by her.
She hugged Feng Tian, who led her inside, very tightly.
Feng Yao shot out several small flames in several directions, lighting the torches around the room and illuminating the dark, cold room.
Feng Jiu and Huo Yu’er gasped in shock as they saw the woman’s soul sitting on the throne, but her hands and legs were bound by chains to the side of the room.
Several other chains were wrapped around her body, tying her to the throne.
"Keh...
Keh...
Keh..." The woman kept releasing horrified laughter as she looked at Feng Yao with hostility in her silver eyes.
Feng Yao shook her head at that.
"You don’t need to look at me like that, Yin Yue.
Since you have been freed from your berserk state, you should have remembered my reason for sealing and imprisoning your soul here.
If you didn’t slaughter those people back then, I definitely wouldn’t do this to you."
"Keh...
Keh...
Keh..." Yin Yue fiercely stared at Feng Yao.
"What brings you here today, Guang Zhiyi?
You’ve been reincarnated several times, but I can never get over that annoying scent coming from your body."
’Guang Zhiyi?’ Feng Jiu and the others exchanged looks of surprise. ’Could it be her other past name?’
"You—"
"That’s enough, Ling’er." Feng Yao walked in front of Yin Yue.
"I came here to give you a chance to reincarnate."
"Keh...
Keh...
Keh..." Yin Yue laughed loudly, but her expression was one of disbelief.
"Who are you trying to lie to?
I’ve long been aware of my situation, and my soul is no longer fit to reincarnate due to the regret and resentment that linger within me."
Feng Yao created a qi screen and showed Yin Yue about Zhang Fei, causing her to frown.
"I can’t help you reincarnate, but he can.
He’s in this dungeon now, and he’ll reach this place later.
You may not know him, but I know him well, and I know a lot about his abilities.
He may be young, but he’s an expert soul cultivator, and most importantly, he’s Hu Tianlang’s sole heir."

chapters.title: Chapter 1189: Second Area: Cavern
paragraphs: "Hu Tianlang’s sole heir." Yin Yue’s expression turned shocked.

Feng Yao then displayed one of the stone monuments left by the ten-tailed fox. "Hu Tianlang wrote them himself, and Zhang Fei is the only person who can cleanse your soul of your regret. Once you enter the cycle of reincarnation, the souls of your race members will also be free from their regret, and they can start their new lives in the next life."

"Why do you want to help us? What is your goal?" Yin Yue looked at Feng Yao with full seriousness. "Back then, you could have saved our two clans from the catastrophe, but you refused to help us, and you let our clans die."

"I came this time to free you from your suffering, not to discuss the past. I have shown you the way, but the choice is yours. If you want you and your race members to be free, you can wait for Zhang Fei to come, and he will free you all." Feng Yao then turned to leave, leaving Yin Yue to consider her proposed solution first. However, she stopped after walking a few steps before turning to her. "Back then, I had the power to save both clans, but something prevented me from doing so, and I could only stand there watching your destruction."
"What do you mean by that?" Feng Yao let out a soft sigh and showed Yin Yue something, but only the two of them and Huo Ling could see it. "That’s—"

"It was the reason I couldn’t save your Silver Moon Clan and the Golden Sun Clan back then, and it was also my reason to undergo multiple reincarnations." Yin Yue was speechless in response to Feng Yao. "Unfortunately, I never managed to find someone capable of freeing me from my shackles in my previous lives, but I have found him now."
"Zhang Fei."
"That’s right." Feng Yao then continued walking out. "I’ve told you the truth, so you can consider your options."

After Feng Yao and the others left, the door to the throne room closed by itself, leaving Yin Yue to ponder alone on her throne. She released a soft sigh and stared at the door. "Can Zhang Fei really free us from our regret and resentment, Guang Zhiyi?"
Outside, Feng Jiu grabbed Feng Yao’s hand and questioned her. "What did you mean by those words just now, Yao’er? What did you mean by your shackles?"

"Yao’er, I understand that you have had many identities in your past lives, but in this life, we are your parents. As your parents, we will always worry about you." Feng Tian then grabbed her shoulder. "Back then, you told us that you would disappear one day, but you were never willing to tell us the truth. It became a burden on our minds, so I hope you are willing to tell us the truth."
Hearing that, Huo Lanyi, Huo Yu’er, and Huo Hao’er intensely stared at Feng Yao, waiting for her to reveal the truth.

Unfortunately, Feng Yao’s quick rejection of her parents’ request dashed their hopes. "I’m sorry, but it’s not time for you to know the truth yet, especially since this matter is far beyond your reach. Moreover, this problem is not only related to me, but it is related to something higher. If I feel you are all ready, I will tell you the truth."

Feng Jiu and Feng Tian were disappointed by that, but they realized that they couldn’t force Feng Yao to say everything, as she was simply much stronger than them. "You have to tell us the truth at that time, okay?"

"I will." Feng Yao then checked the entire area of the Endless Night Domain. Unlike other cultivators, the restriction is completely useless in stopping her or Huo Ling, and she can monitor all areas without any effort. "I didn’t expect he would bring all his clones here."
"Where is Zhang Fei now? Are we going to his location now?"
"There." Feng Yao pointed in one direction. "The Endless Night Cave is located far in that direction, and he is on his way there now."
"Is there anything good in that place, Empress?" Huo Yu’er asked.
"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled before embracing her waist. "Little Yu’er, I’ll take you there if you want to meet tens of thousands of ghosts."

"No!" Huo Yu’er shouted as she broke free from Feng Yao’s embrace. She shook her head while crossing her arms in front of her chest. "Empress, I don’t want to meet those ghosts! Therefore, we should avoid that location and instead go to another area, such as the garden. That way, Sister Lanyi can harvest a lot of herbs there, or those cultivators will get ahead of us."
"Hahaha." Feng Yao and the others burst into laughter seeing her act like that. "Alright, I’ll take you all somewhere else."

While the people in the dungeon were trying to reach their destinations, more than a thousand evil beasts flew into the Twin Flame Domain, and their aura brought panic to the domain’s inhabitants. They were led by several mythical beasts, one of which was a giant black dragon, which looked more like a European dragon than a Chinese dragon like Long Wuzhao.

They flew at full speed toward the central area of the domain. A mythical beast, the dark qilin, flew to the black dragon’s side. "Xie Heilong! We’re a little late; those people seem to have entered the dungeon."

"Better late than never, Yao Qilin." Xie Heilong looked back. "Fly faster! Otherwise, we will fall behind those people! Remember! We don’t just focus on finding treasures in there, but we also have to focus on capturing their strongest younger generations and bringing them back to our domain!"
"Yes, sir!"
In a few minutes, they had arrived at the central area. They didn’t waste any more time; Xie Heilong, Yao Qilin, and the other evil mythical beasts immediately led their men into the dungeon.

Zhang Fei’s five clones had already arrived at an area slightly away from the Endless Night Cave, where they saw hundreds of thousands or perhaps millions of blackish-white flames floating around the cave.

"So many Soul Flames!" Nalan Yushu licked her lips after seeing them, impatiently wanting to devour them. "How many people actually lived in this dungeon in the past? How can there be so many soul flames here?"
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at her. "These soul flames are different from the one I absorbed in the Nine Hells Darkland Realm, and their souls still possess their consciousness."
"So, they haven’t completely turned into soul flames, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Luo Yunxiao. "In the past, someone massacred all the inhabitants of that realm, and since they died with a deep grudge, they turned into wandering souls. As time passed, their numbers continued to increase until they merged into one, becoming the evil soul flame and the wandering soul demon. Unlike them, these people seem to die of natural causes because I can’t sense any grudge in their souls, but I can feel deep regret in their souls, preventing them from being reincarnated."

Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding and spoke directly to Nalan Yushu. "Since they haven’t completely transformed into soul flames, we can still save them and help them reincarnate, so you can’t devour them, Sister Yushu."
"Tch!" Nalan Yushu was annoyed by that. "It doesn’t matter if I devour a few of them, right?"

"I don’t know them, but they aren’t evil souls, so I forbid you from devouring any of them." Nalan Yushu sighed in disappointment that Zhang Fei [5] agreed with Luo Yunxiao. "You don’t need to be like this, okay? You have me, and I will continue to help you with my soul power."

"Whatever." Nalan Yushu flew to a tree in the distance, sat there, and stared at those soul flames with a full desire to devour them. Unfortunately, her soul was bound with Zhang Fei [5]’s, and he could stop her easily if she intended to devour them. ’Tch! My life was more comfortable before I reshaped my body.’

Luo Yunxiao and the others stole a glance at Nalan Yushu before sighing. After all, she was a soul-devouring demon, and she was accustomed to devouring the souls of living beings, which would strengthen her.
"Husband, how—"
"Shh." Zhang Fei [5] stopped Luo Yunxiao and pointed far away. "Powerful demons are on their way here, and they will arrive soon, so suppress your auras now."

Luo Yunxiao and the others immediately followed Zhang Fei [5]’s order, including Nalan Yushu, who was sulking on another tree. The other women, who were with the other four clones, also did the same, as they could already feel the demons’ power from a distance.

As soon as she detected the movement of the evil beast races, Mei immediately informed Zhang Fei [5]. [The situation has changed, Master. As you previously predicted, I detected over a thousand evil beasts entering this dungeon, and many of them are mythical beasts.]
Zhang Fei [5] frowned at that. ’Show their location on the map, Mei.’
[Alright.]
’Hmm?’ Zhang Fei [5] frowned even deeper as he looked at the map, especially since the names of all the evil beasts were in red, which meant they had malicious intentions.

Zhang Fei [5] and the other clones warned them, including Nalan Yushu. However, two evil mythical beasts suddenly appeared not far from their location. ’Shit! Their cultivation is at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm!’

chapters.title: Chapter 1190: Beasts And Demons
paragraphs: Since most of them were beasts, they sent them back to the beast space. They did not stay there and instead took the other women away, while Zhang Fei [5], Luo Yunxiao, and Nalan Yushu chose to remain.
’Are they evil mythical beasts, husband?’ Luo Yunxiao inquired via the harem link.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. ’They are the Two-Headed Ghost Dragon and the Blood-Horned Xiezhi, and their cultivation is at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.’
’What kind of beast is Blood-Horned Xiezhi?’ Nalan Yushu asked, observing the beast.

Zhang Fei [5] read the data about the beast that Mei had displayed before informing them. ’The Blood-Horned Xiezhi is a corrupted version of the normal Xiezhi, renowned as a righteous judge of good and evil. I don’t know how it turned evil, but it possesses extraordinary abilities, and its judgment flame is quite deadly, especially to those who are wicked.’
’Since the beast itself has become evil, it should lose its abilities, right?’

’You are mistaken, Yunxiao.’ Zhang Fei [5] pointed to the blood horn on the beast’s head. ’Although it has become evil, it still possesses the judgment flame. Additionally, its roar will directly attack our souls, causing them to shatter immediately if we are weak. Its horn is also scary because it will cause endless bleeding no matter how good our healing is or how many healing items we consume.’
’What about the Two-Headed Ghost Dragon?’

’The Two-Headed Ghost Dragon was born from two corrupted dragon corpses, nourished by yin miasma and lingering resentment. The left head can release a Yin Flame, while the right head can devour almost everything, including souls. If the beast manages to devour our souls, we will live as soulless puppets for the rest of our lives.’ Both women looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a frown. ’The beast is almost immortal, especially since it will continue to regenerate by absorbing the souls of living creatures. The only way to kill it is to keep it away from this kind of place, and we must burn its body to ashes before it has a chance to regenerate.’
’Then—’ Nalan Yushu did not continue her words, and her expression turned furious as the Two-Headed Ghost Dragon began to devour those souls. ’This bastard! Those souls are mine!’
Zhang Fei [5] grabbed her shoulder. ’Forget those souls! We are not the Two-Headed Ghost Dragon’s match, and we will only die in vain if we attack it.’

’Tch!’ Nalan Yushu gritted her teeth, but to her surprise, three demons suddenly appeared. ’The man in black is Mo Taizi, the second prince of the Celestial Demon Race, and the two old men behind him are Mo Shentian’s confidants.’
’Oh?’ Zhang Fei [5] checked the data about the three demons. ’Mo Zuozai and Mo Zhengzai’s cultivation has reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable too.’

Nalan Yushu nodded at him. ’Their role within the Celestial Demon Race is crucial, and Mo Shentian mostly delegates external affairs to them. However, I feel there is something strange about them, so we should listen to their conversation first.’
’Yeah.’

"Hey, Long Gui! Stop absorbing those souls!" The Blood-Horned Xiezhi spoke to his comrade before turning into a man with a tall and slender figure, clad in armor forged of black bone and blood runes, carrying a suffocating killing intent. His eyes have crimson irises with black sclera. His dark crimson-black hair was left messy, and a jagged blood-red horn protruded from his forehead.

Long Gui immediately stopped and looked at the three demons for a while before turning into a man with long, pale white hair, a bulky figure, and pale skin with faint scales. His left eye was ghostly white, and the right was blood crimson. Two pale white dragon horns curved backwards from his temples. A subtle shadow lingered behind him, like a distorted second figure, symbolizing the dragon’s other head. "You three are from the Celestial Demon Race, right?"
"Yes, two seniors." Mo Taizi respectfully replied. "My father asked me to meet one of the leaders of the evil beast races, but I didn’t expect to meet you two here."
Long Gui turned to his friend before asking them, "What does Mo Shentian want from us?"

"Cooperation." Mo Zhengzai’s answer surprised both beasts. "My lord wants to unite all demon races under his control, but he can’t do it alone, with all the demon gods’ strengths almost equal. Some demon gods are on his side, but others still harbor desires to take his place. Therefore, he wants to cooperate with the evil beast races to subdue them."
Long Gui raised an eyebrow after hearing that. "What do you think about that, Xie Zhi?"

"Hmm?" Xie Zhi rested his chin in thought. "As far as I know, the situation in the demon race is almost the same as ours. and we always had difficulty subduing those beast races under the leadership of Long Wuzhao. If all the demon races unite under Mo Shentian, he should be able to help us get rid of them. However, we cannot make a decision regarding this matter, and we must inform our leaders first of his request. Unfortunately, we can’t contact them from this dungeon, so we’ll have to wait to get back to report it."
"You’re right." Long Gui then spoke to them. "Tell Mo Shentian that we will report this matter to our leaders later, and they will definitely send someone to meet him afterwards."
The three demons nodded to them. "Alright, I will tell my father about this."
"So, which demon race does Mo Shentian target first? I’m sure it’s not the Asura Demon Race, right?" Xie Zhi asked them.

"Currently, our demon race is related to the Asura Demon Race by marriage, and Shang Zhanluo’s strength cannot be underestimated. He will be truly powerful if he uses the Asura Bloodline Awakening Technique; not even your four leaders can stop him." Xie Zhi and Long Gui frowned at Mo Zuozai, but they did not refute him. "The weakest of the ten demon gods is Qi Qingxiu, but her ability to control the seven emotions of living beings is very troublesome, and I’m sure Lord Qiongqi must still remember the effects of her abilities."

Xie Zhi nodded in agreement with that. "Lord Qiongqi has long been attracted to Qi Qingxiu, and he longed for her to be his wife. However, she kept rejecting him, and she used her abilities to chase him away."

"That’s why we won’t make a move against Qi Qingxiu for now, and we’ll start from the Faceless Demon Race." Mo Zuozai’s answer surprised them. "That demon race has the best stealth skills, and we will utilize their abilities to infiltrate the other demon races. My lord is confident that no demon god will notice our actions, but we have one problem."
"What’s the problem?"

"The problem is that we are having difficulty finding Wu Mian’s true body." Xie Zhi and Long Gui were not too surprised by Mo Taizi’s answer. "Apart from his ability to disguise himself, he also has the ability to switch bodies, and we still haven’t managed to find the location of his true body."

Mo Zhengzai then spoke. "If we want to subdue Wu Mian, we must find his true body first. My lord said that someone among the evil beast races has the ability to do so, so he hopes she can help us find his true body."

"Mo Shentian is right about that." Long Gui replied with a light nod. "However, that woman is beyond our lords’ control, and she dislikes your demon race. Therefore, I’m sure she won’t be willing to help you, so you have to think of another way to find Wu Mian’s true body."
"What really happened, Senior? Why does she dislike our demon race?" Mo Taizi asked.
Long Gui shook his head in response. "I don’t know the details, but your father surely knows her reasons, especially since she hates him so much."
"What’s her name, Senior? What kind of beast is she?"

Xie Zhi told them directly, "No one knows what kind of beast Dong Xuanyin is. She looks more like a koi, but she also looks like a carp. She has a third eye that can see through almost everything, including the disguises of the Faceless Demon Race, so she is the only beast that can help you find Wu Mian’s true body. If you want her help, you have to ask Mo Shentian to see her first; otherwise, you should forget about it."

"I see." Mo Taizi nodded in understanding. "In that case, I will discuss the matter with my father after we return. Since our discussion is over, we will go to carry out our other tasks, two seniors."

"Go." After the three demons left, Long Gui asked Xie Zhi. "Do you think it would be beneficial if we cooperated with them? Lord Taotie once said that Mo Shentian had sky-high ambitions; he not only wanted to unite the demon race, but he also wanted to subdue the other races."

Xie Zhi could only shake his head. "We only need to convey Mo Shentian’s request to our leaders, and they will decide whether to accept it or not. They are not stupid, and they know his cunning, so the cooperation will probably never happen. Let’s go! There’s nothing here but these souls, so we don’t need to waste time here."
Long Gui looked at the souls below them before following Xie Zhi, relieving Zhang Fei [5] and the two women.

chapters.title: Chapter 1191: Third Area: Abyss
paragraphs: Nalan Yushu moved above those souls, summoned a giant mouth above her, and devoured the remaining ones.
"Husband, she—"

"Let her be, Yunxiao." Zhang Fei [5] contacted the others, informing them about the presence of the evil beasts. "I didn’t expect that Mo Shentian would send his second son and two confidants to contact those beasts, let alone that he wanted to cooperate with them. The situation in the demon races might be chaotic if he succeeded in finding the true body of the Faceless Demon God, and it would also affect the Eternal Night Demon Race and the Soul-Devouring Demon Race."
"Are you going to interfere in their matters, husband?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I have no relationship with the other demon races, so I can’t care about them. While the Eternal Night and the Soul-Devouring Demon Races are different from them, I will not directly interfere in this matter, and I have already warned Ye Futian about Mo Shentian’s plans."
"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "Were you able to track the others?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Qing Qiu’er is on her way to pick up nearby disciples, and I have asked You Feiling to search for the others along with the elders. Bing Xingying has already secured your family and the cultivators from the Empyrean Domain, so you don’t need to worry about them. Feng Yao had already noticed the presence of the evil demon beasts; she and her three subordinates have already moved to protect the others, so I’m sure they will be fine."
"Phew." Luo Yunxio breathed a sigh of relief after hearing that her family members were fine. "What about Tian Huangjin, Tianshi Shengjie, and the people from the two demon races?"

"Tianshi Shengjie and the beast races are far away in that area, and they’re fighting some of those beasts." Zhang Fei [5] pointed northwest before pointing east. Tian Huangjin and the winged race are 3,000 miles east, but no evil beasts are there, and they’re only fighting demons. The people from the Eternal Night and Soul-Devouring Demon Races fell not far from each other, and Ye Futian was with them now. They haven’t encountered those evil beasts or other races, so their situation is relatively safe. However, many fights have already occurred in several areas, and many victims have fallen from various races."

"Tch! That damn ghost dragon devoured most of those souls, and I only got a few!" Nalan Yushu complained as soon as she returned to their side. "So, what should we do now? There’s nothing interesting left in this place now that those souls are gone."

"My four other clones have already moved to several other locations, and the closest one to this place is the Endless Night Abyss." Zhang Fei [5] pointed to the south of their location. "The abyss is over there, but there are quite a lot of evil beasts nearby. I wanted to avoid that place, but I felt like there was something there, so we’ll go there now."
"What do you mean by that, Master?"
"Did you detect anything from that place, Husband?"
"I can’t confirm it yet, so we’ll have to check first." Zhang Fei [5] hugged their waists, brought both of them into an invisible state, and used the Nine Cloud Steps to bring them there.
In a matter of seconds, they had arrived above the Endless Night Abyss, where they saw many evil beasts lining the edge, led by the dark Qilin, Yao Qilin.

Yao Qilin’s human form is quite sexy and pretty, with pale skin, slanted eyes with black eyeliner, a straight nose, and full lips. Her jet-black, long hair is left loose. Her figure is voluptuous with noticeable fullness and roundness, supported by a fitted, deep-cut black dress that shows off her deep cleavage, hourglass curves, and toned legs.

The Endless Night Abyss is a massive pit. Its walls are sheer black stone, and the darkness within makes it difficult for people to see the bottom. Cold winds rise constantly from below, carrying whispers that disturb the mind and weaken the will. Cultivators who stare into it for too long often hear voices calling their names, luring them to jump in.
Zhang Fei [5] and the two women could see that Yao Qilin wanted to enter the place, but she seemed hesitant to do so, leaving them wondering about the area within the abyss.

Zhang Fei [5] tried to check the inside of the Endless Night Abyss, but the map could only detect up to the middle area. ’I can’t check the inside, especially since it’s too dark. The only way to check it is to go in directly, but I don’t know what awaits us inside. Moreover, Yao Qilin seems to intend to go in, so I will send you two to my other clones’ places, and I will go in myself.’
’But, master, you—’

’Sister Yushu, have you forgotten that our husband still has another identity?’ Nalan Yushu turned to Luo Yunxia. ’His fourth identity is the Calamity Demon Dragon, remember? If he used that form to go in there, I’m sure Yao Qilin wouldn’t be able to differentiate him from other evil beasts. Moreover, he can run away whenever he wants, so he’ll be fine.’
Nalan Yushu nodded at her. ’Alright, bring us to your other clone’s place.’

Zhang Fei [5] took the two women a little away from the abyss, and she sent them into the training space. This way, his other clone could take them out elsewhere, and he returned to their previous location afterwards.
After transforming into his fourth form, Zhang Fei [5] immediately entered the Endless Night Abyss in an invisible state, unlike Yao Qilin, who was still hesitant about doing so.
After thinking about it for some time, Yao Qilin decided to enter the abyss. She looked at the other evil beasts. "Go to Xie Heilong and tell him my location if I don’t return in a few hours."
"Yes, Leader."

Thereafter, Yao Qilin immediately flew down into the abyss, but she did so very carefully. Just like Zhang Fei [5], she couldn’t see the middle area down to the bottom of the abyss, and the strange voices coming from within gave her a bad feeling.
Zhang Fei [5] had already arrived at the bottom of the abyss, but the place was simply too dark. His map still couldn’t detect anything there, but he could see that Yao Qilin had begun to fly down.

"Keh... Keh... Keh..." The eerie laugh startled Zhang Fei [5], who immediately spun around in place to seek the source. "Keh... Keh... Keh... I haven’t smelled the scent of a living being in a long time, and your soul smells good."
’A man?’ Zhang Fei [5] kept trying to seek the source while asking. "Who are you? Where are you? How did you get trapped here?"
"Keh... Keh... Keh... I’m over here." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly saw a faint golden light from a distance. "Keh... Keh... Keh... Do you have the guts to meet me, young beast?"

Zhang Fei [5] frowned at that, but he hesitated to decide, especially since he didn’t have any information about the mysterious man. Additionally, he sensed that the abyss was unusual, particularly because he could detect several formations within it, even though the darkness prevented him from seeing them directly.

[Master, you have to be careful, especially since this dungeon used to be the residence of ancient races. I’m sure that mysterious man is the soul of one of the ancients, and his soul power should be stronger than yours. If that’s true, I’m afraid that he will possess your body and destroy your soul.]
’I know.’ Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly and considered his options.

Since Zhang Fei [5] continued to hesitate, the mysterious man tried to provoke him. "Keh... Keh... Keh... You seem like a coward, young beast. If you don’t have the guts to meet me, you should go back up there, and I’ll wait for that female Dark Qilin to come to me."
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow. "So, you can see all the way out there, huh?"
"Keh... Keh... Keh..." The mysterious man laughed at that. "Even though I’ve been dead for millions of years, my soul is still as strong as in the past, so it’s not hard for me to check out there."
Zhang Fei [5] eventually decided to meet the mysterious man, but he walked very slowly. "Tell me, who exactly are you? How did you get trapped here? Who imprisoned your soul here?"
"You don’t have any information about this place, yet you dare set foot in it."

"I only know that this place once belonged to the Silver Moon Clan, one of the clans of the ancient races." The mysterious man did not immediately reply to Zhang Fei [5]. "Could it be that you were a member of the Golden Sun Clan in the past?"
The mysterious man immediately answered him. "You’re right, young beast. I was a member of the Golden Sun Clan in the past, but my clan should have been destroyed along with the Silver Moon Clan."

"I don’t have clear information about either clan, but an acquaintance told me that both clans were destroyed by a deadly disaster that occurred in the past." Zhang Fei [5] could hear the disappointed sigh of the mysterious man. "Who exactly are you?"
"My name is Tian Taiyang, a winged race and the second in command of the Golden Sun Clan."

Keh..." The eerie laugh startled Zhang Fei [5], who immediately spun around in place to seek the source.
"Keh...
Keh...
Keh...
I haven’t smelled the scent of a living being in a long time, and your soul smells good."
’A man?’ Zhang Fei [5] kept trying to seek the source while asking.
"Who are you?
Where are you?
How did you get trapped here?"
"Keh...
Keh...
Keh...
I’m over here." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly saw a faint golden light from a distance.
"Keh...
Keh...
Keh...
Do you have the guts to meet me, young beast?"
Zhang Fei [5] frowned at that, but he hesitated to decide, especially since he didn’t have any information about the mysterious man.
Additionally, he sensed that the abyss was unusual, particularly because he could detect several formations within it, even though the darkness prevented him from seeing them directly.
[Master, you have to be careful, especially since this dungeon used to be the residence of ancient races.
I’m sure that mysterious man is the soul of one of the ancients, and his soul power should be stronger than yours.
If that’s true, I’m afraid that he will possess your body and destroy your soul.]
’I know.’ Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly and considered his options.
Since Zhang Fei [5] continued to hesitate, the mysterious man tried to provoke him.
"Keh...
Keh...
Keh...
You seem like a coward, young beast.
If you don’t have the guts to meet me, you should go back up there, and I’ll wait for that female Dark Qilin to come to me."
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow.
"So, you can see all the way out there, huh?"
"Keh...
Keh...
Keh..." The mysterious man laughed at that.
"Even though I’ve been dead for millions of years, my soul is still as strong as in the past, so it’s not hard for me to check out there."
Zhang Fei [5] eventually decided to meet the mysterious man, but he walked very slowly.
"Tell me, who exactly are you?
How did you get trapped here?
Who imprisoned your soul here?"
"You don’t have any information about this place, yet you dare set foot in it."
"I only know that this place once belonged to the Silver Moon Clan, one of the clans of the ancient races." The mysterious man did not immediately reply to Zhang Fei [5].
"Could it be that you were a member of the Golden Sun Clan in the past?"
The mysterious man immediately answered him.
"You’re right, young beast.
I was a member of the Golden Sun Clan in the past, but my clan should have been destroyed along with the Silver Moon Clan."

"I don’t have clear information about either clan, but an acquaintance told me that both clans were destroyed by a deadly disaster that occurred in the past." Zhang Fei [5] could hear the disappointed sigh of the mysterious man.
"Who exactly are you?"
"My name is Tian Taiyang, a winged race and the second in command of the Golden Sun Clan."

[Daily Quest IV: Killing 1000 beasts/demon beasts in the Celestial Lord or above.]
[Reward: Celestial daily pack x1]
*Thud*

Zhang Fei [5] stopped walking as soon as Yao Qilin landed behind him, but the darkness made it difficult for them to see each other. Despite this, the female beast could sense his presence due to her keen sense of smell. "Who are you? How did you get in here without my knowledge with your cultivation still in the Celestial Lord Realm?"

"My name is Long Fei, and I entered this place before you arrived." Yao Qilin raised an eyebrow because she didn’t remember that name being part of their entourage. "I’m not part of your group, and I came to this dungeon with the Soul-Devouring Demon Race."

Yao Qilin frowned and tried to grab Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulder, but he immediately shifted to the side, causing her to grab at empty air. ’Can he see my movements in a place this dark?’ "Who is the group leader of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race?"
"Princess Nalan Wangzi and Prince Nalan Huanzi, but several elders also came to protect them." Zhang Fei [5] casually answered.
"What—"

"How long are you going to wait there, young beast? Would you rather have some fun with that female qilin beast?" Yao Qilin frowned and looked toward the faint golden light in the distance. "After being lonely in this place for so long, I finally have two guests, so I want you two to accompany me for a while."
After Tian Taiyang said that, Zhang Fei [5] and Yao Qilin sensed a powerful aura enveloped over them, which was his soul power.
"Do you know who he is?"

"He said his name is Tian Taiyang, a member of the winged race and the second-in-command of the Golden Sun Clan." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer shocked Yao Qilin. "Even though I’m not as strong as you, I can sense that his soul is powerful; otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to survive here for millions of years."
Yao Qilin agreed with that and took out a black bone whip with blades on both ends. "Let’s go there and meet him."

"Are you sure?" Yao Qilin looked to the side even though she did not know Zhang Fei [5]’s exact location. "If his soul power overcomes your soul power, he will take over your body, and you will be under his control for the rest of your life."

Yao Qilin’s intentions wavered slightly after Zhang Fei [5] said that, and she had second thoughts about approaching Tian Taiyang. Moreover, she is an evil beast, and he is the soul of a winged race, making the two oppose each other. "What about you? Are you thinking about meeting him even though you are much weaker than me?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed. "Hey, many people say that your mythical evil beasts are very evil, but you’re not as bad as I imagined."

Yao Qilin raised her eyebrows slightly. "Aren’t you a mythical evil beast yourself? Although I can’t see your figure clearly, I can smell your dragon scent. Moreover, the evil stench from you is strong, and it is not inferior to Xie Heilong."
"You’re right, I’m an evil dragon." Zhang Fei [5] then walked forward. "If you’re not worried that he will possess your body, you can follow me."
"Hey! Wait for me!" Yao Qilin hurriedly followed behind Zhang Fei [5] by following his scent.

The more they walked forward, the clearer the golden light emitted by Tian Taiyang became. A while later, they arrived in front of him, and the area was quite bright even though the surrounding area was filled with darkness.
"A light within the darkness." Zhang Fei [5] muttered as he looked at Tian Taiyang, but he was quite shocked because both his hands and feet were chained to the sides, as was his body.

"What kind of dragon are you?" Yao Qilin looked at Zhang Fei [5] after she could see his figure. "There are many evil dragons in our Ten Thousand Beast Graves Domain, but I have never seen your kind before."

"This universe is so vast, and I’m sure not all evil dragon races live in your domain, so it’s normal if you have never seen my kind before." Yao Qilin was irritated and surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s demeanor because he was still relaxed and not afraid of her, even though she was much stronger than him. "In fact, I’m not a native of this realm, and I ascended about five years ago."
"Oh." Yao Qilin nodded slightly. "I’ve never descended into the Three Mortal Realms, but I’ve heard there are many evil dragon races there. So, what is your dragon race?"

"Instead of discussing my dragon race, why don’t we talk about him?" Just like Zhang Fei [5], Yao Qilin was also confused by Tian Taiyang’s situation. "How did you end up like this? Who imprisoned your soul here?"

"An ancient female named Guang Zhiyi imprisoned my soul here." Tian Taiyang let out a soft sigh and recounted some past events. "She was the guardian of the ancient races, and her duty was to maintain balance between the clans. My Golden Sun Clan has always been at odds with Yin Yue’s Silver Moon Clan, but our two clans had never engaged in a major, deadly battle before that day’s events."
"What kind of event?"

"The event that caused the deadly disaster, which also destroyed our clans." Zhang Fei [5] and Yao Qilin’s expressions turned serious after Tian Taiyang said that. "The story is too long, and the incident was devastating for our two races, so I don’t want to waste time retelling everything. If you two are curious about that incident, you guys can touch my soul, and I will share everything with you."

Zhang Fei [5] unhesitatingly approached Tian Taiyang and touched his soul. In a few moments, many memories flowed into his mind, but some of them shocked him. ’Feng Yao? So, Guang Zhiyi was her identity in the ancient era, huh? What was her reason for imprisoning this man’s soul here? Since he was imprisoned here, I figured he was one of the two souls I had to free to complete one of the quests. However, these chains are not simple, and I still don’t know her purpose for imprisoning him here.’
"Hey! What did you see?" Yao Qilin grabbed Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulder, bringing him out of his thoughts. He touched her forehead, sharing Tian Taiyang’s memories with her. "Hmm?"

Yao Qilin closed her eyes and watched those memories, but her body trembled and subconsciously took a few steps back because some of them were too terrifying, especially the deadly disaster that destroyed the two clans.

Zhang Fei [5] was amused to see her reaction because she was only one step away from reaching the Celestial God Realm, but she was frightened by those memories. "So, Guang Zhiyi imprisoned your soul here because you triggered the disaster, right?"

"Yes." Tian Taiyang nodded at him. "If only I had controlled my anger back then, the disaster would never have happened, and our two clans would still exist today. As punishment, she imprisoned my soul in this abyss, and she also imprisoned Yin Yue’s soul in her palace."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding, satisfied that he had successfully found both targets of one of his quests. "Did Guang Zhiyi say anything after she imprisoned your soul and Yin Yue’s?"

"She didn’t say anything to me." Tian Taiyang’s answer confused Zhang Fei [5], as he believed that Feng Yao must have a special reason for doing that. "Can you free my soul from this eternal loneliness? I have been imprisoned in this place for too long, and I want to rest forever."

Zhang Fei [5] tried to contact Feng Yao from inside the abyss, but he couldn’t reach her, and he suspected it was because of the formations inside. "I can’t help you at this time, especially since these chains are not ordinary ones. If I touch them, they will absorb my soul power. However, I will think of a way to set you free, and I will return again later."
"Why do you want to free him? Wouldn’t it be easier if we absorbed his soul power?" Yao Qilin suddenly asked.

Zhang Fei [5] turned to her directly. "Even though his soul has been imprisoned here for so long, his light element is still pure, and it will kill us. Even if we could do it, these chains would prevent us from doing so."

"Hmm?" Yao Qilin tried to touch them a little, but they absorbed quite a lot of her soul power, forcing her to pull her hand back. "Holy shit! I’ve never seen such artifacts before! I only touched them briefly, but they absorbed ten percent of my soul power! How can he survive for so long even though they continue to absorb his soul power?"

’Why is this woman so stupid?’ Zhang Fei [5] thought to himself. "This man came from an ancient race, so you can’t compare his soul power with ours. Moreover, these chains didn’t absorb his soul power as quickly as they absorbed yours just now, and they absorbed it little by little."

chapters.title: Chapter 1193: Xie Heilong Come
paragraphs: "Oh." Yao Qilin nodded slightly. "So, what are your next plans? How about joining my group? You’re an evil dragon, and your status is higher than those weak demons, so you shouldn’t waste your time with inferior creatures like them."

"Even though they are inferior to us, they have helped me a lot since I ascended to this realm. I’m evil, but I’m not an ungrateful person." Yao Qilin could have forced Zhang Fei [5] to go with her with her superior cultivation, but she hesitated to do so, mainly because of his calmness and indifferent attitude towards her.

"Up to you, then." Yao Qilin looked at Tian Taiyang for a while before flying away, but she threw a token to Zhang Fei [5]. "If you change your mind, you can activate it, and I will send people to pick you up."
After Yao Qilin disappeared, Tian Taiyang asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Why didn’t you tell that woman that you are the one and only Calamity Demon Dragon?"
"Oh?" Tian Taiyang’s question surprised Zhang Fei [5]. "How did you recognize my beast’s identity if you were dead a long time ago?"

"Hahaha!" Tian Taiyang laughed at that. "Your ignorance amused me, kid. Did you know that there can only be one Calamity Demon Dragon in this universe? The Calamity Demon Dragon is the equivalent of the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, one born of Yin and one born of Yang. Both dragons have existed since the primordial era, just like the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast. However, the primordial beasts killed the two dragons, especially since their existence threatened them."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] frowned at that. "How could the existence of two dragons threaten the two primordial beasts? The Genesis Beast’s abilities are related to creation, and the Nihility Beast’s abilities are related to nothingness; thus, both should be superior to the two dragons, right?"

Tian Taiyang shook his head. "I don’t understand why the two primordial beasts killed the two dragons, especially since I’ve never met either of them. I heard it from stories circulating in the Ancient Era, and some people say that the source was the two dragons who lived in that era. Since you are the current Calamity Demon Dragon, you should be careful of the two primordial beasts. If they find out about your existence, they will send their avatars to kill you. Who is the current Five-Clawed Golden Dragon?"

"Long Wuzhao is the Golden Dragon Emperor of the Paradise Realm." Tian Taiyang naturally had never heard of his name, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained several things about him according to his knowledge. "He has lived for a very long time, and he has become the strongest cultivator in this realm. Given his current status and the fact that the four peril beasts are subordinates of the Primordial Nihility Beast, they should have heard of him. However, I have never heard of the two of them coming after him; he is still alive and safe until now. Even so, I appreciate your warning, and I will definitely be more careful."

"That’s weird." Tian Taiyang muttered to himself. "The Calamity Demon Dragon and the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon of my era died at their hands; they sent their avatars specifically to kill them. Could it be that many changes have occurred after my death?"

"You died millions of years ago, remember? Since then, this universe has experienced many era changes until it reached the current era, and each era brought many changes to this universe." Tian Taiyang nodded his head several times in agreement with Zhang Fei [5]. "As for today, the cultivators from the Paradise Realm cannot go to the Ancient Realm, but the ancients can descend here, and I have met two of them. Moreover, the Calamity Demon Dragon is not my true identity, and I have another identity."
"Oh?" Tian Taiyang looked at Zhang Fei [5] with surprise. "What exactly is your identity?"

Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to his human form, surprising him further. "I was born and grew up as a human, and I still maintain my human identity, even though I have become the Calamity Demon Dragon."
"You are the strangest living creature I have ever met, kid."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed and turned back into a half-dragon. "I don’t have a way to free you yet, and I want to ask someone about you first, so I’ll be leaving now. She should know a way to free you, but I doubt she’ll tell me, especially since she’s repeatedly toyed with me."
"Who is the person you mean?"
"Guang Zhiyi."

"Are—" Tian Taiyang swallowed his words because Zhang Fei [5] had already disappeared from his sight. "Is he joking with me? How could he know Guang Zhiyi? Sigh! I have no choice but to wait for him to return, and I hope he can release me from this eternal prison."

When Zhang Fei [5] arrived on the surface, Yao Qilin and her subordinates were no longer there, and he opened the map to monitor the situation. He frowned when he found many enemies ganging up on Qing Qiu’er and two disciples with her, and he immediately used the Nine Cloud Steps to go to their location.

With his current speed and the technique, Zhang Fei [5] could reach their location in just a few seconds. He summoned the extermination demon sword, channeled his light element, and attacked those enemies. "Second Move! Heaven-Cleaving Slash!"
*Swoosh*

A giant light qi sword shot towards those enemies, splitting those standing in its path and slashing the ground at the same time. Zhang Fei [5] landed in front of Qing Qiu’er and the others, slashing his sword horizontally. "First Move! Severing Slash!"

A wide, long, light qi sword shot out from Zhang Fei [5]’s sword and moved horizontally towards their enemies. In the blink of an eye, those demons and evil beasts had fallen to the ground with their bodies split in two, and their blood soaked the ground beneath them.

Zhang Fei [5] turned to them, but the two disciples were stunned after witnessing him kill so many demons and evil beasts with just two sword techniques. "Why are you two stunned, Bai Fengyun and Han Ziyan?"

"Haha." Qing Qiu’er laughed softly. "How can they not be stunned? Our enemies just now were quite numerous, and some of them had already reached the Celestial King Realm, but you killed them in the blink of an eye."

Bai Fengyun took a deep breath before answering him. "Please forgive me, Elder Zhang. I initially still doubted Sect Master Qing’s decision to choose you, but your sword attacks just now made me realize that we had underestimated you too much."
"That’s true." Han Ziyan nodded in agreement. "How did you manage to kill them so quickly, Elder Zhang?"

Zhang Fei [5] enveloped his body with his light qi. "My light element and elemental law have long since reached their peak, and my second sword technique can cut through anything, including qi protection. Moreover, they were unprepared for my sudden attack, so they didn’t have time to dodge it. If they were in a prepared position, I wouldn’t have been able to do it."
"Huh?" Both Bai Fengyun and Han Ziyan were shocked to hear that. "Have you really mastered the light elemental law, Elder Zhang?"

"Have you two never learned the elemental laws of your elements?" Both of them shook their heads at Zhang Fei [5], who immediately looked at the embarrassed Qing Qiu’er. "Your elements are Fire and Wind, right?"
"My elements are actually light and wind, Elder Zhang." Bai Fengyun answered first.
Han Ziyan nodded at him. "My main element is fire, but I also have the earth element, Elder Zhang."

Zhang Fei [5] already knew that, and he just wanted to have a small talk with them. He then imparted the method for mastering the light and wind elemental laws to Bai Fengyun and the fire elemental law method to Han Ziyan. "As for the earth element, I don’t have a method for mastering it, so I can’t teach you that."
"Huh? Does that mean you also have fire, light, and wind elements, Elder Zhang?" Both asked in shock.
Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er suddenly detected a powerful aura flying fast towards them. "Xie Heilong."
Zhang Fei [5] swiftly transformed into his half-fox form, wrapped three of his tails around their waists, brought them into an invisible state, and took them away from that place.

A few minutes later, the black dragon, Xie Heilong, landed at their previous location. He frowned as he tried to check the surrounding area to no avail. He then crouched at the side of the slash hole from Zhang Fei [5]’s previous attack. "Who used this technique? I can sense the remnants of that person’s light element, and it is no less pure than that of the winged race. Moreover, I already used my maximum speed, but that person was still able to escape from me."
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Xie Heilong’s subordinates landed behind him. "What happened, Lord? Why are you in such a hurry to go to this place?"

"Hmm?" Xie Heilong thought for a moment. "I want you to spread out and search for someone, but I do not know his or her identity. That person is a human who possesses a pure light element, and that person could pose a threat to us, so I want you to find that person as soon as possible."
"Yes, Lord."
