Did you know that there can only be one Calamity Demon Dragon in this universe?
The Calamity Demon Dragon is the equivalent of the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, one born of Yin and one born of Yang.
Both dragons have existed since the primordial era, just like the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast.
However, the primordial beasts killed the two dragons, especially since their existence threatened them."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] frowned at that.
"How could the existence of two dragons threaten the two primordial beasts?
The Genesis Beast’s abilities are related to creation, and the Nihility Beast’s abilities are related to nothingness; thus, both should be superior to the two dragons, right?"
Tian Taiyang shook his head.
"I don’t understand why the two primordial beasts killed the two dragons, especially since I’ve never met either of them.
I heard it from stories circulating in the Ancient Era, and some people say that the source was the two dragons who lived in that era.
Since you are the current Calamity Demon Dragon, you should be careful of the two primordial beasts.
If they find out about your existence, they will send their avatars to kill you.
Who is the current Five-Clawed Golden Dragon?"

"Long Wuzhao is the Golden Dragon Emperor of the Paradise Realm." Tian Taiyang naturally had never heard of his name, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained several things about him according to his knowledge.
"He has lived for a very long time, and he has become the strongest cultivator in this realm.
Given his current status and the fact that the four peril beasts are subordinates of the Primordial Nihility Beast, they should have heard of him.
However, I have never heard of the two of them coming after him; he is still alive and safe until now.
Even so, I appreciate your warning, and I will definitely be more careful."
"That’s weird." Tian Taiyang muttered to himself.
"The Calamity Demon Dragon and the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon of my era died at their hands; they sent their avatars specifically to kill them.
Could it be that many changes have occurred after my death?"
"You died millions of years ago, remember?

Since then, this universe has experienced many era changes until it reached the current era, and each era brought many changes to this universe." Tian Taiyang nodded his head several times in agreement with Zhang Fei [5].
"As for today, the cultivators from the Paradise Realm cannot go to the Ancient Realm, but the ancients can descend here, and I have met two of them.
Moreover, the Calamity Demon Dragon is not my true identity, and I have another identity."
"Oh?" Tian Taiyang looked at Zhang Fei [5] with surprise.
"What exactly is your identity?"
Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to his human form, surprising him further.
"I was born and grew up as a human, and I still maintain my human identity, even though I have become the Calamity Demon Dragon."
"You are the strangest living creature I have ever met, kid."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed and turned back into a half-dragon.
"I don’t have a way to free you yet, and I want to ask someone about you first, so I’ll be leaving now.
She should know a way to free you, but I doubt she’ll tell me, especially since she’s repeatedly toyed with me."
"Who is the person you mean?"
"Guang Zhiyi."
"Are—" Tian Taiyang swallowed his words because Zhang Fei [5] had already disappeared from his sight.
"Is he joking with me?
How could he know Guang Zhiyi?
Sigh!
I have no choice but to wait for him to return, and I hope he can release me from this eternal prison."
When Zhang Fei [5] arrived on the surface, Yao Qilin and her subordinates were no longer there, and he opened the map to monitor the situation.
He frowned when he found many enemies ganging up on Qing Qiu’er and two disciples with her, and he immediately used the Nine Cloud Steps to go to their location.
With his current speed and the technique, Zhang Fei [5] could reach their location in just a few seconds.
He summoned the extermination demon sword, channeled his light element, and attacked those enemies.
"Second Move!
Heaven-Cleaving Slash!"
*Swoosh*
A giant light qi sword shot towards those enemies, splitting those standing in its path and slashing the ground at the same time.
Zhang Fei [5] landed in front of Qing Qiu’er and the others, slashing his sword horizontally.
"First Move!
Severing Slash!"
A wide, long, light qi sword shot out from Zhang Fei [5]’s sword and moved horizontally towards their enemies.
In the blink of an eye, those demons and evil beasts had fallen to the ground with their bodies split in two, and their blood soaked the ground beneath them.
Zhang Fei [5] turned to them, but the two disciples were stunned after witnessing him kill so many demons and evil beasts with just two sword techniques.
"Why are you two stunned, Bai Fengyun and Han Ziyan?"
"Haha." Qing Qiu’er laughed softly.
"How can they not be stunned?
Our enemies just now were quite numerous, and some of them had already reached the Celestial King Realm, but you killed them in the blink of an eye."
Bai Fengyun took a deep breath before answering him.
"Please forgive me, Elder Zhang.
I initially still doubted Sect Master Qing’s decision to choose you, but your sword attacks just now made me realize that we had underestimated you too much."
"That’s true." Han Ziyan nodded in agreement.
"How did you manage to kill them so quickly, Elder Zhang?"
Zhang Fei [5] enveloped his body with his light qi.
"My light element and elemental law have long since reached their peak, and my second sword technique can cut through anything, including qi protection.
Moreover, they were unprepared for my sudden attack, so they didn’t have time to dodge it.
If they were in a prepared position, I wouldn’t have been able to do it."
"Huh?" Both Bai Fengyun and Han Ziyan were shocked to hear that.
"Have you really mastered the light elemental law, Elder Zhang?"
"Have you two never learned the elemental laws of your elements?" Both of them shook their heads at Zhang Fei [5], who immediately looked at the embarrassed Qing Qiu’er.
"Your elements are Fire and Wind, right?"
"My elements are actually light and wind, Elder Zhang." Bai Fengyun answered first.
Han Ziyan nodded at him.
"My main element is fire, but I also have the earth element, Elder Zhang."
Zhang Fei [5] already knew that, and he just wanted to have a small talk with them.
He then imparted the method for mastering the light and wind elemental laws to Bai Fengyun and the fire elemental law method to Han Ziyan.
"As for the earth element, I don’t have a method for mastering it, so I can’t teach you that."
"Huh?
Does that mean you also have fire, light, and wind elements, Elder Zhang?" Both asked in shock.
Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er suddenly detected a powerful aura flying fast towards them.
"Xie Heilong."
Zhang Fei [5] swiftly transformed into his half-fox form, wrapped three of his tails around their waists, brought them into an invisible state, and took them away from that place.
A few minutes later, the black dragon, Xie Heilong, landed at their previous location.
He frowned as he tried to check the surrounding area to no avail.
He then crouched at the side of the slash hole from Zhang Fei [5]’s previous attack.
"Who used this technique?
I can sense the remnants of that person’s light element, and it is no less pure than that of the winged race.
Moreover, I already used my maximum speed, but that person was still able to escape from me."
*Swoosh...
Swoosh...*
Xie Heilong’s subordinates landed behind him.
"What happened, Lord?
Why are you in such a hurry to go to this place?"
"Hmm?" Xie Heilong thought for a moment.
"I want you to spread out and search for someone, but I do not know his or her identity.
That person is a human who possesses a pure light element, and that person could pose a threat to us, so I want you to find that person as soon as possible."
"Yes, Lord."

chapters.title: Chapter 1194: Zhuxian Sheng
paragraphs: Feng Yao and the others stood in the sky, observing every change that occurred in the area below them.
"The arrival of these evil beasts has caused the situation to change rapidly, and they seem to be targeting the talents of the human race." Feng Jiu softly spoke.
"What exactly is their purpose in capturing those young cultivators, Yao’er?"

"I once said that this realm is experiencing a crisis of new talents, right?" Feng Tian and Feng Jiu nodded to Feng Yao. "The main cause is these evil beasts. Over the years, they kidnapped all the new talents that emerged, and they stole their talents for themselves."
"Stealing talents? Can that kind of thing be done?" Both phoenixes asked in shock.
Feng Yao nodded at them. "Naturally, it cannot be done by everyone, but someone in the evil beast races has the ability to do it, especially since he was born with the Myriad Dao Physique."
"The Myriad Dao Physique is a fourth-rank special physique, right?"

"Yes." Feng Yao then explained. "The physique is one of the most unfathomable physiques under the heavens. It is the embodiment of the dao itself. Every law, element, and principle resonates with the bearer’s body and soul. The owner has perfect compatibility with all cultivation methods, and he can comprehend all dao as easily as turning the palm of his hand. Additionally, it grants him the ability to steal other people’s talents and transfer them to others, enhancing the target’s talents and weakening the source’s talents."
"Isn’t that physique too overpowered?"

"Actually, it depends on the owner," Feng Yao’s answer confused them. "It will be overpowered if it is possessed by the right person, but it will be ineffective if the owner lacks fundamental abilities. The current owner of the physique is a useless person, and he is under the complete control of the four evil beasts. In fact, that person is no different from a puppet."
"A puppet?"

Feng Yao nodded. "He was born with that physique, but his cultivation veins were born fragile. If he cultivated too fast, his veins would rupture instantly, and he would become a cripple. He has cultivated for quite a long time, but his cultivation was stuck in the Divine Transformation Realm. Qiongqi accidentally discovered his physique and managed to capture him, and he turned him into a soulless puppet. Since then, the evil beasts began to capture all the outstanding talents, and none of them can stop them, including Long Wuzhao."
"What happened to the victims?"
Feng Yao let out a soft sigh. "They will never be able to advance further on their path of cultivation, and most of them will turn into idiots for the rest of their lives."

Feng Jiu remembered something. "Come to think of it, Zhang Fei doesn’t have that physique, but he managed to walk multiple cultivation paths simultaneously. He managed to master so many techniques, and he also has so many elements. What would happen if he had the Myriad Dao Physique?"

"Haha." Feng Yao laughed softly. "Unlike the owner of the Myriad Dao Physique, Zhang Fei managed to achieve all of that thanks to his persistence and seriousness in learning new things, supported by his already high talent. If he had that physique, he would have mastered far more things, and he would likely become the embodiment of the living Dao. Unfortunately, there are no ifs in life, and he is not destined to have that physique."

Feng Tian’s expression suddenly turned serious. "Why didn’t you stop those evil beasts, Yao’er? You and Huo Ling had the ability to stop them, but you both let them do as they pleased, resulting in countless casualties."
"That’s—"

Feng Yao stopped Huo Ling. "Father, we do have the ability to stop those evil beasts, but there are many things we cannot interfere with, and that matter is one of them. If I make a move, that higher power will not like it, and it will immediately stop me. The current me is indeed powerful, but that power is far beyond your imagination, and I am just a speck of dust in front of it. My main reason for reincarnating over and over again is to free myself from its shackles; only then will I no longer be under its control, and I can be myself."
"What—"
"Wait for the right time, okay? At that time, I will tell you both the truth, and I will help you to be free." Feng Tian and Feng Jiu sighed softly before nodding to Feng Yao.
"Master." Huo Ling pointed to a man. "Isn’t he—"
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at her. "He possesses the Ancestral Battle Saint Physique, and he also possesses the most terrifying element, the Time Element."

"The Time Element!" Feng Tian and Feng Jiu screamed in shock as they observed the man. They could see that the demons and evil beasts surrounding him were moving extremely slowly, and they would sometimes stop in midair, allowing him to kill them without using any techniques. "That man is truly terrifying, Yao’er!"

Feng Yao nodded at them. "Unfortunately, the time element isn’t that simple, and it’s difficult to master. He can control time, but his control over it is still too weak, and he can only use it for a few seconds. Fortunately, he is also a speed cultivator, and his movement techniques give him an advantage over his enemies, especially when combined with his time control."
"If he’s a speed cultivator, how can his attacks be so powerful and deadly? He attacked them with ordinary attacks, yet their bodies shattered instantly." Feng Jiu asked in confusion.

"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed. "Mother, as I said just now, he possesses the Ancestral Battle Saint Physique, and it was born from the spirit of ancient war gods. It embodies the essence of battle itself—unyielding spirit, unstoppable force, and the might to shake heaven and earth through combat alone. His attacks appear ordinary to others, but they are deadly due to his battle intent."
"Battle intent?"

"Battle intent is akin to a battle spirit, but the possessor of that physique can manifest his spirit into something tangible, just like sword cultivators manifest their sword intent. The more he is involved in a battle, the stronger his battle intent will be. The physique also strengthens his entire body, be it inside or out. The disadvantage is that he becomes thirsty for battle, and he often acts rashly because his battle spirit continues to overflow." Feng Yao immediately enveloped them with her aura. "Let’s meet him.

"Who are you guys?" The man was tall and young, with long, straight red hair. His eyes were sharp and piercing, with a cold and indifferent expression. There was a black, sword-like mark on his forehead. He wore a dark robe lined with red cloth, decorated with black sword patterns.

"Zhuxian Sheng, we didn’t come here to look for trouble with you." He was surprised that Feng Yao knew his name, even though he had never known her before. However, he realized that he and Huo Ling were much stronger than him, even though they suppressed their aura as neatly as possible. "I came to you because I needed your help, especially your ability to control time."
Zhuxian Sheng raised an eyebrow. "I don’t have such an ability."

"Is that so?" Feng Yao created a qi screen, displaying Zuxian Sheng’s previous battle against the demons and evil beasts. "Like I said, I don’t want to look for trouble with you; instead, I need your help."

"What do you need from me?" Feng Yao changed the qi screen and displayed Zhang Fei [5], who was picking up several disciples from the Moonlit Passion Sect, confusing Zhuxian Sheng. "Do you want me to attack them?"

"His name is Zhang Fei, an elder of the Moonlit Passion Sect, and he is an acquaintance of mine." Feng Yao’s answer increasingly perplexed Zhuxian Sheng. "You two have similarities, and you both thirst for battle. I need him to help me, but he’s still too weak. I need someone to train him, and I want you to be his sparring partner."
"I don’t have time for that, so you can find someone else to help you." Feng Yao immediately threw a storage ring to Zhuxian Sheng and asked him to check its contents, which shocked him. "How—"
"If you are willing to help me to train Zhang Fei, you can have that item." Feng Yao then told Zhuxian Sheng a few things. "What do you think? Are you willing to accept my request?"
Zhuxian Sheng nodded. "Alright, I’ll accept your request, but don’t blame me if he gets injured, because I often can’t control my thirst for battle, especially when facing someone worthy."

"You don’t need to worry about him because he has excellent recovery abilities." Feng Yao gave him another thing. "I want you to use your full strength when you spar with him, and you don’t need to hold back your killing intent when facing him."
Zhuxian Sheng frowned at that. "If you believe in his abilities so much, why don’t you train him yourself? After all, you and the woman beside you are much stronger than me."
"I have my reasons." Feng Yao immediately led the others away. "Remember! Don’t hold back and fight him with all your might."
Zhuxian Sheng let out a soft sigh and took out an item inside the storage ring, which was a black spear brimming with powerful killing intent. "How did this spear end up in her hand?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1195: Nine-Headed Evil Bird
paragraphs: Huo Lanyin, Huo Yu’er, and Huo Hao’er had already brought most of Zhang Fei’s closest people to the entrance of the Endless Night Labyrinth, as that area was free from demons and evil beasts, mainly because they were still hunting members of other races scattered throughout the various areas of the dungeon.

Not long after, Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the place, and he brought all the members of the Moonlit Passion Sect, both disciples and elders. "I know you guys want to explore other places, but the situation is unsafe right now. I don’t know what they’re planning, but those evil beasts are targeting many young cultivators, and they’ve already captured many people from other sects and clans. Therefore, we will avoid them for now, and we will explore this labyrinth. As for those places, I will take all of you to this place again after they are all gone."
"How are you going to take us back to this dungeon, Elder Zhang?" A female disciple asked.
Another female disciple also spoke. "Elder Zhang, this dungeon only opens once every thousand years, and we can only enter it when the twin moons are perfectly aligned."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "Pei Yingluo and Tang Meixue, I naturally have my way, and I assure you all that there’s no need to worry about that."
"Please show it to us, Elder Zhang," a male disciple named Fu Tianjue, who is also Tang Meixue’s partner, asked.

Another male disciple named Fu Tianjue joined in. "Elder Zhang, we’re not doubting you, but we need valid proof. There are many precious and beneficial items for our cultivation in this dungeon, so we would rather not waste the opportunity by waiting another thousand years."

’These people.’ Zhang Fei [5] opened two gates, shocking everyone except for his old acquaintances. "The right one will take us back to our sect, and the left one will take us back to this dungeon. This way, we can come in and out of this place whenever we want, so we’ll come back here once the entrance closes."
"How—"

"Your elder is a heavenly fox beast, and he has the ability to travel wherever he wants through these gates." Some disciples and elders looked at Zhang Fei [5] in shock after hearing Huo Lanyin’s statement.
Han Ziyan directly spoke to them. "That’s right, Elder Zhang is a fox beast."
"Ziyan and I have seen his half-fox form when he saved us." Bai Fengyun told them.
Fang Roulan also spoke. "I’ve known about his identity as a fox beast since several months ago."
"We should go in now." Zhang Fei [5] closed the two gates and transformed into his half-fox form, shocking them again. "We’ll talk while exploring this labyrinth."
"Yes, Elder Zhang."

Huo Lanyin, Huo Yu’er, and Huo Hao’er did not join them, especially since Feng Yao had asked them to continue monitoring the movements of those evil beasts. Moreover, Zhang Fei’s four other clones are still in other places, exploring those areas.

In one area of the Endless Night Dungeon, Su Shentian and Jian Kuang were fighting those evil beasts. However, their combined abilities were a terrifying threat to those beasts, and the two managed to kill countless of them, including several mythical evil beasts.
"These beasts never give up, huh?" Jian Kuang wiped the blood on his sword. "They know that they are not our opponents, but they keep coming to us just to die."
"Hahaha!" Shu Shentian laughed heartily. "They think we’re weak because we’re humans, but they’re too ignorant, and they don’t know that their four leaders never dared to attack us openly."
Jian Kuang nodded at him. "It seems like they’re keeping us busy on purpose."

"That’s true." Shu Shentian looked away. "If my guess is correct, they are targeting the younger generation of those sects and clans, just like in the past. Therefore, they decided to split up into several groups, and some of them are deliberately keeping us busy so that we can’t save them."
"Then, where—"
*Boom*
Su Shentian and Jian Kuang suddenly heard a powerful explosion several miles away from their location, and they also saw a giant figure of a female winged race in the distance. "Shall we help them?"

"Why not? Zhang Fei is close to the winged race, right?" Su Shentian nodded to Jian Kuang. "I was impatient to find him and spar with him, but the appearance of these evil beasts disrupted my plans. Those winged races are probably fighting them, so we should go there, and I’ll slaughter those foolish beasts."
"Hahaha! Let’s go there!" Both of them immediately flew toward the location of the next fight.
Meanwhile, Tian Huangjin, Tian Zhiling, and Tian Huotian fought fiercely with dozens of evil beasts.
The three members of the winged race were forced to use their ultimate technique, especially since the number of their enemies was simply too numerous compared to them.
The giant female winged race swung her golden sword towards the evil beasts, which matched the movements of Tian Huangjin, Tian Zhiling, and Tian Huotian.

However, a Nine-Headed Evil Bird suddenly flew towards them from the sky, shooting nine darkness balls towards the giant female winged race. The nine darkness balls fiercely slammed into the figure, causing it to disappear instantly.
Tian Huangjin, Tian Zhiling, and Tian Huotian flew quite far back, vomiting quite a lot of blood from their mouths.
*Bam... Bam... Bam...*
Tian Huangjin, Tian Zhiling, and Tian Huotian slammed onto the ground heavily, vomiting blood again. ’Shit! That bird’s cultivation is at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm!’

sentences.text: Huo Lanyin, Huo Yu’er, and Huo Hao’er had already brought most of Zhang Fei’s closest people to the entrance of the Endless Night Labyrinth, as that area was free from demons and evil beasts, mainly because they were still hunting members of other races scattered throughout the various areas of the dungeon.
Not long after, Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the place, and he brought all the members of the Moonlit Passion Sect, both disciples and elders.
"I know you guys want to explore other places, but the situation is unsafe right now.
I don’t know what they’re planning, but those evil beasts are targeting many young cultivators, and they’ve already captured many people from other sects and clans.

As for those places, I will take all of you to this place again after they are all gone."
"How are you going to take us back to this dungeon, Elder Zhang?" A female disciple asked.
Another female disciple also spoke.
"Elder Zhang, this dungeon only opens once every thousand years, and we can only enter it when the twin moons are perfectly aligned."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that.
"Pei Yingluo and Tang Meixue, I naturally have my way, and I assure you all that there’s no need to worry about that."
"Please show it to us, Elder Zhang," a male disciple named Fu Tianjue, who is also Tang Meixue’s partner, asked.
Another male disciple named Fu Tianjue joined in.
"Elder Zhang, we’re not doubting you, but we need valid proof.
There are many precious and beneficial items for our cultivation in this dungeon, so we would rather not waste the opportunity by waiting another thousand years."
’These people.’ Zhang Fei [5] opened two gates, shocking everyone except for his old acquaintances.
"The right one will take us back to our sect, and the left one will take us back to this dungeon.
This way, we can come in and out of this place whenever we want, so we’ll come back here once the entrance closes."
"How—"

"Your elder is a heavenly fox beast, and he has the ability to travel wherever he wants through these gates." Some disciples and elders looked at Zhang Fei [5] in shock after hearing Huo Lanyin’s statement.
Han Ziyan directly spoke to them.
"That’s right, Elder Zhang is a fox beast."
"Ziyan and I have seen his half-fox form when he saved us." Bai Fengyun told them.
Fang Roulan also spoke.
"I’ve known about his identity as a fox beast since several months ago."
"We should go in now." Zhang Fei [5] closed the two gates and transformed into his half-fox form, shocking them again.
"We’ll talk while exploring this labyrinth."
"Yes, Elder Zhang."

"They know that they are not our opponents, but they keep coming to us just to die."

chapters.title: Chapter 1196: Fourth Area: Sanctum
paragraphs: "There’s no need to think about it, as they are members of my sect now." Zhang Fei [1] looked towards their previous location. "I want to talk to you about some things, but I don’t think this is the right time. Moreover, this is just your avatar, and you won’t be able to stay here for too long. Once I’m ready, I will go to the Radiance Domain to meet you, and we’ll talk a lot at that time."
"Alright, I will wait for you." Tian Yizu’s avatar transformed into a golden light and entered Tian Huangjin’s necklace again.
Tian Huangjin and the others immediately rose to their feet. "Where are we now, Zhang Fei?"

"Let’s go there." Zhang Fei [1] led the three members of the Winged Race to a large building not far away. Like the palace and the others, the building was also made of black stone, but it was still completely intact and had not been destroyed by the ravages of time. There, several women were already waiting for them, such as Shangguan Yan, Duanmu Luolan, and several others. "This place should be the Endless Night Sanctum, but I don’t know the inside yet. We just arrived here when I saw the three of you summon that giant female figure, and I immediately rushed over."
Tian Huangjin and the other two nodded slightly. "I didn’t expect to encounter the Nine-Headed Evil Bird, which is one of the ten generals of the evil beast race."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [1] turned to them in surprise. "Who are their generals?"

"The Nine-Headed Evil Bird, Jiu Niao. The Dak Qilin, You Qilin. The Evil Black Dragon, Xie Heilong. The Blood-Horned Xiezhi, Xie Zhi. The Two-Headed Ghost Dragon, Long Gui. The War Devil Beast, Chi You. The Corrupted Dragon-Tiger, Suanni. The Man-Eating Beast, Yayu. The Demonic Wind Beast, Fei Lian. The Three-Eyed Demon Ape, Zhuyan." Zhang Fei [1] himself had heard of those beasts from Chinese mythology, but he was unsure if they were as described by those mythologies. "Actually, the evil beast races still have many powerful beasts whose strength is equal to the ten, but they rarely appear in public like them, so not many know about them."
"It’s okay; we don’t need to worry about them for now," Zhang Fei [1] then questioned Duanmu Luolan. "How is it? Can you open this formation?"

Just as Zhang Fei [1] asked that question, the barrier covering the Endless Night Sanctum opened. Duanmu Luolan looked at him with a proud look. "It wasn’t difficult, right? We can go in and check it out now."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed at her expression. "Let’s go in before other people come here.
"You don’t need to think about them because I can reactivate this formation from within, and I’m sure not many of them can crack it." Duanmu Luolan said this while following behind him.
"That’s good, then."

Despite its name, the Endless Night Sanctum is actually a library where the Silver Moon Clan stores all of their clan techniques, from the ordinary to the forbidden. However, Zhang Fei [1] and the others immediately felt a powerful pressure as soon as they set foot inside, causing some of them to feel dizzy and nauseous.

In the starting room, they saw nothing except many stone tables still neatly arranged despite having long been abandoned. They also saw four hallways in different directions that would lead them to the other four rooms, but their attention fell on the large door at the north end, mainly because its shape was unusual and the material was different from the walls.
"Husband, I think we should split up to check the next rooms." Shangguan Yan said.
"No." Zhang Fei [1] rejected her outright before leading them to the first hallway to their right. "Let’s go there first."

All of them immediately followed Zhang Fei [1] into the room, where the pressure increased. There, they saw dozens of tall bookshelves neatly lined up on each side of the room filled with ancient books, and some of them immediately moved to examine them.
"This place is actually a library belonging to the Silver Moon Clan." Tian Huangjin spoke.
Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her. "I guess there’s no danger here, so you guys can try examining these books first, and I’ll check the other rooms."
"I’ll go with you." Tian Huangjin immediately followed Zhang Fei [1]. On the other hand, Tian Huotian and Tian Zhiling joined Duanmu Luolan and the others, checking the books in the first room.
In the second room, Zhang Fei [1] and Tian Huangjin found many bookshelves inside, and the pressure within was much stronger than in the first room.

"All the books in this room should be more valuable than the previous room." Tian Huangjin walked over to one of the bookshelves and took a book from it. "The Shifting Moon Mirage technique! This should be a movement technique, right?"
"Let me see it." Tian Huangjin handed the book to Zhang Fei [1], who immediately read it.

[Shifting Moon Mirage: The user creates overlapping afterimages of their body while moving, making it extremely difficult for enemies to determine their true position. At higher mastery, the afterimages become tangible mirages that can deflect attacks or strike with partial force, confusing enemies.]

"This technique isn’t just a movement technique; it also combines it with an illusion technique." Zhang Fei [1] returned the book to her. "This technique is similar to my Clone Illusion Steps, so it’s useless for you. However, it’s quite good for you, so you can learn it if you like it."

"Clone Illusion Steps?" Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her and demonstrated his movement technique, amazing Tian Huangjin as his ten clones appeared in front of her. "Your clones seem alive, and I find it difficult to differentiate between you and them."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] softly laughed. "This technique has helped me a lot in the Three Mortal Realms, and I have always managed to outwit my enemies using it. However, no technique is perfect, and many cultivators can still differentiate between my real body and these clones."
Tian Huangjin nodded in understanding. "I’ll look through the books in this room first."
"Alright, I’ll check out the third room." Zhang Fei [1] immediately left Tian Huangjin there.
In the third room, Zhang Fei [1] felt the pressure increase again, and it was several times stronger than in the second room. There, he only found five bookshelves, which were also filled with books.

Zhang Fei [1] carefully checked every bookshelf, looking for techniques that might suit him. A while later, he took a book from one of the shelves, brushed off the dust, and read it. "The Demon-Blood Refinement Art."

[The Demon-Blood Refinement Art: A foundational body cultivation method practiced by the demon branch of the Silver Moon Clan. It awakens and strengthens their demonic bloodlines by circulating Yin demonic force through the veins, forcing impurities out and fusing qi with blood. It has three steps: Blood Tempering, Blood Transforming, and Blood Transcendence.]
[Blood Tempering: The demon blood was condensed and refined, becoming denser and stronger. Impurities are forced out, and the user gains tougher flesh, faster healing, and higher stamina.]

[Blood Transforming: The blood undergoes a transformation, enhancing its bearer’s natural demonic traits. Scales, horns, claws, wings, and other features become stronger, and the blood itself carries corrosive qi that damages enemies while nourishing the body.]

[Blood Transcendence: Demon blood perfectly fuses with pure demon essence, becoming a boundless source of vitality and power, regenerating grievous wounds, and burning enemies with pure destructive energy.]
Zhang Fei [1] nodded his head in satisfaction. "This is an interesting technique, but what does ’pure demon essence’ mean?"
Mei immediately explained to him. [Master, the Pure Demon Essence is the pure origin of demon power. Unlike ordinary demon essence, which is chaotic and violent, it is extremely dense and stable.]
Zhang Fei [1] rubbed his chin in thought. "Doesn’t that mean I already have the Pure Demon Essence in my body?"

[Not yet.] Zhang Fei [1] raised an eyebrow. [Master, all demons are born with ordinary demon essence, including you. You can only get the Pure Demon Essence from ancient demon items, such as Abyssal Heartstone, Abyssal Essence Fruit, Demon Marrow Bead, and many more. Unfortunately, those items only exist in places full of strong and pure demon aura, like those demon domains. You can learn two sub-techniques of the Demon-Blood Refinement Art, but you need the Pure Demon Essence to learn the third sub-technique.]
Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding, stored the book in the system’s inventory, and left the room. He then headed to the fourth room, where he found only two bookshelves.

On the left bookshelf, Zhang Fei [1] saw a sign that said ’human techniques’, and on the right bookshelf, he saw a sign that said ’demon techniques’. He chose to check the bookshelf on the right, as he was more interested in demon techniques than human techniques.

Zhang Fei [1] spent some time looking through all the books, with Mei helping him record them all in the system. However, he felt that none of them were interesting, and he decided to leave the place before going to the last room, which was closed by an unusual door.

Zhang Fei [1] stood in front of the door while pressing his palm against it. After some thought, he channelled his demon power into it, and as he expected, it immediately opened by itself. "So, only demons can access this room, huh?"

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding, stored the book in the system’s inventory, and left the room.
He then headed to the fourth room, where he found only two bookshelves.
On the left bookshelf, Zhang Fei [1] saw a sign that said ’human techniques’, and on the right bookshelf, he saw a sign that said ’demon techniques’.
He chose to check the bookshelf on the right, as he was more interested in demon techniques than human techniques.
Zhang Fei [1] spent some time looking through all the books, with Mei helping him record them all in the system.
However, he felt that none of them were interesting, and he decided to leave the place before going to the last room, which was closed by an unusual door.
Zhang Fei [1] stood in front of the door while pressing his palm against it.
After some thought, he channelled his demon power into it, and as he expected, it immediately opened by itself.
"So, only demons can access this room, huh?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1197: A Soul Remnant
paragraphs: When Zhang Fei [1] stepped inside, the room became bright and many people, consisting of humans and demons, were discussing serious matters. What surprised him the most was one of the people among them, especially since the man was a human and a demon, just like him. ’Mei.’

[Yes, Master. As you guessed, the man is indeed a human and a demon like you. His demon identity is a moon demon, like the main member of the Silver Moon Clan. I never expected that someone like him had existed since long ago, and his two forms had also reached equilibrium.]
Zhang Fei [1] nodded slightly and tried to listen to the people’s conversation, which was about a technique that combined the power of humans and demons. ’Heaven-Demon Silver Annihilation.’
{Can you see us?} Zhang Fei [1] was startled and turned to the woman who had asked him. {Oh, you really can see us.}
"Who are you? Aren’t these just memories left in this place? How can you talk to me?"

{My past name is Yin Shizi, and I used to be the chief researcher of my Silver Moon Clan. These are all memories, and they are memories of my past. As for me, this is just a mere remnant of my soul, and I deliberately left it in this place before my death to wait for a person with two identities like Yin Yuemo. You do look like an ordinary human from the outside, but I can feel a demon aura emanating from you, which means you also have two identities like him.}
Zhang Fei [1] looked at the man. "He was Yin Yuemo, right? How could he have two identities?"

Yin Shizi shook her head. {We never knew how Yin Yuemo could have been born with two identities, and we have been trying to uncover the mystery behind his birth and two identities. Unfortunately, our efforts never bore fruit, and he was the only member of our clan who had two identities in the past. He had a son and a daughter in the past, but they didn’t have two identities like him. His son was a human, and his daughter was a moon demon.}
"That’s weird." Zhang Fei [1] then asked her another question. "Did you guys create the Heaven-Demon Silver Annihilation technique specifically for him?"
{Yes.} Yin Shizi let out a regretful sigh. {We did create that technique specifically for Yin Yuemo, but that was our biggest mistake, and it also caused the disaster.}
"What exactly happened? How could that technique have caused the disaster back then?"
Yin Shizi pulled the book toward her before giving it to him. {Try reading this technique.}

"Alright." Zhang Fei [1] read it straight away. "The user’s body transforms into a colossal silhouette of silver light intertwined with demonic shadows, resembling a god and devil fused as one. Wherever the technique is unleashed, the sky turns silver-black. The final technique condenses all qi and demon essence into a single destructive pulse that erases everything within a radius of miles of heaven and earth; it throws off the balance between being human and being a demon in the user. Upon doing so, the human side will be destroyed, turning them into a pure demon, or the demon side will collapse, leaving the user as a frail mortal who can never cultivate again. In the end, Yi Yuemo turned into a pure demon, and he was the initial cause of the disaster."

{Yin Yuemo initiated the disaster, which culminated in the annihilation of both clans.} Then, Yin Shizi pointed to the book in Zhang Fei [1]’s hand. {Back then, I was too late to destroy this book, and I no longer have the ability to destroy it. As long as this book exists, the danger may recur in the future, and the outcome may be even more severe than it was then. Therefore, I deliberately left this strand of my soul here, and I hope you will help me destroy it.}

Zhang Fei [1] did not immediately agree to Yin Shizi’s request because the technique greatly piqued his interest, and he wanted to learn it to add to his collection of techniques. However, he remembered the situation when he almost fell under the control of the Cursed Demon Heart, and he also remembered the worry on his wives’ faces at that time.
Zhang Fei [1] released a soft sigh and used his eternal flame to burn the book to ashes. "It’s done."
{Eternal Flame! How... How did you manage to obtain the Eternal Flame?} Yin Shizi screamed in shock.
"I never obtained the Eternal Flame, and she gave me a fragment of her flame." Zhang Fei [1] retracted his flame.
{The Eternal Flame gave you her flame fragment.} Yin Shizi muttered to herself, staring at him.

Zhang Fei [1] nodded slightly. "Since you died long ago, and this wisp of your soul is tied to this place, you probably don’t know that the Eternal Flame is in this dungeon now. Furthermore, she is not alone, and she is together with Guang Zhiyi."
{Guang... Guang Zhiyi...} Yin Shizi stuttered. {Is it true? Is she really in this place now?}

"The current her is not Guang Zhiyi but Feng Yao, but they are still the same person, and I know her to some extent." Zhang Fei [1] then asked her. "Is there anything interesting in this place besides those technique books?"

{This place is our library, so there’s nothing interesting here besides those books.} Yin Shizi looked outside for a moment before returning her gaze to him. {Thank you for destroying the book, and I can rest in peace because the disaster will never happen again. My Silver Moon Clan has long been perished, and those books are our legacy. I hope you will share them with other cultivators, and our legacy will live on through them.}

Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her. "In fact, I’m establishing a new sect now, but we don’t have many techniques in other fields because it used to be a dual cultivation sect. Therefore, I’m thinking of transferring those books to my sect, and I’ll allow our future disciples to learn them. This way, your Silver Moon Clan’s legacy will be part of us, and it will live on forever."

{I think your idea is the best choice compared to those techniques spreading widely, and the disciples of your sect will inherit the legacy of my clan. My time is up, and this soul will disappear. Once again, I sincerely thank you for destroying the book.}
"Rest in peace." After Yin Shizi’s soul disappeared, Zhang Fei [1] left the room. He asked everyone there to pack up all the technique books, which excited them.
[Master, I have recorded the Heaven-Demon Silver Annihilation technique into the system, so you can still learn it if you wish.]

Zhang Fei [1] was not surprised by this, especially since Mei was always like that. However, he had no desire to learn the technique because he feared that learning it might transform him into a pure demon like Yin Yuemo did in the past, which would only make all his wives sad.
[Do you want me to delete it, Master?]
"Just keep it for now, Mei."
[Alright.]
Zhang Fei [1] suddenly sensed the presence of two powerful auras in front of the Endless Night Sanctum, and he rushed to investigate, finding Su Shentian and Jian Kuang standing outside the barrier.
"Haha! I knew you were there!" Jian Kuang exclaimed as he laughed. "Hey! Open this barrier so we can go in."
"You know the situation isn’t right for us to spar swords, right?" Zhang Fei [1] approached the barrier while asking Duanmu Lolan how to open it, and he immediately opened it for the two men.

"Haha." Jian Kuang laughed at that. "Naturally, I know that, but I didn’t come here to spar with you. Moreover, I was already satisfied after killing hundreds of those evil beasts and demons, but unfortunately, that Nine-Headed Evil Bird managed to escape from me."
"Did you have a problem with that bird?"

Jian Kuang nodded at him. "That cowardly bird massacred the people of my hometown, and I’ve been hunting him ever since. Unfortunately, he always managed to escape from my pursuit, so I still haven’t managed to avenge the villagers against him."
"I see." Zhang Fei [1] nodded slightly.
"So, what did you find in this place? How did you manage to open this barrier?" Su Shentian asked him.

Zhang Fei [1] shrugged his shoulders slightly. "You were present at the auction that time, so you should know that I am an array master, right? In fact, one of my wives opened it, especially since I went to save three people from the winged race who were attacked by that evil bird before."
"So, what did you find in this place?"

"This place is the library of the Silver Moon Clan, and there are many techniques in it." Su Shentian and Jian Kuang exchanged surprised glances. "I’ve asked them to pack up those books, and I’ll move them to my sect. If you two are interested in finding new techniques, you can go there again to choose them later."
Jian Kuang readily agreed. "You still owe me a spar, so I’ll go to your sect to spar with you and see those techniques."
"I’m in!" Su Shentian also agreed. "I heard the Silver Moon Clan was powerful in the past, so they should have a lot of good techniques."
"Let’s go in first."

chapters.title: Chapter 1198: Fifth Area: Mausoleum
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] and several women, including Luo Yunxiao and Nalan Yuzhu, had just arrived at a cemetery filled with countless ruined tombs. However, their attention was not on those ruined tombs but on the biggest one in the middle of the area. "The Endless Night Mausoleum."

The Endless Night Mausoleum is the ancient burial ground of the Silver Moon Clan. It stretches like a vast city, constructed of black stone halls and carved silver pillars that gleam dimly in the darkness. There are so many ruined tombs in that area, with the largest located in the middle. The air is filled with lingering demonic essence, which distorts perception and suppresses the powers of intruders.
"Hehe." Nalan Yushu giggled. "Husband, I think there will be many powerful souls inside, so we should go in now, and I’ll devour all those souls."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others sighed heavily upon hearing that, but they did not try to stop Nalan Yushu as they had in the Endless Night Cavern.
They had only walked a few steps but immediately stopped, and they turned to look at the people who had just arrived.
"Big Sis! Big Brother!" Nalan Yushu waved her hands at Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi, who had just arrived with the entourage from the Soul Devouring and Eternal Night Demon Races.

Nalan Wangzi approached Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Previously, we met Yao Qilin’s group, and she asked about our relationship with you. Luckily, you already informed me about it, so we answered her according to your story."

"Yao Qilin insisted on taking you with her, and she was willing to give us huge compensation to get you." Nalan Huanzi added as he walked before Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Fortunately, Elder Ye Futian was with us, so she didn’t dare force us. However, I’m not sure she would give up, and she might come to our clan to look for you."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at them. "Don’t worry, I’ll think of a solution to deal with Yao Qilin later, but we have to check the mausoleum as soon as possible before other groups come here."

"I don’t think they’ll arrive that fast, kid," Ye Futian spoke. "Those evil beasts are chasing the best talents of the human, natural, beast, and winged races. The four evil mythical beasts even sent their ten generals here, and they each brought their own large armies, so I’m sure they’re hiding from them right now."

"Phew." Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft breath. "Apart from Yao Qilin, I have also met Long Gui, Xie Zhi, Xie Heilong, and Jiu Niao before. However, they were still too strong for the current me, so I hid from them. The majority of my people are already in the labyrinth , especially since that’s the safest place for now."

Ye Futian nodded in agreement. "Ever since this dungeon appeared, people of all races have always avoided the labyrinth because there are too many traps there, and they haven’t found anything good there. Even so, many of them have tried to enter, and some have managed to reach the castle. Unfortunately, their struggle to arrive at the castle ended in vain, especially since there is nothing other than a sealed throne room there."
"Has no one managed to open the throne room yet, Elder Ye?"

Ye Futian shook his head at Luo Yunxiao. "The ten demon gods and I have been there in the past, but the seal in front of the throne room was too strong. We’ve used various methods to no avail, so we used all our strength to forcefully open it, but all our attacks were instantly dissipated upon colliding with the seal."

"No one will ever succeed in breaking the seal, especially since it was created by the guardian of the ancient races." Ye Futian and the others looked shocked as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that. "The Silver Moon Clan and the Golden Sun Clan were once part of the ancient races, and they were much older than the other ancients. I heard about this from the soul of the second-in-command of the Golden Sun Clan, who was imprisoned at the bottom of the Endless Night Abyss. He shared his memories about the disaster with me and Yao Qilin, and he also told us about the guardian named Guang Zhiyi."
"So, it was the guardian who sealed the throne and imprisoned the man’s soul at the bottom of the abyss, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told them the truth. "The throne is not empty, and the soul of the leader of the Silver Moon Clan is imprisoned there. Just like the man in the abyss, Yin Yue seems to be waiting for someone to free her from her prison; otherwise, she will never be able to reincarnate, and she will be imprisoned there forever."
Nalan Wangzi immediately asked. "Are you thinking about freeing the two of them? Aren’t you afraid they will possess you and take over your body?"

"I agree with my sister." Nalan Huanzi nodded slightly. "Even though they are dead, their souls must still be powerful, so I think freeing them would be too risky. They might not take over your body, but they might kill you and the people in this dungeon. After all, they have been imprisoned in that place for so long, so I’m sure they hold a deep grudge in their hearts, and they will immediately take their revenge on us."

"Hahaha." Nalan Yushu laughed listening to her sister and brother. "Your worries about those two souls are too much, okay? You two don’t know my husband very well, so you still don’t know much about his abilities. He is a heavenly fox, remember? He possesses some purifying abilities, and he’s purified many evil souls in the Star Tower. Therefore, you don’t need to worry about them, and he won’t release them until he’s certain they won’t cause any trouble."

Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi admitted that they didn’t know much about Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s abilities, especially his abilities as a heavenly fox. However, they still doubted that he could refine the two souls, especially since both of them were once members of the ancient races.
"Are you sure you can purify their souls, kid?"

Zhang Xiaolong shook his head at Ye Futian. "As Yushu said just now, I have some purifying abilities, but I’m not sure whether they will work or not. I won’t immediately release them from their prison, and I’ll try to purify their souls first. If I truly succeed, I’ll release them, but vice versa."

"I see." Ye Futian then looked towards the Endless Night Mausoleum. "In that case, we’ll think about those two souls later, and we should check this place first. After that, we will go to check other places."
"Hehe." Nalan Yushu chuckled. "You’re late, Elder Ye. My husband sent his other four clones to several other places, and they should have arrived there by now."
Ye Futian, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Huanzi observed Zhang Xiaolong [3]. However, they couldn’t tell whether he was his real body or his clone, especially since all of them were completely identical.

"You guys don’t need to be confused by that, and this one is my third clone. The one who met Yao Qilin was my fifth clone, and he is in the labyrinth now." The three wore curious looks, especially about Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s real body. "My real body is in seclusion to help all my wives who have not yet broken through to the Five Celestial Realms. We’ve wasted a lot of time, so we might as well go in now and check the main tomb."
All of them immediately followed behind Zhang Xiaolong [3], walking through the tomb area before entering the biggest tomb in the middle.
As soon as they entered the tomb, a stone gate immediately fell and sealed the entrance, causing some of them to become tense and nervous.

Unlike most tombs, they saw many stone beds in the room, with many human skeletons lying on them on both sides of the wall. Although they had been dead for a long time, and their flesh had long since disappeared, their skeletons were still intact, giving the place a terrifying atmosphere. In front of each stone bed, they could see a significant amount of damaged offering equipment.
Murong Mengying immediately hugged Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s arm. "Husband, I have a bad feeling about this tomb."
"Me too." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then pointed in front of them. "This area seems to be just the opening area, and the main area of this tomb is below there."
"Can you open your gate here, husband?" Qian Shuang asked him, hugging his other arm.

"Let me try it." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately asked Mei to open one, but the gate did not appear. "I can’t open it, so we have no choice but to move forward, and we might find another way out there."
"Let’s go!" Unlike Murong Mengying and Qian Shuang, Nalan Yushu was not bothered by those skeletons, and she looked excited instead.
"Why is she so excited? Is she impatient to devour the souls?" Murong Qianying asked, shaking her head.
Luo Yunxiao told her directly. "Sister Yushu is still upset because Long Gui devoured most of the souls in the Endless Night Cavern earlier, so you shouldn’t be surprised if she’s so excited."
"My sister is always impatient to devour wandering souls." Nalan Wangzi immediately followed Nalan Yushu. "Let’s go! We have to follow her."

We’ve used various methods to no avail, so we used all our strength to forcefully open it, but all our attacks were instantly dissipated upon colliding with the seal."
"No one will ever succeed in breaking the seal, especially since it was created by the guardian of the ancient races." Ye Futian and the others looked shocked as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that.
"The Silver Moon Clan and the Golden Sun Clan were once part of the ancient races, and they were much older than the other ancients.
I heard about this from the soul of the second-in-command of the Golden Sun Clan, who was imprisoned at the bottom of the Endless Night Abyss.
He shared his memories about the disaster with me and Yao Qilin, and he also told us about the guardian named Guang Zhiyi."
"So, it was the guardian who sealed the throne and imprisoned the man’s soul at the bottom of the abyss, right?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told them the truth.
"The throne is not empty, and the soul of the leader of the Silver Moon Clan is imprisoned there.
Just like the man in the abyss, Yin Yue seems to be waiting for someone to free her from her prison; otherwise, she will never be able to reincarnate, and she will be imprisoned there forever."
Nalan Wangzi immediately asked.
"Are you thinking about freeing the two of them?
Aren’t you afraid they will possess you and take over your body?"
"I agree with my sister." Nalan Huanzi nodded slightly.
"Even though they are dead, their souls must still be powerful, so I think freeing them would be too risky.
They might not take over your body, but they might kill you and the people in this dungeon.
After all, they have been imprisoned in that place for so long, so I’m sure they hold a deep grudge in their hearts, and they will immediately take their revenge on us."
"Hahaha." Nalan Yushu laughed listening to her sister and brother.
"Your worries about those two souls are too much, okay?
You two don’t know my husband very well, so you still don’t know much about his abilities.
He is a heavenly fox, remember?
He possesses some purifying abilities, and he’s purified many evil souls in the Star Tower.
Therefore, you don’t need to worry about them, and he won’t release them until he’s certain they won’t cause any trouble."
Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi admitted that they didn’t know much about Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s abilities, especially his abilities as a heavenly fox.
However, they still doubted that he could refine the two souls, especially since both of them were once members of the ancient races.
"Are you sure you can purify their souls, kid?"
Zhang Xiaolong shook his head at Ye Futian.
"As Yushu said just now, I have some purifying abilities, but I’m not sure whether they will work or not.
I won’t immediately release them from their prison, and I’ll try to purify their souls first.
If I truly succeed, I’ll release them, but vice versa."
"I see." Ye Futian then looked towards the Endless Night Mausoleum.
"In that case, we’ll think about those two souls later, and we should check this place first.
After that, we will go to check other places."
"Hehe." Nalan Yushu chuckled.
"You’re late, Elder Ye.
My husband sent his other four clones to several other places, and they should have arrived there by now."
Ye Futian, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Huanzi observed Zhang Xiaolong [3].
However, they couldn’t tell whether he was his real body or his clone, especially since all of them were completely identical.
"You guys don’t need to be confused by that, and this one is my third clone.
The one who met Yao Qilin was my fifth clone, and he is in the labyrinth now." The three wore curious looks, especially about Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s real body.
"My real body is in seclusion to help all my wives who have not yet broken through to the Five Celestial Realms.
We’ve wasted a lot of time, so we might as well go in now and check the main tomb."
All of them immediately followed behind Zhang Xiaolong [3], walking through the tomb area before entering the biggest tomb in the middle.
As soon as they entered the tomb, a stone gate immediately fell and sealed the entrance, causing some of them to become tense and nervous.
Unlike most tombs, they saw many stone beds in the room, with many human skeletons lying on them on both sides of the wall.
Although they had been dead for a long time, and their flesh had long since disappeared, their skeletons were still intact, giving the place a terrifying atmosphere.
In front of each stone bed, they could see a significant amount of damaged offering equipment.
Murong Mengying immediately hugged Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s arm.
"Husband, I have a bad feeling about this tomb."
"Me too." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then pointed in front of them.
"This area seems to be just the opening area, and the main area of this tomb is below there."
"Can you open your gate here, husband?" Qian Shuang asked him, hugging his other arm.
"Let me try it." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately asked Mei to open one, but the gate did not appear.
"I can’t open it, so we have no choice but to move forward, and we might find another way out there."
"Let’s go!" Unlike Murong Mengying and Qian Shuang, Nalan Yushu was not bothered by those skeletons, and she looked excited instead.
"Why is she so excited?
Is she impatient to devour the souls?" Murong Qianying asked, shaking her head.
Luo Yunxiao told her directly.
"Sister Yushu is still upset because Long Gui devoured most of the souls in the Endless Night Cavern earlier, so you shouldn’t be surprised if she’s so excited."
"My sister is always impatient to devour wandering souls." Nalan Wangzi immediately followed Nalan Yushu.
"Let’s go!
We have to follow her."

chapters.title: Chapter 1199: Four Souls
paragraphs: When they arrived at the B1 floor, they were quite surprised by its size, especially since it was several times larger than the previous room. They saw thousands of stone beds with human skeletons on them, almost the same as the previous room.
However, the stone beds on that floor were a little better than before, and the equipment for the offerings was more plentiful and varied.
"Tch!" Nalan Yushu gritted her teeth in annoyance. "There are so many human skeletons here, but not a single soul!"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] checked the area through the map, but he found nothing unusual there, and the map also showed no other dots besides theirs. "Let’s go down again."
"How deep is this tomb really?"
"I don’t know." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately led them down to the B2 floor, where they also found many stone beds.
Unlike the previous two floors, they couldn’t find any human skeletons on those beds, but they discovered many demon skeletons on them.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] tried examining one of the demon skeletons, but he found no signs of violence on it, proving that they died of natural causes. Since there was nothing there, he immediately led them to floor B3.
In addition to the stone beds and skeletons, they found several treasure chests on that floor. However, cultivators who had visited the dungeon in the past had looted most of them.
"So many treasures!" Nalan Yushu exclaimed.

"Let’s check on them first." Zhang Xiaolong [3] approached one of the chests that was still closed and tried to touch it, but a formation suddenly appeared, preventing him from touching it. "Try checking the other chests."
They immediately moved to check the chests, and Luo Yunxiao quickly informed him. "Husband, this chest is not protected by any formation."
"This one too!" Nalan Yushu shouted.
Murong Mengying raised an eyebrow as she touched the chest in front of her. "Husband, this chest is protected by a demon formation."
"This chest is also protected by a demon formation." Murong Qianying pointed to the chest in front of her.

Qian Shuang and the others also reported their respective discoveries, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked them to open all the chests that weren’t protected by any formations first. The contents of those chests were mostly jewels of various colors, element crystals, and other items.

Since the contents of those chests were only ordinary items, Zhang Xiaolong [3] allowed them to loot them according to their respective discoveries. He tried to crack the formation protecting the chest in front of him, but he had difficulty doing it because the formation came from the ancient era.

Qian Shuang approached Zhang Xiaolong [3] and squatted beside him. "Do you want to open all the sealed chests in this room, husband? If we do it here, we’ll waste a lot of time, so it would be better to send them away first and try to open them later."

"You’re right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] tried to open the portal to the training space. To his relief, the formation in the tomb didn’t prevent him from doing so, and he immediately lifted the chest using his aura before throwing it in. "Bring all the sealed chests here and throw them into the portal."
Ye Futian, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Huanzi were surprised to hear that. They immediately looked toward the portal, curious about the area connected to it.

"Don’t worry, I won’t take all the treasures for myself. The formation that protects these chests is too complicated, and I would rather not waste time here. Therefore, send them to my private place first, and we’ll open them together after we return." After Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke, everyone immediately used their aura to send the sealed chests into the portal before proceeding to the next room.
They also looted all the chests on floor B4 and the following lower floors, and their numbers increased as they descended further down.
Even though they had obtained so many treasures, Nalan Yushu continued to wear a disappointed expression, especially since she couldn’t find a single soul there.

They finally reached the bottom floor, which had far more treasure chests than the upper floors. Apart from the treasures, they found four coffins made of black stone there, unlike the stone beds on the previous floors.
"Ten underground floors in total." Zhang Xiaolong [3] mumbled to himself before warning them. "Don’t move first! I sense something unusual from these coffins."
"I think these coffins belong to the ancestors of the Silver Moon Clan, kid."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with Ye Futian. "Judging from the situation on the previous floors, this tomb was built according to the hierarchy within their clan, so these coffins surely belonged to their ancestors."
"How are we going to check on them, husband?" Nalan Yushu asked.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] thoughtfully rubbed his chin, and his eyes scanned the map, looking for any oddities on the floor, especially the four coffins.
"Let me try something first." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately teleported to the center of the four coffins, but they showed no reaction, confusing everyone. "This is really weird."
"Can I go there, husband?"

"Wait there, Yunxiao." Zhang Xiaolong [3] transformed into his demon form and released his demon aura. He touched one of the coffins, but nothing happened. "Could it be that my previous guess was wrong?"
Luo Yunxiao and the others immediately ran to Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s side. "Could it be that there are no souls left in this place, husband?"
"Perhaps." Zhang Xiaolong [3] carefully checked the coffin. "There aren’t any formations on this coffin, so I thought we could try to open it and take a look at the inside."
"I think you shouldn’t do that, husband." Qian Shuang and Murong Mengying agreed with Murong Qianying.
Unlike them, Nalan Yushu, who was already curious, immediately tried to open one of the coffins.
"Yushu!" Nalan Wangzi shouted and moved to stop her sister, but she was too late as Nalan Yushu hurriedly opened it.
"Hehe." Nalan Yushu giggled. "You’re worrying too much, Big Sis! Look, nothing happened, right? You—"
*Smack*
"Ouch!" Nalan Yushu screamed in pain. "What did you do that for, Big Sis?"
Nalan Wangzi shook her head slightly before scolding her. "Can you stop acting rashly? Do you want to die once again? We don’t have clear information about this place, but you’re acting like this."
Nalan Yushu pursed her lips. "Sorry, okay? I won’t act rashly again."
"You—"
*Bam*
The other three coffins suddenly opened, and four souls emerged from them. Two human souls and two demon souls, forcing Zhang Xiaolong [3] to take them away.
Ye Futian, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Huanzi immediately moved in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others, especially since they were the strongest among them.
However, the four souls didn’t pay attention to them; instead, their gazes were only focused on Zhang Xiaolong [3]. {Hu Tianlang’s chosen heir.}
Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow. "How did you guys know about that?"
The male demon soul answered him directly. {Hu Tianlang met us once in the past, and he told us about his future heir. A man with three identities: a human, a demon, and a fox.}
{Hu Tianlang asked us to wait for his heir, but his heir had never appeared before.} The female demon soul spoke.
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned. "Why did the old fox ask you guys to wait for me?"

{Hu Tianlang didn’t explain in detail the reason he asked us to wait for you.} The human woman’s soul’s answer confused him further. {Unfortunately, the situation changed beyond our control, and we died in a past disaster.}
The human man’s soul then spoke. {Fortunately, Guang Zhiyi helped us leave a small portion of our souls here, so we managed to fulfill our promise to Hu Tianlang to wait for you.}
’What exactly is the old fox planning for them? Why did he ask them to wait for me?’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] wondered to himself. "Do you have any requests from me?"
{Please help us to revive our Silver Mon Clan.}
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was stunned to hear that. "How could I possibly do that? All your clan members had died in that disaster, so there was no way I could do it."

{You’re wrong about that.} Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at the male demon soul. {Even though her soul has weakened a lot, Yin Yue’s soul is still intact, but Guang Zhiyi imprisoned her in the palace. Therefore, we hope you are willing to free her from her prison and help her reshape her body, and she will revive our clan.}

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn’t answer him straight away and thought about a few things in his mind, especially the connection between Yin Yue’s soul and the quest. "I can’t promise you anything, but I will go to the Palace to meet her soul first. If her soul is truly intact, I might be able to help her strengthen it so she can reshape her body in the future. However, I won’t be able to do so if her soul is too weak, and her only option is to reincarnate if that happens."
They nodded at him. {Even though we won’t be able to witness the results, we sincerely thank you for your willingness to try, and we hope you will truly succeed in helping Yin Yue return to life.}
"Phew." Zhang Xiaolong [3] exhaled softly. "Whether it will be successful or not, only fate can answer that."
